### [117] [Say, Echo, Do: Strategic Narratives and Revealed Positioning in Financial Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38545)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文研究金融文本中"言论(Say)—媒体回声(Echo)—真实持仓(Do)"三者的关系，回答何时该追随言论、何时该反向操作。理论证明当言论与持仓协方差为负时，言论具有负向预测能力应被淡化；并给出回声识别、收益对齐嵌入与路径签名三类测量工具，在受控市场中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融文本机器学习信号默认把机构言论与媒体转述当作价值证据，但塑造叙事者可能正与其反向交易。因此需要判别何时应追随言论、何时应淡化（fade）言论。

Method: 在线性二次模型中刻画知情机构先发声、后交易、面对部分轻信群体的行为；推导分布无关恒等式，以可观测的Say-Do协方差判断言论预测方向；并提出(1)基于到达时间与嵌入相似度的因子化后验以识别回声文章，(2)收益对齐对比目标及其损失证书，(3)路径签名统计量判断"谁先动"。

Result: 在29个已知真值的受控模拟市场中，回声情绪对收益具有显著负向预测；滚动Say-Do相关性以0.90的AUC标记虚假警报事件；收益对齐嵌入按后果而非主题组织标题。同时报告了工具的失效情形。

Conclusion: 当言论与持仓背离（Say-Do协方差为负）时，言论应被反向解读与淡化；所提测量工具能从文本中提取有经济含义的信号，但存在明确适用边界与失效场景。

Abstract: Machine-learning signals built from financial text treat what institutions say, and what the media repeat, as evidence about value. But whoever shapes a narrative may be trading against it. We study markets with three observable voices: institutional statements (Say), media repetition (Echo) and revealed positioning (Do). We ask when words should be followed and when they should be faded. In a linear-quadratic model of an informed institution that speaks and trades before a partly credulous crowd, talking an asset down while buying it is optimal exactly when $\varphi^2<2λk<\varphi$. A distribution-free identity then shows that when the observable Say-Do covariance is negative, words carry negative predictive content and should be faded. For measurement, we derive (i) an exact factorised posterior over which articles are echoes, combining arrival times with embedding similarity; (ii) a return-aligned contrastive objective that attains its bound exactly when squared embedding distances are an increasing affine function of squared outcome distances, with the tightest loss-based certificate of which neighbour rankings survive imperfect training; and (iii) a path-signature statistic for who moved first. In a controlled market with known ground truth, echo sentiment predicts returns with a significantly negative sign in all 29 simulated markets, the rolling Say-Do correlation flags false-alarm events with an AUC of 0.90, and return-aligned embeddings organise headlines by consequence rather than topic. We also report where the tools fail.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.PM'></div>

# q-fin.PM [[Back]](#toc)

### [118] [Spouse-Protected Tontines: Household Decumulation via Neural-Network Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39569)
*Duy-Minh Dang,Yukan Perumal*

Main category: q-fin.PM

TL;DR: 该论文提出"配偶保护型tontine"：首次死亡不产生池内转移，账户保留至家庭灭绝，为先去世者的配偶提供续期阶段。推导精算公平条件与有限池死亡率信用分配规则，构建多维去累积化问题并用神经网络求解，量化配偶续期成本与大规模组合多样化效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统tontine在首次死亡时发生池内转移，无法应对家庭中一方先去世后配偶仍需持续收入的情形。作者希望设计一种对配偶友好、又能保持精算公平与预算平衡的tontine机制，并评估其成本与风险。

Method: 设计配偶保护型tontine（首次死亡不转移、账户延续至家庭灭绝，为先逝者配偶提供仅配偶续期阶段）；推导合同级精算公平条件与精确事后预算平衡的有限池死亡率信用分配规则；在同质大池近似下建立代表性家庭的多维去累积化问题（含提取与再平衡控制）；目标权衡预期实际家庭支付与相对家庭准备金目标终端短缺的CVaR（不条件于存活至期末）；采用全局时间神经网络参数化容许控制策略进行数值求解；在代表性合同与账簿两个层面用期望成本与风险加载支付尺度载荷量化配偶续期成本；刻画大账簿极限下平均每合同续期成本等于给定共同市场信息下代表性合同期望成本。

Result: 基于澳大利亚数据的数值实验显示，仅配偶阶段是家庭中一阶且持续的事件。大账簿层面多样化消除了代表性合同配偶续期的大部分超额上尾成本，但不改变期望每合同续期成本。跨国死亡率比较表明，仅配偶阶段的普遍性与持续性并非澳大利亚特有。

Conclusion: 配偶保护型tontine可在无首次死亡池转移的前提下实现精算公平与预算平衡，并有效覆盖配偶续期风险；大规模组合多样化能显著降低续期风险的上尾成本，且该风险具有跨国普遍性。

Abstract: We develop a spouse-protected tontine in which a first death changes the household state but generates no pool transfer. The same account remains attached to the household contract until extinction and funds a spouse-only continuation phase if the retiree dies first. We derive contract-level actuarial-fairness conditions and a finite-pool mortality-credit allocation rule with exact ex post budget balance. Under a homogeneous large-pool approximation, we formulate a multidimensional decumulation problem for a representative household, with withdrawal and rebalancing controls while the retiree is alive. The objective balances expected cumulative real household payments against the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of terminal shortfalls relative to household reserve targets, without conditioning on survival to the horizon. We develop a numerical solution method for this problem based on a global-in-time neural-network parameterization of admissible control policies. We quantify policy-induced spouse-continuation costs using expected-cost and risk-loaded payment-scale loads at both representative-contract and book levels. We characterize the large-book limit of average per-contract continuation cost as the expected representative-contract cost conditional on common market information.
  Numerical experiments calibrated to Australia show that the spouse-only phase is a first-order and persistent household event. In these experiments, book-level diversification removes most of the representative-contract excess upper-tail cost of spouse continuation in the large-book limit, without changing expected per-contract continuation cost. A cross-country mortality comparison indicates that the prevalence and persistence of the spouse-only phase are not specific to Australia.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [119] [How People Use ChatGPT: Conversation-Level Evidence from India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38279)
*Shreyasi Roy Chowdhury,Kiran Garimella*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 首个跨多国、会话级别且带人口统计信息的ChatGPT使用研究：基于印度、尼日利亚、巴西、巴基斯坦1252名用户202590条会话，揭示本地化用途与互动模式变迁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公众对LLM对话助手使用的认知主要来自OpenAI和Anthropic的汇总平台报告：采用固定分类法和推断的人口特征，只发布外部研究者无法重新分析的统计数据。缺少会话级别、带自报人口特征、覆盖多个非西方国家的比较视角。

Method: 分析1252名用户（印度、尼日利亚、巴西、巴基斯坦）的202590条ChatGPT完整导出会话，含自报年龄与性别，时间跨度2022年12月至2026年2月。结合平台自带分类器、无监督主题发现，以及对表达性会话的主题分析，考察用途、话题和互动方式。

Result: 各国个人用途占55-64%，课业与工作相近，职场生产力仅代表少数使用。无监督主题发现揭示被OpenAI分类法归入通用类别的国别用途：印度与巴西的健康养生、巴基斯坦的乌尔都语-英语翻译、尼日利亚的时事、尼日利亚与巴基斯坦的宗教问题、巴西的自我反思。三年间，信息寻求类会话仅小幅下降，任务委派类未增长，而用户自我表达类会话从百分之几升至每国约五分之一以上。

Conclusion: 同一产品在各国附着于不同的本地需求，理解"采用"的含义需要会话级别、国别敏感的测量，与全球汇总数据互为补充。

Abstract: Public understanding of how people use LLM-based conversational AI assistants comes primarily from aggregate platform reports by OpenAI and Anthropic, which apply fixed taxonomies and inferred demographics to hundreds of millions of users and release only summary statistics that outside researchers cannot re-analyze. We provide a complementary, conversation-level view: complete ChatGPT exports comprising 202,590 conversations from 1,252 users across India, Nigeria, Brazil, and Pakistan, paired with self-reported age and gender and spanning December 2022 to February 2026. To our knowledge this is the first conversation-level, demographically grounded comparison of ChatGPT use across multiple non-Western countries. We ask what these users use ChatGPT for (purpose), what they talk about (topics), and how they engage with it (mode of interaction), using the platform's own classifiers, unsupervised topic discovery, and a thematic analysis of expressive conversations. Personal use accounts for 55-64% of conversations in every country and coursework is about as common as work, so workplace productivity describes a minority of use. Unsupervised topic discovery surfaces country-specific uses that the OpenAI taxonomy folds into generic categories: health and wellness in India and Brazil, Urdu-English translation in Pakistan, current affairs in Nigeria, religious questions in Nigeria and Pakistan, and self-reflection in Brazil. Over three years, the share of conversations that seek information declined only modestly and the share that delegate a task did not grow, while conversations in which users express themselves rose from a few percent to roughly a fifth or more in every country. The same product is thus attached to different local needs in each country, and understanding what adoption means requires conversation-level, country-sensitive measurement alongside global aggregates.

</details>


### [120] [Anthropomorphism in the age of Large Language Models: An overview of potential risks and mitigations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38486)
*Ismael T. Freire,Marceau Nahon,Maud van Lier,Katie Evans,Hélie Bazin,Michele Farisco,Kathinka Evers,Raja Chatila,Mehdi Khamassi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文综述了AI拟人化现象，梳理理论框架、语言框架作用、风险分类及缓解策略，主张以系统组织与能力为基础理解AI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM与AI系统常被以拟人化方式描述和理解，这种认知可能带来多方面问题，需要系统性梳理以厘清其成因、影响与应对方式。

Method: 文献综述与概念分析：考察拟人化动因与合理性，分析语言框架的影响，构建风险分类体系并提出干预方向。

Result: 提出包含21项关切、5大类别（认知、情感、人类能动性、规范、社会与制度）的风险分类法，并将其与设计、传播、教育、治理四类干预措施相关联。

Conclusion: 理解AI需基于其组织结构与实际能力的概念与理论；语言对拟人化感知的塑造应纳入这一科学努力，因为描述方式影响我们对AI的理解及赋予其的社会角色。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and more broadly Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are often described and understood in human-like terms, a phenomenon known as \emph{anthropomorphism}. This paper provides a synthesis of recent literature on anthropomorphism in AI, covering theoretical frameworks, the role of language in framing AI as human-like, the various risks of anthropomorphizing machines, and strategies to mitigate these issues. After examining why we tend to anthropomorphize AI systems and whether we are right to do so, we highlight the impact of linguistic framing on anthropomorphism. Then, we introduce a conceptual taxonomy of risks associated with AI anthropomorphism. This taxonomy groups twenty-one concerns within five analytical categories: epistemic, affective, human agency, normative, and societal and institutional risks. Finally, we relate these concerns to proposed interventions in design, communication, education, and governance. We argue that a better understanding of AI systems requires concepts and theories grounded in their organization and demonstrated capacities. The linguistic shaping of anthropomorphic perceptions should form part of this scientific effort, since our descriptions influence both how these systems are understood and the roles we allow them to occupy in society.

</details>


### [121] [Navigating the Changing Landscape of Online Knowledge Consumption and Production in the Age of Generative AI: Evidence from Stack Overflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38563)
*Ji Eun Kim,Léa Vitale,Libby Hemphill,Yulin Yu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: ChatGPT发布后，Stack Overflow中消费者从提问转向回答但其答案更少被采纳，生产者提问减少但转向新话题、回答更受认可，说明生成式AI未带来平等的参与机会。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线知识社区依赖提问者与回答者之间的认知分工，生成式AI可能模糊这种角色划分，但其如何重新分配知识寻求与生产活动、并重塑参与的性质与回报尚不清楚。

Method: 以ChatGPT发布为节点，对Stack Overflow不同用户群体（消费者与生产者）的提问与回答行为变化进行实证分析。

Result: 消费者从提问转向回答，但答案被接受率低于ChatGPT之前；生产者提问数量未变，但更多涉及新颖和新兴话题，回答数量减少但获得更高认可。

Conclusion: 生成式AI的可及性并不必然转化为成功参与的平等机会。

Abstract: Online knowledge communities rely on a division of epistemic labor between users who seek information and those who produce it. Generative AI may blur these roles, but how it reallocates knowledge-seeking and knowledge-producing activities and reshapes the nature and returns of participation remains unclear. We examine changes in question-asking and answering among Stack Overflow user groups, focusing on consumers and producers, following the release of ChatGPT. Consumers shifted from asking questions to producing answers, but their answers were less likely to be accepted relative to the pre-ChatGPT period, suggesting that increased production did not yield equal standing in the community. By contrast, producers did not change the number of questions they asked, but increasingly asked about novel and emerging topics. Although they produced fewer answers, their answers received greater recognition. These findings show that access to generative AI does not necessarily translate into equal opportunities for successful participation.

</details>


### [122] [Drowning in AI Slop: How Social Media Platforms (Do Not) Label AI and Deepfake Content under EU law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38571)
*Bram Rijsbosch,Luka Bekavac,Henry Tari,Gijs van Dijck,Konrad Kollnig*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对Instagram、TikTok、X和YouTube的AI标签实施进行法律导向的审计，发现AI标签虽已广泛建立，但在最需要标注的深度伪造场景覆盖率仍不足（仅33%），受控上传中仅61%被标注且元数据常被剥离，各平台规则与检测方式差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI标签成为社交媒体上AI生成内容透明度的主要保障手段（如欧盟《数字服务法》和《人工智能法》要求），但缺乏关于平台实际如何实施这些标签的系统性证据。

Method: 基于欧盟委员会2026年7月深度伪造指南，对四大平台进行法律导向审计：分析平台政策与检测方法；采集10,722条系统性风险及AI相关关键词帖子；500条专家标注子集；对四平台进行十个主流生成式AI工具输出的受控上传实验。

Result: AI标签已广泛建立，四平台均自动应用标签，平台自行标注比例高于以往审计。但覆盖不完整：系统性风险语境下仅33%的专家认定深度伪造带有平台AI标签，而这些帖子中位浏览量达16万；受控上传中平台仅标注61%，且常在上传后剥离标准AI来源信号。平台规则、标签设计、检测方法和报告方式差异显著。

Conclusion: AI标签虽已普及但在关键场景覆盖不足，且平台间实践分化严重；研究提出了改善AI标签采纳率、清晰度与有效性的具体机会。

Abstract: AI labels are emerging as a primary safeguard for transparency about AI-generated content on social media, including under the EU Digital Services Act and AI Act. Yet, limited systematic evidence exists on how platforms implement such labels in practice. We conduct a legally grounded audit of AI labelling across Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube, drawing on the European Commission's July 2026 guidelines on deepfakes. To this end, we analyse platform policies and detection approaches, 10,722 posts collected via systemic-risk and AI-related keywords, an expert-annotated subset of 500 posts, and controlled uploads to the four platforms of outputs from ten popular generative AI tools. We find that AI labelling is now broadly established. All four platforms apply labels automatically and a greater share of labels are platform-applied than in earlier audits. However, coverage remains incomplete where labelling arguably matters most: only 33% of expert-identified deepfakes in systemic risk contexts carried a platform-applied AI label, while reaching a median of 160,000 views. In controlled uploads of AI-generated content carrying standard AI provenance signals, platforms labelled only 61% of uploads, and commonly strip those signals after uploading. Overall, platform rules, label designs, detection approaches, and reporting diverge substantially. In response, we identify concrete opportunities to improve the uptake, clarity and efficacy of AI labelling.

</details>


### [123] [Breaking News Out of the Filter Bubble: Generative AI Search Diversifies Collective Attention and Raises Shared Information Consumption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38946)
*Heeseung Andrew Lee,Dokyun Lee,Gwanhoo Lee,Dongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 通过《华盛顿邮报》37,561名读者的随机实地实验发现，生成式AI搜索在扩大共同信息的同时，也促进了话题消费的多样化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI搜索和AI概览正在改变信息与新闻的获取方式，引发担忧：读者接触的话题范围会变窄、彼此间的共同信息会减少。本文旨在实证检验这些担忧。

Method: 在《华盛顿邮报》开展随机实地实验，37,561名读者参与。两组搜索同一档案库，实验组额外获得带文章引用的AI答案，显示在传统结果之上。测量范围涵盖展示的答案与被打开的文章。对比两组的话题覆盖度、消费集中度、重叠度及点击与搜索行为。

Result: AI搜索扩大了热门话题的触达范围，提升了读者间话题消费的重叠度；同时消费变得更分散，并转向较冷门话题（读者内与受众层面均如此）。AI答案贡献了共同信息增长的大部分，无需点击即可传递，并拓宽了曝光范围。被引用文章也推动了向冷门话题的转移。读者从传统结果点击和浏览转向被引文章与后续搜索。更频繁的搜索抵消了单次搜索文章消费的下降，使每读者文章消费略增，每分钟总信息消费上升。

Conclusion: 生成式AI搜索能够使集体注意力多样化，同时增强读者间的共同信息，缓解了对信息窄化和共同性下降的担忧。

Abstract: Generative AI search and AI overviews are transforming access to information and news, renewing concerns that readers will encounter a narrower range of topics and have less in common. We examine these concerns via a randomized field experiment with 37,561 readers at The Washington Post. Both groups searched the same archive, but treatment readers also received AI answers with article citations above conventional results. Measuring consumption across displayed answers and opened articles, we find that AI search expands the reach of widely read topics and increases overlap in readers' topic consumption. At the same time, consumption becomes less concentrated and shifts toward less-popular topics, both within readers and across the audience. AI answers account for most of the increase in shared information, delivering it without requiring article clicks and broadening exposure beyond the articles readers open. Cited articles also contribute to the shift toward less-popular topics. Readers shift from conventional-result clicks and browsing toward cited articles and follow-up searches. More frequent searching offsets lower article consumption per search, producing a small increase in article consumption per reader. Total information consumption per minute also rises. Generative AI search can thus diversify collective attention while strengthening the information readers have in common.

</details>


### [124] [Freeze, Validate, Report: Auditing Urban Station Plans with Common Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39064)
*Julian Teusch,Oliver Keszöcze*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出"冻结-验证-报告"评估契约，在统一验证证据上比较七种车站选址生成器，使城市车站规划方案可比、可审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通部门比较城市车站规划时，需区分"方案真实差异"与"评估输入差异"。若从各方案自身的接入结果反推空间单元、行程或候选块，评分将不可比。因此需要一个固定评估契约来保证可比性与可审计性。

Method: 冻结-验证-报告（Freeze-Validate-Report）契约：固定目标行程、代理群体、报告单元、候选池与字典序选择规则。以端点距离（起点+终点到最近车站距离之和）作为统一验证证据。比较七种生成器（聚类、设施选址、公平性改造、网格对照）。用双点示例说明方案专属观测选择可逆转目标均值排序，并做比例均值公平小群诊断与事后敏感性检查。

Result:  Porto选出IFkCO（个人公平k-中心带离群点改造），测试整体与最差群体90分位为805 m与872 m；芝加哥选出Grid，同日后续窗口为1404 m与1656 m。事后检查显示输入敏感：候选从300增至600会改变两市选择；固定小时并跨三个芝城日期则选出Priority。方案专属候选池会改变诊断排名；可采纳性与求解界仅适用于抽样池。

Conclusion: 在声明契约内建立了可审计性，而非部署后的稳定性能保证。代理定义与指标优先级仍属主管部门的选择，方案附带代码、哈希、决策日志与候选池。

Abstract: Transport authorities comparing urban station plans need to distinguish plan differences from differences in evaluation inputs. Reconstructing spatial units, included trips, or candidate blocks from each plan's access outcomes can make scores incomparable. Freeze--Validate--Report fixes an evaluation contract: target trips, proxy groups, reporting cells, candidate pools, and a lexicographic selection rule. A two-point example shows that plan-specific observation selection can reverse the target mean ordering. We compare seven generators spanning clustering, facility location, fairness-oriented adaptations, and a grid control. All plans are scored on common validation evidence using endpoint distance: the sum of origin and destination distances to their nearest stations. A five-metric rule selects one plan for a single test report. In Porto, it selects IFkCO, an adaptation of individually fair $k$-center with outliers; test overall and worst-group 90th percentiles are 805 m and 872 m. In Chicago, it selects Grid; values in a later test window on the same day are 1404 m and 1656 m. Post hoc checks show input sensitivity: expanding candidates from 300 to 600 changes selection in both cities, while holding the hour fixed across three Chicago dates selects Priority. A proportional mean fairlet diagnostic shows that plan-specific proposal pools can change diagnostic ranks; admissibility and solver bounds apply only to the sampled pool. The package supplies code, hashes, decision logs, and proposal pools. We establish auditability within a declared contract, not stable performance after deployment; proxy definitions and metric priorities remain the authority's choices.

</details>


### [125] [The Concentration of Artificial Intelligence in Big Tech and Its Implications for Human Rights in the European Union](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39285)
*Marcin Marciniak*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证AI产业的高度集中将市场力量转化为对基本权利行使条件的私人治理，并主张竞争政策需与权利影响评估、互操作性、公共研究、劳动者参与和救济机制结合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进AI发展日益集中于少数垂直整合的科技巨头，它们掌控算力、云、数据、基础模型、软件生态与分发渠道。作者关注这种集中如何影响基本权利的行使条件，并探讨相应的治理对策。

Method: 采用跨学科叙事性综述，结合爱尔兰、英国、美国和智利的数据中心扩张证据，以及自动化和集体谈判相关研究进行分析。

Result: 集中影响平等获取、隐私、科学自由、工作条件、基本资源获取、环境保护和有效救济；收益可能广泛分布，但决策权和经济回报仍集中于少数企业。集中本身不构成权利侵犯，但会增加依赖、不透明、转换成本以及社会与环境成本外化的风险。

Conclusion: 竞争政策必须与基于权利的影响评估、互操作性、公共研究能力、劳动者参与以及可执行的审查与救济途径相结合。

Abstract: The development of advanced artificial intelligence is increasingly concentrated in a small group of vertically integrated technology companies. These firms control combinations of computing infrastructure, cloud services, data, foundation models, software ecosystems, and channels of distribution. This article argues that such concentration transforms market power into a form of private governance over the conditions in which fundamental rights are exercised. Drawing on an interdisciplinary narrative review, it examines how concentration affects equality of access, privacy, freedom of science, working conditions, access to essential resources, environmental protection, and the availability of effective remedies. Evidence from data-centre expansion in Ireland, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Chile, together with studies of automation and collective bargaining, shows that benefits may be widely distributed while decision-making power and economic returns remain concentrated. Concentration does not itself establish a rights violation, but it increases dependency, opacity, switching costs, and the risk that social and environmental costs are externalised. The article concludes that competition policy must be combined with rights-based impact assessment, interoperability, public research capacity, worker participation, and enforceable access to review and remedy.

</details>


### [126] [Executive Judgement in AI-Mediated Decision-Making Environments: A Process Theory of Formation, Qualification Attrition and Authorisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39442)
*Richard Hill*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 文章提出"资格衰减"（qualification attrition）与"形成—授权缺口"概念，解释局部胜任的人机判断贡献为何在组合后仍导致授权不足的组织承诺，并给出高管判断治理的四个维度与四个命题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI影响高管判断的形成、备选与评估，现有研究已解释混合认知、依赖、管理能动性与问责，但仍缺乏对"局部胜任却整体失效"这一过程性挑战的解释。

Method: 概念性/理论建构：提出资格衰减过程与形成—授权缺口，界定高管判断治理四维度（边界设定、解释性挑战、依赖校准、可问责授权），并构建四个命题连接转换、资格衰减、治理安排与认知风险、问责风险和判断质量。

Result: 局部胜任的人与AI贡献可能在授权前因既定操作假设、不确定性或依赖关系丢失或被转化，而使组织承诺的论证依据不足；形成—授权缺口即"有根据承诺所需依据"与"授权角色仍可获得、可理解、可质疑的依据"之间的差距。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一套整合性过程理论，说明分布式判断形成即使各环节胜任、依赖决策合理、问责安排正式，仍可能作为"组合"而失败。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence can contribute to the representations, alternatives and evaluations through which executive judgements are formed. Existing research already explains important aspects of hybrid cognition, reliance, managerial agency and accountability. This article develops a narrower process challenge: locally competent human and AI contributions can still culminate in an inadequately warranted organisational commitment when established operational assumptions, uncertainties or dependencies are lost or transformed before authorisation. It proposes qualification attrition as the process through which such epistemically consequential content is weakened across successive transformations, and a formation--authorisation gap as the resulting discrepancy between the grounds required for warranted commitment and those that remain accessible, intelligible and challengeable to the authorising role. Executive judgement governance is defined through four dimensions: boundary setting, interpretive challenge, reliance calibration, and authorisation with answerability. Four propositions connect transformation, qualification attrition and governance arrangements to epistemic risk, accountability risk and judgement quality. The contribution is an integrative process theory of how distributed judgement formation can fail as a composition even where individual contributions, local reliance decisions and formal accountability arrangements appear competent.

</details>


### [127] [From Knowledge to Legitimacy: A Philosophical Problem Discovery of AI Implementation Readiness in Public Health Disease Surveillance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39513)
*Tithi Mitra,Souvik Pramanik,Most. Aysha Siddika Sumona,Ahmed Faizul Haque Dhrubo,Farhana Sharmin,Mohammad Abdul Qayum*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究采用定性问题发现设计，结合主题分析与哲学分析，探讨AI在中低收入国家疾病监测中的实施障碍，提出包含四个维度的实施就绪框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在疾病监测（早期发现、疫情预测、循证决策）中具潜力，但在LMICs应用受阻（卫生信息系统碎片化、数字不平等、治理问题、机构能力不足）。现有研究多聚焦AI预测的效力与准确性，忽视了部署所需的其他条件。

Method: 定性问题发现研究设计，整合主题分析与哲学分析，考察AI在疾病监测中实施的结构性与规范性障碍。

Result: 识别出四个相互关联的实施就绪维度：认识论充分性、分配正义、治理伦理、机构合法性，揭示知识整合局限、数字基础设施不均、隐私与问责、机构与公众信任不足等制约。

Conclusion: 提出将AI疾病监测实施视为社会-技术与规范性双重过程的理论框架，为后续实证研究与在资源受限环境中设计情境敏感、伦理合理、机构可持续的AI监测系统提供基础。

Abstract: Despite being an emerging credible means of using artificial intelligence (AI) for improving disease surveillance via early detection of outbreaks, epidemics prediction and evidence-based decision-making, there continue to be challenges in the use of AI tools in many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) due to various factors including fragmented health information system, digital inequality, governance problems and institutional incapability. Most of the research conducted so far has concentrated on the efficacy and accuracy of AI in terms of predicting outbreaks, with little focus on other conditions necessary for its deployment. This study adopts a qualitative problem-discovery research design, integrating thematic analysis with philosophical analysis to examine the structural and normative barriers surrounding AI implementation in disease surveillance. The analysis identifies four interrelated dimensions of implementation readiness: epistemic adequacy, distributive justice, ethics of governance, and institutional legitimacy. These dimensions provide a framework for understanding how limitations in knowledge integration, unequal digital infrastructure, privacy and accountability concerns, and deficits in institutional and public trust can constrain the practical adoption of AI-enabled surveillance. Rather than proposing another predictive model, this study develops a theoretical framework that conceptualizes AI implementation in disease surveillance as simultaneously a socio-technical and normative process. The framework provides a foundation for subsequent empirical investigation and offers a structured perspective for designing more context-sensitive, ethically grounded, and institutionally sustainable AI-enabled disease surveillance systems in resource-constrained healthcare settings.

</details>


### [128] [A Reusable Semantic Web Framework for Evidence-Grounded Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments under the EU AI Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39537)
*Faith Olopade,Delaram Golpayegani,David Lewis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 提出基于语义网（RDF/SPARQL）的可复用框架，整合高风险AI系统基本权利影响评估（FRIA）所需的碎片化证据，覆盖就业与公共服务两类场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EU AI Act第27条要求高风险AI部署者部署前进行FRIA，但所需证据分散于互不兼容的事件库、风险词表和法条之中，难以支撑可信评估。

Method: 构建150条记录的人工整理语料，用关键词、LLM及混合方法沿四个维度标注，序列化为含1,351条RDF三元组的知识图谱；设计5个FRIA演示场景并以69条金标准评估。

Result: 5个场景共覆盖103条记录（68.7%覆盖率）；LLM辅助的就业领域分类仅达κ=0.045，显示该领域自动化公平性证据检索效果较差。

Conclusion: 该框架可复用并支持监管机构、国家主管部门与中小企业采纳，但LLM在该领域的自动分类可靠性有限，需谨慎对待；所有制品已开放发布。

Abstract: The EU AI Act (Art. 27) requires deployers of high-risk AI systems to conduct Fundamental Rights Impact Assessments (FRIAs) before deployment, yet the evidence needed for credible assessments is fragmented across incompatible incident repositories, risk vocabularies, and legal texts. We present a reusable Semantic Web-based framework that consolidates this evidence for two high-risk public sector categories: employment and worker management (Annex III(4)) and access to essential public services (Annex III(5)(a)). A curated 150-record corpus is annotated along four axes using keyword, LLM, and hybrid methods and serialised as a SPARQL-queryable knowledge graph of 1,351 RDF triples. Five FRIA demonstration scenarios surface 103 records (68.7% coverage). Evaluation against a 69-record gold standard reveals that LLM-assisted classification of the employment domain achieves only $κ= 0.045$, a cautionary result for automated fairness-related evidence retrieval in this domain. All artefacts are released openly to support adoption by regulators, national authorities, and SMEs.

</details>

### [129] [Multiperiod bond portfolio optimization with transaction costs using a Markov Decision process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38765)
*Balaji Ramachandran,Srikanth Iyer,Shashi Jain*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于模拟的多期债券组合优化框架，在利率风险和比例交易成本下，用DNS+VAR建模收益率曲线并离散化为马尔可夫链，构建有限期MDP，通过后向归纳求解最优策略，同时量化转移核截断误差的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银行国债组合需在收益率、流动性与利率风险间权衡，静态配置规则缺乏动态调整机制，在利率上升时易积累大幅市值损失与流动性压力（如2023年硅谷银行倒闭）。

Method: 用Dynamic Nelson-Siegel参数化结合VAR因子动态建模收益率曲线，构造时间非齐次离散状态马尔可夫链近似跨期限联合收益率过程；以该链为状态空间建立有限期马尔可夫决策过程，投资者在比例再平衡成本约束下最大化期望终端财富，用后向归纳求解最优组合策略。

Result: 量化了截断转移核引入的近似误差：对期望终端财富几乎无影响，但显著扭曲回撤与尾部统计量。

Conclusion: 该框架为利率风险下的多期债券组合优化提供了可处理的模拟求解方法，并提醒转移核截断会破坏回撤和尾部风险刻画，需谨慎处理。

Abstract: Bank treasury portfolios must balance yield, liquidity, and interest-rate risk across bonds of different maturities. Static allocation rules are ill-suited to this task: portfolios concentrated in long-duration securities with no dynamic adjust- ment mechanism can accumulate large mark-to-market losses and liquidity stress under rising interest rates, as illustrated by the failure of Silicon Valley Bank in 2023. We develop a tractable simulation-based framework for multi-period bond port- folio optimization under interest-rate risk and proportional transaction costs. Yield-curve dynamics are modeled using the Dynamic Nelson-Siegel parameter- ization with Vector Autoregressive factor dynamics, from which we construct a time-inhomogeneous discrete-state Markov chain approximating the joint yield process across bond maturities. This chain forms the state space of a finite- horizon Markov Decision Process in which the investor maximizes expected terminal wealth subject to proportional rebalancing costs. The optimal portfolio policy is obtained by backward induction. We also quantify the approximation error introduced by truncating the transition kernel, and show that it leaves mean terminal wealth almost unchanged while substantially distorting drawdown and tail statistics.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [130] [Robust LassoNet: Enhancing Feature Selection in Neural Networks via Robust Loss Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38263)
*Daniela De Canditiis,Italia De Feis,Paola Stolfi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出Robust LassoNet，通过引入Huber、Cauchy、Tukey's bisquare等鲁棒损失函数，解决LassoNet对离群值敏感的问题，在污染数据下提升预测与特征选择性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络特征选择在噪声或受污染数据下仍是难题。LassoNet结合层次稀疏约束实现同时预测与变量选择，但其标准形式依赖MSE损失，对离群值高度敏感。

Method: 提出Robust LassoNet，在保留LassoNet原有优化框架的基础上，用Huber、Cauchy、Tukey's bisquare和Nonnegative Garrote等鲁棒损失函数替换MSE，以缓解极端观测的影响。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，存在离群值或重尾噪声时，Robust LassoNet显著提升预测性能和特征选择准确率，在干净数据上保持相当性能。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了基于神经网络的特征选择中鲁棒性的重要性，并为选择合适的损失函数提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Feature selection in neural networks remains a challenging problem, particularly in the presence of noisy or contaminated data. LassoNet is a recent approach that addresses this issue by combining neural networks with hierarchical sparsity constraints, enabling simultaneous prediction and variable selection. However, its standard formulation relies on the mean squared error (MSE) loss, which is known to be highly sensitive to outliers. In this paper, we present Robust LassoNet, an extension of LassoNet that incorporates robust loss functions, such as Huber, Cauchy, Tukey's bisquare, and Nonnegative Garrote, to mitigate the effect of extreme observations. The proposed approach preserves the original optimization framework while improving stability under data contamination. Through experiments on synthetic and real datasets, we show that robust LassoNet significantly improves both predictive performance and feature selection accuracy in the presence of outliers or heavy tailed noise, while maintaining comparable performance in clean settings. These results highlight the importance of robustness in neural network based feature selection and suggest practical guidelines for choosing appropriate loss functions.

</details>


### [131] [Acceleration of Diffusion Language Model through Discrete Average Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38364)
*Yidong Ouyang,Zhengyan Wan,Themis Haris,Tian Tan,Liqian Peng,Henry Li,Ziqian Lin,Jianhang Chen,Maryam Karimzadehgan,Alec Go,George Michailidis*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出Discrete Average Generator (DAG)，将MeanFlow思想扩展到连续时间马尔可夫链(CTMCs)，通过定义区间上的平均生成子并利用自洽恒等式，实现离散扩散模型的高效少步生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型与流匹配是离散状态空间生成建模的有力框架，但高效的少步生成仍是基本挑战。连续空间中的MeanFlow通过定义区间平均速度场解决了类似问题，而离散空间缺乏对应方法。

Method: 将MeanFlow扩展到CTMCs，定义平均生成子为转移核在时间区间上的归一化增量；证明其满足自洽恒等式作为训练目标基础；设计了与扩散语言模型标准训练范式一致且可操作的训练策略；在逐坐标边际投影下，自洽恒等式具有闭式表达，支持高效训练与推理。

Result: Potts模型模拟中，目标将K步采样器的总变差距离最多降低67%；在OpenWebText上，8至64步采样下取得所评估方法中最低的生成困惑度，并实现16倍加速；在ImageNet上性能与现有方法相当。

Conclusion: 平均生成子的自洽恒等式为离散生成模型提供了高效少步生成的原理性框架，在文本与图像任务上均验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models and flow matching have emerged as powerful frameworks for generative modeling over discrete state spaces, yet efficient few-step generation remains a fundamental challenge. In this work, we introduce the Discrete Average Generator, a principled extension of MeanFlow to Continuous-Time Markov Chains (CTMCs). Analogously to how MeanFlow defines an average velocity field over a time interval in continuous spaces, we define an average generator as the normalized increment of the transition kernel over a time interval. We show that this average generator satisfies a self-consistency identity, which provides the foundation for our training objective. We further develop training strategies that align with the standard training paradigm of diffusion language models while keeping the resulting objective tractable. When projected onto per-coordinate marginals, the self-consistency identity admits a closed-form expression, enabling efficient training and inference. In Potts model simulations, our objective reduces the total variation distance of the $K$-step sampler by up to 67%. On OpenWebText, our method achieves the lowest generative perplexity among the evaluated methods for 8 to 64 sampling steps while enabling a $16\times$ acceleration, and achieves comparable performance to existing methods on ImageNet.

</details>


### [132] [Lower Bounds for Linear-Oracle Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38375)
*Mohit Sinha*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明了Weibel等人的猜想：每轮常数次线性最小化的确定性预言机学习器在一般凸集上无法突破T^{3/4}遗憾率下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线Frank-Wolfe在一般凸集上的最优遗憾率仅为T^{3/4}，Weibel等人猜想固定系数方法无法改进，此前缺乏对任意确定性学习器的通用下界证明。

Method: 在仅限预言机的模型中，对每轮至多b次调用、直径界D、梯度范数界L，构造维度d=2b(T-1)+1的困难实例；对手在博弈前固定域、初始点、确定性打平规则与线性损失，顶点构成路径使决策前可见点当前损失为零、而末顶点每轮负损失，并给出精确算术证书。

Result: 构造实例遗憾至少为2^{-1/4}LDb^{-1/4}T^{3/4}；常数b时与已知维度无关上界匹配。单次固定调度且最新梯度系数非零时，另一构造给出至少3LDT^{3/4}/4且每次查询有唯一最小点，精确证书与Weibel调优调度数值最坏情况吻合。

Conclusion: 证实了Weibel等人的猜想，将下界推广至任意确定性预言机学习器，说明常数次线性最小化无法改善在线Frank-Wolfe的T^{3/4}遗憾率。

Abstract: Can a constant number of linear minimizations per round improve on the $T^{3/4}$ regret rate of online Frank-Wolfe on general convex sets? Weibel et al. conjectured that fixed-coefficient methods cannot. We prove their conjecture and extend the lower bound to every deterministic learner in an oracle-only model. The learner receives an initial feasible point and a diameter bound, and must remain feasible on every domain consistent with its oracle replies. For $T$ rounds, at most $b$ calls between decisions, diameter bound $D$, and gradient norm bound $L$, we construct an instance in dimension $d=2b(T-1)+1$ with regret at least $2^{-1/4}LDb^{-1/4}T^{3/4}$. The adversary fixes the domain, initial point, deterministic tie rule and linear losses before play. The vertices form a path on which every point available before a decision has zero current loss, while the final vertex has negative loss on every round. For constant $b$, the result matches the known upper rate for dimension-independent guarantees. For one-call fixed schedules with a nonzero coefficient on the newest gradient, a second construction gives regret at least $3LDT^{3/4}/4$ with unique minimizers at every issued query. Exact-arithmetic certificates for the tuned schedule of Weibel et al. closely match their finite-horizon numerical worst cases, with unique oracle replies.

</details>


### [133] [Generative sequence modeling for infinite memory processes via predictive states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38524)
*Michael Wieck-Sosa,Cosma Rohilla Shalizi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出基于预测状态（可含无限记忆）的一步前条件分布估计算法，统计复杂度由预测状态空间的内在维度决定，并用深度神经网络实现并验证快速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖有限记忆、稀疏性或可加性等假设，难以处理长程非线性交互过程；而放弃这些假设又面临维度灾难问题。

Method: 引入基于过程预测状态的新估计方法，允许无限范围记忆；当历史可压缩为预测未来的低维充分统计量时实现快速收敛；给出基于深度神经网络估计器的理论保证。

Result: 证明估计问题的统计复杂度由预测状态空间的内在维度决定，深度神经网络实例获得快速收敛率，并通过实验支持理论结果。

Conclusion: 估计难度取决于预测状态空间的内在维度，而非原始历史维度，从而在长程依赖下实现高效非参数估计。

Abstract: We consider estimating the one-step-ahead conditional distribution of a multivariate stochastic process. Many existing approaches rely on assumptions such as finite-range memory, sparsity, or additivity, which can be poorly suited to processes with long-range nonlinear interactions. However, without such structural assumptions, nonparametric estimation is challenging due to the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we introduce a new estimation approach based on the predictive states of a process, possibly with infinite-range memory. We show that our estimator achieves fast convergence rates when the past history can be compressed into a low-dimensional statistic that is sufficient for predicting the future. Specifically, we show that the statistical complexity of the estimation problem is determined by the intrinsic dimension of the predictive state space. We establish guarantees for an instantiation of our method based on deep neural network estimators, and we support these theoretical results with experiments.

</details>


### [134] [Bandits with Multiple Optimal Arms: Minimax Regret and Non-Adaptivit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38659)
*Kaixuan Ji,Qiwei Di,Qingyue Zhao,Heyang Zhao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究有多个最优臂的多臂老虎机问题，改进了次采样算法的遗憾上界至 $\tilde{O}\big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T}\big)$，并给出匹配下界，证明该速率接近最优，同时说明需要知道最优臂数量 $A$ 才能达到近最优遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际决策问题存在多个正确答案，因此需要研究具有多个最优臂的多臂老虎机问题。已有次采样算法遗憾界为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$，尚不够紧，且缺少完整的极小极大刻画。

Method: 针对 $K$ 臂、$A$ 个最优臂的 MAB，对已有次采样算法（De Heide et al., 2021；Zhu and Nowak, 2020）进行更精细的分析，并构造匹配下界；同时分析算法对最优臂数量 $A$ 的知识依赖。

Result: 上界达到 $\tilde{O}\big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T}\big)$，优于此前的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$；下界在忽略对数因子后与之匹配，表明该速率接近极小极大最优；并证明需要知道 $A$（精确到 $\tilde{O}(1)$ 因子）才能实现近最优遗憾，否则遗憾会显著增大。

Conclusion: 本文对 $1 \leq A \leq K-1$ 全范围给出了 $K$ 臂、$A$ 最优臂多臂老虎机的完整极小极大刻画。

Abstract: We study multi-armed bandits (MAB) with multiple optimal arms, motivated by the fact that many practical decision making problems admit multiple correct answers. For $K$-armed bandits with $A$ optimal arms, we first provide a sharper analysis of previous sub-sampling algorithms (De Heide et al., 2021; Zhu and Nowak, 2020), establishing a $\tilde{O}\Big(\frac{K-A}{\sqrt{KA}}\sqrt{T} \Big)$ minimax regret, where $T$ is the total number of interactions and $\tilde O(\cdot)$ drops all constant and logarithmic factors, improving the previous $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KT/A})$ regret. We then provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, indicating that our established rate is nearly minimax-optimal. We further show that the knowledge of $A$ up to $\tilde{O}(1)$ factors is necessary to achieve near-optimal regret, as near-optimal algorithms for one number of optimal arms must incur substantially larger regret than optimal regret for a smaller number. Overall, our results provide a comprehensive minimax characterization of $K$-armed bandits with $A$ over the entire range of $1 \leq A \leq K-1$.

</details>


### [135] [Sharp Statistical Rates for Asynchronous TD Learning with Markovian Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38880)
*Yang Peng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明了单轨迹表格时序差分（TD）学习中最后迭代的收敛速率，达到 $\widetilde O(H^3/(\mu_{\min}\varepsilon^2) + t_{\operatorname{mix}}/\mu_{\min})$ 转移数，并给出匹配的极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究标准表格 TD 学习从单条轨迹进行最后迭代收敛，需在非可逆链、任意初始分布、有界奖励下，同时控制统计误差与混合暂态，且希望去除混合时间的额外视界因子。

Method: 采用反向时间的锚定局部泊松方程控制随机波动（无混合时间因子），用命中时间补偿恒等式约束初始化误差，并通过期望累积传播质量界将论证推广到递减步长。

Result: 最后迭代 TD 以高概率在 $\widetilde O(H^3/(\mu_{\min}\varepsilon^2) + t_{\operatorname{mix}}/\mu_{\min})$ 转移内达到 sup-norm 误差 $\varepsilon$；适用于常数步长和目标无关的递减步长，后者给出所有时刻的同时保证。三状态构造在慢混合区域给出统计项与混合项的匹配（对数内）极小极大下界。

Conclusion: 该工作刻画了单轨迹 TD 最后迭代的紧致收敛速率：统计项保持同步 TD 的 $H^3$ 依赖，混合暂态无额外视界因子，并证明其极小极大最优性。

Abstract: We study the last iterate of standard tabular temporal-difference (TD) learning from a single trajectory of a finite Markov reward process. For discount factor $γ$, write $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, and let $μ_{\min}$ and $t_{\operatorname{mix}}$ denote the minimum stationary probability and total-variation mixing time. We prove that last-iterate TD achieves sup-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ with high probability using$\widetilde O\left(
  \frac{H^3}{μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2}
  +\frac{t_{\operatorname{mix}}}{μ_{\min}} \right)$ transitions, for $0<\varepsilon\leq1$. This rate holds both for a constant step size selected for the target accuracy and for a decreasing schedule independent of the target accuracy and terminal time. The latter gives a simultaneous guarantee over all times beyond an explicit transient threshold. The statistical term retains the cubic effective-horizon dependence of synchronous TD, and the additive mixing transient has no extra horizon factor. The result allows non-reversible chains, arbitrary initial state distributions, and bounded rewards that may depend on the next state. The proof uses an anchored local Poisson equation in reverse time to control stochastic fluctuations without a mixing-time factor, and a hitting-time compensation identity to bound initialization error. The latter also yields a finer transient in terms of the worst expected reverse hitting time. A bound on the expected cumulative propagation mass extends this argument to decreasing step sizes. A three-state construction with known deterministic rewards gives matching minimax lower bounds for the statistical and mixing terms, up to logarithms, over specified model classes in a slow-mixing parameter regime.

</details>


### [136] [Warm-starting PDE solvers with any-dimensional machine learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38916)
*Wilson G. Gregory,George A. Kevrekidis,Ben Blum-Smith,Soledad Villar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究PDE学习型求解器的维度泛化能力，证明在方程与初始数据满足对称性条件时，可将低维训练的求解器零样本迁移到高维PDE；当方程对称但数据不对称时，可用低维求解器为高维求解器提供热启动。在热方程、Burgers方程和可压缩Navier–Stokes方程上验证，显著提升高维性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受图神经网络可迁移性研究的启发，作者希望探究PDE学习型求解器是否也能像GNN一样，在低维输入上训练后直接用于求解高维PDE，从而降低训练成本与数据需求。

Method: 作者基于PDE和初始数据的对称性，推导出使低维训练的PDE求解器能零样本迁移到高维PDE的数学条件。当方程满足对称性但数据不满足（物理中常见）时，利用该理论对低维求解器进行热启动，以辅助高维PDE求解。

Result: 在热方程、Burgers方程和可压缩Navier–Stokes方程上进行实验，在零样本和高维常规训练两种模式下均提升性能。例如，用2D Navier–Stokes数据训练的代理模型，在3D测试数据上的表现优于用3D数据训练的基线模型，而仅使用约12%的FLOPs和20%的数据量。

Conclusion: 该工作为PDE学习型求解器的维度迁移提供了理论基础和实用方法，证明低维训练可有效迁移或热启动高维PDE求解，大幅节省计算与数据成本。

Abstract: Any-dimensional machine learning models, such as graph neural networks (GNNs), can be naturally trained and evaluated on inputs of different sizes and dimensions. Inspired by the GNN transferability literature, we show mathematical conditions under which a partial differential equation (PDE) learning-based solver can be trained in small dimensions and directly applied to solve a higher dimensional PDE in a zero-shot fashion. These conditions are based on symmetries in both the partial differential equation and the initial data. When the equations satisfy the symmetries but the data does not, which is the case for many PDEs arising from physics, we show that our theory gives a principled way of warm-starting low-dimensional PDE solvers for higher dimensional PDEs. We apply this method on the heat equation, Burgers' equation, and the compressible Navier--Stokes equations, improving the performance in both zero-shot and typical training regimes on high dimensional data. For example, we train a surrogate model on 2D Navier--Stokes data and achieve better results on 3D test data than a baseline surrogate model trained on 3D data, while only using 12$\%$ of the flops and 20$\%$ of the total data size.

</details>


### [137] [Minimax rates for learning spectral Barron functions by deep ReLU neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39020)
*Songqiu Ma,Yunfei Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文研究深度ReLU网络对谱Barron函数的逼近与学习，给出深度网络逼近率并证明学习速率是极小极大最优的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明浅层网络可高效逼近谱Barron函数而不受维度诅咒影响，但深度网络的逼近能力及该类函数的学习最优速率尚不明确，本文对此进行补充。

Method: 针对d维、平滑指数s>0的谱Barron函数，推导深度ReLU网络的逼近界，并基于该结果分析用n个样本学习该类函数的收敛速率，最后证明其极小极大最优性。

Result: 深度ReLU网络对谱Barron函数的逼近率为Õ(S^{-1/2-s/d})（S为非零参数数）；学习收敛速率为n^{-(d+2s)/(2d+2s)}。

Conclusion: 该学习速率在忽略对数因子意义下是极小极大最优的，表明深度ReLU网络可快速学习谱Barron函数。

Abstract: We study how well deep neural networks approximate and learn spectral Barron functions. Recent studies have shown that these function classes can be efficiently approximated by shallow neural networks without suffering from the curse of dimensionality. We complement these results by providing new approximation bounds for deep networks with ReLU activation and establishing the minimax rates for learning these function classes. Specifically, we show that $d$-dimensional spectral Barron functions with smoothness index $s>0$ can be approximated by deep ReLU neural networks with approximation rate $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}} (S^{-\frac{1}{2}-\frac{s}{d}})$, where $S$ denotes the number of nonzero parameters in the network. Using this approximation result, we further show that deep ReLU neural networks can learn spectral Barron functions in a fast rate $n^{-\frac{d+2s}{2d+2s}}$ with $n$ training samples. Finally, we prove that this convergence rate is minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [138] [Steepest Guidance: A Practical and Principled Approach to Inference-Time Alignment of Flow and Diffusion-based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39091)
*Shokichi Takakura,Akifumi Wachi,Rei Higuchi,Kohei Miyaguchi,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出Steepest Guidance框架，将流/扩散模型的推理时对齐视为概率测度空间的序列优化问题，通过最大化目标的局部改进来近似Doob's h-transform引导，并提供理论分析与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流与扩散模型的推理时对齐对灵活生成至关重要。Doob's h-transform理论上提供了优雅解，但实际推理时估计其最优引导很困难。

Method: 将推理时对齐重新定义为概率测度空间中的序列优化问题，基于目标局部改进最大化原则，提出Steepest Guidance框架。

Result: 通过充分实验验证了方法的有效性，并提供了理论分析。

Conclusion: Steepest Guidance为扩散/流模型推理时对齐提供了可行且有效的方案，克服了Doob's h-transform实际估计困难的问题。

Abstract: Inference-time alignment of flow and diffusion-based models is critical for achieving flexible generative modeling. Theoretically, Doob's $h$-transform provides an elegant solution to this problem, and most existing methods are based on this principle. However, in practice, estimating the optimal guidance derived from Doob's $h$-transform at inference time is challenging. To deal with this issue, we regard inference-time alignment as a sequential optimization problem in the space of probability measures and propose a novel framework called *Steepest Guidance*, based on the principle of maximizing local improvement in the objective. We provide a theoretical analysis of the proposed method and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive experiments.

</details>


### [139] [Asymptotic Properties of Support Vector Machines in High-Dimension, Low-Sample-Size Settings under a Spiked Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39173)
*Yugo Nakayama*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究spiked模型下SVM的渐近性质，指出SVM在HDLSS下不一致，提出SC-SVM并证明其一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有HDLSS下SVM理论依赖几何表示，要求协方差矩阵特征值不占主导；但该条件在spiked模型下不成立，导致既有结论失效。

Method: 在spiked模型下分析SVM渐近性质，研究Gram矩阵依分布收敛与有限维随机构型；分析BC-SVM的不足；提出spike-corrected SVM (SC-SVM)。

Result: 几何表示在spiked模型下不成立；Gram矩阵收敛为随机矩阵，数据收敛到由spike数决定维度的有限维随机构型；SVM误分类率不趋于零（不一致）；BC-SVM因bias项需修正而表现不佳；SC-SVM在样本量趋于无穷时具有一致性，且其样本量增长是必要的（固定样本量下任何基于投影的方法都失败）；数值模拟验证。

Conclusion: spiked HDLSS模型下传统SVM与BC-SVM存在根本困难，SC-SVM可恢复一致性，且样本量增长对投影类方法不可或缺。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider asymptotic properties of the support vector machine (SVM) in high-dimension, low-sample-size (HDLSS) settings under a spiked model. The existing theory of the SVM in the HDLSS context relies on the geometric representation of HDLSS data, which requires that the eigenvalues of the covariance matrices are not dominant. We first show that the geometric representation does not hold under the spiked model. We show that the Gram matrix of HDLSS data converges in distribution to a random matrix, namely, the HDLSS data converge to a random configuration in a finite-dimensional space whose dimension is given by the number of the spikes. We show that the misclassification rates of the SVM do not tend to zero, that is, the SVM does not hold the consistency property. We also show that the bias-corrected SVM (BC-SVM) does not give preferable performance in this setting because the bias term itself should be modified. In order to overcome such difficulties, we propose a spike-corrected SVM (SC-SVM). We show that the SC-SVM holds the consistency property when the sample size goes to infinity, and that the growth of the sample size is essential in the sense that any projection-based procedure fails when the sample size is fixed. Finally, we check the performance of the classifiers by numerical simulations.

</details>


### [140] [Minimax Additive Regression under Unknown Dependent Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39212)
*Baptiste Ferrere,Fabrice Gamboa,Jean-Michel Loubes*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 研究非乘积随机设计下随样本量增长的维度中的可加回归，提出耦合光滑类与Riesz基构造，建立预测的极小极大上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有可加回归研究多假设乘积设计或固定维度；本文放松为一般非乘积随机设计，并允许维度d随样本量n增长，需处理变量间依赖及密度与分量的光滑性耦合问题。

Method: 引入耦合光滑类，分别控制边缘密度与密度加权可加分量的正则性；针对依赖结构改造函数ANOVA模型的Riesz基构造，在联合密度一致有界下得到与维度无关的相容性界；构造阈值最小二乘估计量。

Result: 在适当的维度增长条件下，对已知或未知边缘密度的预测建立匹配的极小极大上下界；当边缘密度至少与加权分量同样光滑时，未知密度问题达到已知密度的极小极大速率；当密度较不光滑时，其正则性决定极小极大速率；中心化可加分量可达相同的聚合上界速率，且无额外阶误差。

Conclusion: 非乘积设计下可加回归的可估计性由分量与边缘密度的耦合光滑性共同决定，依赖结构可通过维度无关的Riesz基相容性界加以控制，密度光滑性成为决定极小极大速率的关键因素。

Abstract: We study additive regression under a potentially non-product random design on $[0,1]^d$, allowing the dimension $d$ to grow with the sample size $n$. We introduce coupled smoothness classes that separately control the regularity of the marginal densities and the density-weighted additive components. To handle dependence, we adapt a Riesz-basis construction for functional ANOVA models and establish compatibility bounds with constants independent of the dimension under uniform bounds on the joint density. We construct thresholded least-squares estimators and establish matching minimax upper and lower bounds for prediction with known or unknown marginal densities, under suitable dimension-growth conditions. When the marginal densities are at least as smooth as the weighted components, the unknown-density problem attains the known-density minimax rate. When the densities are less smooth, their regularity determines the minimax rate over the coupled class. Finally, we show that the centered additive components can be recovered at the same aggregate upper rate, without an additional order of error.

</details>


### [141] [Discrete Score Matching Enables Causal Discovery from Count Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39326)
*Euijong Song,Hyewon Park,Gunwoong Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将SCORE的常曲率准则推广为条件曲率分数(CCS)与离对角曲率分数(OCS)，用于计数数据的因果发现，并提出DISCO算法实现DAG恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计数数据中导数不可用，用有限差分替代无法满足因果发现需求，需要新的准则与算法。

Method: 提出条件曲率分数(CCS)用于排序，离对角曲率分数(OCS)用于父节点恢复；用连续数据的score函数与计数数据的concrete score构造两个分数。提出DISCO算法，用离散扩散估计CCS和OCS。

Result: 双变量中零CCS精确刻画半参数GLM条件形式；在正则条件下，canonical-parameter非线性是可识别性的充要条件；框架严格包含SCORE识别的非线性高斯ANM类。实验在Poisson、负二项、二项及混合族设置中准确恢复DAG，单GPU可扩展到1000节点。

Conclusion: 该框架为计数数据因果发现提供了新的一类半参数GLM DAG，并通过DISCO实现可扩展的DAG恢复。

Abstract: Count data pose a challenge for score-matching-based causal discovery: derivatives are unavailable, and simply replacing them with finite differences does not generally suffice for causal discovery. We generalize SCORE's constant-curvature criterion (Rolland et al., 2022) by conditioning on the node's value, yielding the conditional curvature score (CCS) for ordering. We also extend curvature-based parent recovery through the off-diagonal curvature score (OCS), enabling directed acyclic graph (DAG) recovery with both scores constructed from score functions for continuous data and concrete scores for counts. In the bivariate setting, zero CCS exactly characterizes a semiparametric generalized linear model (GLM) conditional form in which the conditional family need not be specified in advance, unlike in classical GLMs. For bivariate semiparametric GLM DAGs under our regularity condition, canonical-parameter nonlinearity is necessary and sufficient for identifiability. In multivariate DAGs, this nonlinearity enables DAG recovery through CCS and OCS. Our framework identifies a new class of semiparametric GLM DAGs that strictly contains the nonlinear Gaussian ANM class identified by SCORE. We introduce DISCO (DIscrete SCOre), a count-DAG recovery algorithm that estimates CCS and OCS using discrete diffusion. Experiments demonstrate accurate DAG recovery across Poisson, negative binomial, binomial, and mixed-family settings, as well as scalability to 1,000-node DAGs on a single GPU.

</details>


### [142] [A Dynamical Theory of LoRA in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39367)
*Théo Marchetta,Filippo Alessandroni,Alessandro Breccia,Alessandro Ingrosso,Federica Gerace*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 通过可解双任务师生模型对LoRA进行精确动力学刻画，揭示低秩更新在持续学习中的干扰与惯性权衡，并提出状态依赖掩码策略显著减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LoRA被广泛使用，但其在持续学习中的动力学、以及低秩更新如何影响灾难性遗忘的机制尚不清楚。

Method: 在高维在线学习极限下，对双任务师生模型推导宏观序参量的闭合ODE系统，得到Task 1学习和Task 2 LoRA微调全过程泛化误差的精确表达式；并据此分析状态依赖掩码策略（冻结承载第一任务最强表征的隐藏单元）。

Result: 理论与有限维模拟定量吻合；低秩适应减少对第一任务特征的干扰，但初始化拖慢第二任务适应。掩码策略在保持新任务可塑性的同时显著减少遗忘。适配器秩的作用：迁移仅提升至目标任务内在维度后饱和，而遗忘随秩持续增长。结论在序列MNIST基准上定性重现。

Conclusion: 提供了低秩适应如何跨序列任务组织信息的动力学与几何解释，并为缓解遗忘的秩选择与掩码设计提供理论指导。

Abstract: Despite the widespread use of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), little is known about its dynamics in continual learning and the mechanisms by which low-rank updates affect catastrophic forgetting. We provide an asymptotically exact dynamical characterization of LoRA in a solvable two-task teacher-student model. In the high-dimensional online-learning limit, we derive a closed system of ordinary differential equations for a finite set of macroscopic order parameters, yielding exact expressions for the generalization errors throughout both the initial Task 1 learning phase and the subsequent LoRA fine-tuning on Task 2. The theory quantitatively matches finite-dimensional simulations and exposes two characteristic effects of LoRA: low-rank adaptation reduces interference with features learned on the first task, but its initialization slows adaptation to the second task. Building on this mechanistic picture, we analyze a state-dependent masking strategy that freezes hidden units carrying the strongest first-task representations and restricts adaptation to the complementary subspace. This structural partitioning markedly reduces forgetting, while preserving plasticity on the new task. Our framework further clarifies the role of adapter rank: transfer improves only up to the intrinsic dimensionality of the target task and saturates beyond it, while forgetting continues to grow with rank. These results provide a dynamical and geometric account of how low-rank adaptation organizes information across sequential tasks and are qualitatively reproduced on a sequential MNIST benchmark.

</details>


### [143] [Towards Optimal Inventory Control under Censored Demand: A Biased Sample-Average Approximation Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39397)
*Yuxuan Han,Xiaoyu Fan,Jiawei Zhang,Zhengyuan Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究截尾需求下的多周期失销库存控制，提出基于成本分解与有偏SAA的统一框架，实现在线与离线近最优学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 截尾需求下缺货仅揭示需求超过库存水平，数据信息不完整，给数据驱动的库存策略学习带来挑战，需要新的框架与覆盖条件保证样本效率。

Method: 构建基于基本库存策略的新成本分解，提出覆盖条件；据此设计两种有偏SAA算法：上偏算法（离线近最优样本复杂度）和下偏算法（在线主动生成覆盖、近最优遗憾）。

Result: 在离线覆盖条件下上偏SAA达到近最优样本复杂度；下偏SAA在线主动创造所需覆盖并达到近最优遗憾。

Conclusion: 有偏SAA为截尾反馈下的悲观与乐观机制提供通用原则，具有独立研究价值。

Abstract: We study data-driven multi-period lost-sales inventory control under censored demand, where a stockout reveals only that demand exceeded the stocking level. We develop a unified, model-based framework for policy learning from censored data, built on a new cost decomposition for base-stock policies and a biased sample-average approximation (SAA) approach. The cost decomposition allows us to propose a new coverage condition under which censored observations are informative enough for sample-efficient policy learning. Guided by this coverage condition, we design two biased SAA algorithms: an upper-biased one that achieves near-optimal sample complexity under the offline coverage condition, and a lower-biased one that actively generates the required coverage and achieves near-optimal regret online. More broadly, this biased SAA approach provides a general principle for implementing pessimism and optimism under censored feedback, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [144] [Principal Component Regression Dominates all Monotone Spectral Filters for Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39440)
*Juno Kim,Hengyu Fu,Peter Bartlett,Jason D. Lee,Jingfeng Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文比较线性回归中单调谱滤波器（含PCR、GD、岭回归）的实例级有限样本风险，证明PCR主导所有单调谱滤波器，且在滤波器远离阶梯函数时呈现强主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作（Wu et al. 2026）证明GD强主导岭回归，但缺乏对更广泛单调谱滤波器类的统一理解，需明确PCR在该类中的最优性地位。

Method: 对单调谱滤波器类进行实例级有限样本风险比较分析，建立通用谱滤波器新的上界与下界，并在岭回归或GD特化时达到实例级紧致。

Result: 最优调参的PCR风险在所有问题上不超过任意单调谱滤波器常数倍，即PCR主导该类；若滤波器远离阶梯函数（如GD、岭回归），存在问题实例使PCR风险随样本量多项式因子更小；新界在特化到岭回归或GD时恢复或改进已知最优界。

Conclusion: PCR在单调谱滤波器中是最优且可容许的，显著推广了GD强主导岭回归的结论。

Abstract: We compare the instance-wise, finite-sample risks of monotone spectral filters for linear regression, a broad class of estimators including principal component regression (PCR), gradient descent (GD), and ridge regression. We show that PCR dominates all monotone spectral filters: compared to any such filter, the risk of optimally tuned PCR is no bigger by a constant factor for all problems. Furthermore, the dominance is strong if the filter is separated from step functions (e.g., GD and ridge): there exist problem instances for which the risk of PCR is smaller by a polynomial factor in sample size dependence. Our comparison results show that PCR is optimal and thus admissible among monotone filters, significantly extending Wu et al. (2026)'s result that GD strongly dominates ridge. From a technical perspective, we establish new upper and lower bounds for general spectral filters, which are instance-wise sharp when specialized to ridge or GD, recovering or improving the best-known bounds.

</details>


### [145] [Distributionally robust linear regression through the lens of adversarial training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39449)
*Elis Stefansson,David Vävinggren,Antônio H. Ribeiro*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文统一研究Wasserstein DRO线性回归，涵盖平方根Lasso与对抗线性回归为特例，证明其误差界、枢轴性与解等价性等性质，并给出高效求解与数值验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRO是分析鲁棒性与泛化的原则性框架，Wasserstein DRO可推广多种正则化方法；但缺乏对Wasserstein DRO线性回归这一统一方法的系统理论刻画，本文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 将Wasserstein DRO线性回归重铸为二次形式（类似对抗线性回归）作为关键证明步骤，并给出高效求解算法。

Result: 证明了：(i) 确定性非渐近样本内误差界，一般为O(n^{-1/2})，在设计矩阵与稀疏性条件下为O(n^{-1})；(ii) 对噪声水平不敏感的枢轴性；(iii) 小与大模糊集下的解等价性；数值模拟验证了结论。

Conclusion: Wasserstein DRO线性回归统一并继承了平方根Lasso与对抗线性回归的诸多性质，且可高效求解，兼具理论保证与实用性。

Abstract: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) studies parameter estimation under uncertainty in the underlying probability distribution and has emerged as a principled framework for analyzing robustness and generalization. In particular, Wasserstein DRO, with distributional uncertainty induced by the Wasserstein distance, generalizes several popular regularizers. This paper studies Wasserstein DRO linear regression, unifying square-root Lasso and adversarial linear regression as important special cases. We prove that many properties of these two special cases carry over to this general method. In particular, we show (i) deterministic and non-asymptotic in-sample error bounds $O(n^{-1/2})$ in general and $O(n^{-1})$ under design matrix and sparsity conditions; (ii) insensitivity to the noise level, also known as the pivotal property; and (iii) solution equivalences for small and large ambiguity sets. The key proof step is to recast the method into a quadratic form, mimicking adversarial linear regression. We also show that the method can be solved efficiently, and we validate our findings through numerical simulations.

</details>


### [146] [CAMOS: Coupled Oscillatory State-Space Model for Multimodal Clinical Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39484)
*Maxx Richard Rahman,Mostafa Hammouda,Wolfgang Maass*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文证明线性状态空间模型用掩码处理缺失模态存在表征局限，提出CAMOS：将耦合矩阵置于微分方程内并由可用性门控，使转移算子依赖观测模式，并在ADNI/OASIS-3上取得更优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向临床队列（如ADNI）多模态、不规则采样且普遍缺失（近半访问缺PET和CSF）。线性状态空间模型虽能处理不规则采样，但对缺失模态仅做输入掩码、不改变转移算子。作者证明此类层无法表征模态间"共同出现/共同缺失"的交互，这构成表征局限。

Method: 提出CAMOS：每个模态配置一组二阶振荡器bank，通过位于微分方程内部的耦合矩阵连接，并由可用性门控，使转移算子本身成为观测模式的函数。为恢复可分析性，引入逐通道Gershgorin预算保证有效刚度在所有2^M可用性模式与间隙下一致正定；用能量论证将放大归因于可用性转变而非序列长度；通道分解保持精确的并行关联扫描。

Result: 在ADNI上，CAMOS在同次访问分期、landmark预测和纵向预测任务上优于非耦合振荡状态空间模型与临床融合模型；零样本迁移到OASIS-3时，是唯一避免坍缩到多数类的模型。

Conclusion: 让转移算子依赖模态可用性可突破线性状态空间模型的表征限制，CAMOS在保持理论可分析性与计算效率的同时显著提升多模态缺失场景下的临床预测与迁移能力。

Abstract: Longitudinal clinical cohorts are multimodal, irregularly sampled and pervasively incomplete: in ADNI, positron emission tomography and cerebrospinal fluid assays are absent from roughly half of all visits. Linear state-space models handle irregular sampling gracefully but treat a missing modality by masking the input, leaving the transition operator untouched. We prove that this is a representational limitation: the latent state of any linear state-space layer whose transition operator does not depend on the availability pattern is an additive function of the availability indicators, so no such layer can represent an interaction between two modalities being jointly present or jointly absent. We propose CAMOS, which gives each modality a bank of second-order oscillators coupled through a matrix that sits inside the differential equation and is gated by availability, so the transition operator itself becomes a function of which measurements were taken. Coupling invalidates the analysis of uncoupled oscillatory models, and we restore it: a per-channel Gershgorin budget makes the effective stiffness positive definite uniformly over all $2^M$ availability patterns and all gaps, an energy argument charges amplification to availability transitions rather than sequence length, and a channel factorization preserves exact associative parallel scans. On ADNI, CAMOS outperforms uncoupled oscillatory state-space models and clinical fusion models on same-visit staging, landmark prediction and longitudinal forecasting, and under zero-shot transfer to OASIS-3 it is the only model that avoids collapse to the majority class.

</details>


### [147] [Mitigating Representation Gaps in Amortized Bayesian Inference with Auxiliary Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39525)
*Hans Olischläger,Svenja Jedhoff,Šimon Kucharský,Aayush Mishra,Stefan T. Radev,Paul Bürkner*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出用辅助引导损失监督内部表示，以改善摊销贝叶斯推理的训练动态，加速收敛并提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摊销贝叶斯推理虽在理想收敛下可靠，但实际受限于架构与优化选择，在有限模拟、算力和时间预算下只能“将就”，导致不可避免的表示缺口，通常需针对具体问题修补。

Method: 提出一种通用替代方案：对网络内部表示施加辅助引导损失；将表示缺口形式化为卡在特征学习部分与条件分布学习部分之间信息瓶颈处的局部最优，并提供诊断方法以区分摘要失败与推理失败。

Result: 引导在训练数据充足时带来更快收敛，在数据稀缺时带来更好性能；在多个具有挑战性的真实推理问题上提升了收敛速度和精度。

Conclusion: 辅助监督是一种通用且有效的手段，可缓解摊销推理中的表示缺口，改善训练动态与推理精度，并提供诊断工具。

Abstract: Casting Bayesian inference as a neural network optimization problem targeting an amortized posterior is attractive, as it extends to otherwise intractable statistical models and offers near instantaneous inference for new datasets after prepaying the training cost. Although theory guarantees faithfulness under ideal convergence, practical amortized inference still requires iterating over architectures and optimization choices and ultimately ``satisficing'' under finite simulation, compute, and time budgets. Even the best-performing solution may thus retain avoidable representation gaps that typically require problem-specific fixes. Here, we propose a generic alternative which improves training dynamics with auxiliary guidance losses applied to internal representations. Specifically, we show how such guidance leads to faster convergence when training data is abundant and to better performance when it is scarce. We formalize representation gaps as getting stuck in a local optimum at the information bottleneck between the parts of the network tasked with feature learning and those tasked with conditional distribution learning, and offer a generic diagnostic to separate summary failures from inference failures. Finally, we demonstrate that auxiliary supervision improves convergence speed and accuracy on a range of challenging real-world inference problems.

</details>


### [148] [Estimation of the Label-Noise Transition Matrix with Performance Guarantees via Selective Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39829)
*Xabier de Juan,Santiago Mazuelas,Yilun Zhu,Clayton Scott*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于单侧选择性分类的标签噪声转移矩阵估计方法，绕过类后验估计，提供有限样本性能保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习依赖大规模数据，但高质量标注成本高昂，带噪数据学习变得普遍，因此准确估计标签噪声转移矩阵至关重要。然而现有转移矩阵估计器依赖脆弱的类后验估计，且缺乏有限样本性能保证。

Method: 提出基于单侧选择性分类（one-sided selective classification）的新方法来估计转移矩阵，绕过类后验估计，为二元分类利用灵活的学习方法，并设计了有效的实现算法。

Result: 方法能够绕过类后验估计并提供有限样本性能保证；所提算法给出了更精细的有限样本性能界。

Conclusion: 该工作为标签噪声转移矩阵估计提供了一种具有理论保证的新途径，克服了现有方法在类后验估计与有限样本分析方面的不足。

Abstract: Modern machine learning depends heavily on massive datasets, but obtaining high-quality annotations at scale is often expensive. As a result, learning from noisily-labeled data has become common, making accurate estimation of the label-noise transition matrix crucial. However, existing transition matrix estimators rely on the fragile estimation of class-posteriors and do not provide finite-sample performance guarantees. In this work, we propose a novel methodology to estimate the transition matrix based on one-sided selective classification. This approach bypasses class-posterior estimation, provides finite-sample performance guarantees, and leverages flexible learning methods for binary classification. Moreover, we introduce effective algorithms to implement the proposed methodology and provide their refined finite-sample performance bounds.

</details>


### [149] [BayesNDE: Bayesian Generative Modeling for Neural Density Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39843)
*Chenglin Li,Qiao Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出BayesNDE，一种基于贝叶斯生成建模的神经密度估计器，无需可逆网络或雅可比行列式计算，通过样本特定的隐后验构建自适应提议并结合桥式采样估计密度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密度估计是统计与机器学习的核心问题，现有神经密度估计器常依赖可逆网络或雅可比行列式计算，限制灵活性与计算效率。

Method: 学习贝叶斯生成模型；为每个观测推断样本特定的隐后验，构建自适应提议分布，将计算聚焦于密度贡献最大的区域；用桥式采样结合提议样本与独立后验样本估计密度。

Result: 在非线性与多模态合成数据集上，密度值估计更准、密度结构恢复更好，优于当前最优神经密度估计器；在真实数据集上异常检测性能提升。

Conclusion: BayesNDE是一种灵活有效的神经密度估计器，表明后验推断可将生成模型转化为密度估计工具。

Abstract: Density estimation is a fundamental problem in statistics and machine learning. In this work, we introduce BayesNDE, a neural density estimator based on Bayesian generative modeling. BayesNDE learns a Bayesian generative model and evaluates its density without requiring invertible networks or Jacobian-determinant computation. For each observation, it infers a sample-specific latent posterior to construct an adaptive proposal that focuses computation on regions contributing most to its density. Bridge sampling then combines samples from this proposal with separate posterior samples to estimate the density. Experiments on nonlinear and multimodal synthetic datasets show improved estimation of density values and better recovery of the density structure compared to the state-of-the-art neural density estimators. Applications to real-world datasets further demonstrate improved anomaly detection. Together, these results highlight BayesNDE as a flexible and effective neural density estimator, demonstrating how posterior inference can turn generative models into tools for density estimation. The code and tutorials are available at https://github.com/liuq-lab/BayesNDE.

</details>


### [150] [Amortized Bayesian Inference on Multilevel Models of Arbitrary Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40024)
*Daniel Habermann,Andreas Bulling,Stefan T. Radev,Paul-Christian Bürkner*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种通用方法，用于任意结构多层模型的摊销贝叶斯推断。通过图扩展和图反转自动推导后验分解与神经网络架构，保持模型的全部条件独立性和可交换性，在超过6500个参数上接近金标准采样器，训练后推断接近即时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多层模型摊销推断方法常简化依赖结构以加速学习或推断，导致丢失原生成模型的条件独立性和可交换性假设，限制了准确性和通用性。

Method: 给定以有向无环图表示的生成模型，方法自动推导联合后验的有效分解及匹配的神经网络架构。核心步骤为图扩展与图反转：反转图决定推断网络的堆叠与条件化方式，生成的分解可对组数量及组内观测数量进行摊销，同时不简化依赖结构。

Result: 在三个案例研究中，该方法在参数超过6500的模型上与金标准采样器高度吻合，训练完成后推断仅需接近即时的前向传播。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种自动、通用的多层模型摊销贝叶斯推断框架，无需牺牲模型的条件独立性结构即可实现高效且准确的推断。

Abstract: We develop a general method for amortized Bayesian inference on multilevel models of arbitrary structure. Given a generative model specified as a directed acyclic graph, our method automatically derives valid factorizations of the joint posterior and matching neural network architectures. The key steps, graph expansion and graph inversion, yield an inverse graph that determines how inference networks are stacked and conditioned, producing factorizations that amortize over the number of groups and the number of observations within each group. Unlike approaches that simplify the dependency structure to speed up learning or inference, our method preserves all conditional independence and exchangeability assumptions of the generative model. Across three case studies, it closely matches gold-standard samplers on models with more than 6,500 parameters while reducing inference to a near-instant forward pass once trained.

</details>


### [151] [Proximal Balancing for Causal Effect Estimation under Unmeasured Confounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40051)
*Yonghan Jung*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出"proximal balancing"，将协变量平衡思想扩展到只能通过代理变量观测的混杂因素上，学习一个低维代理摘要使处理组可比并进行调整，无需指定代理角色、求解逆问题或假设潜变量模型，给出识别理论、有限样本保证和实用算法PROBE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测数据中因果效应估计常因存在未测量混杂因素而不可识别。近端因果推断用混杂因素的代理变量来解决此问题，但现有方法要么需指定代理角色并求解病态的逆问题（在高维代理下难以估计），要么使用潜变量模型并假定学到的潜变量与隐藏混杂因素匹配（不匹配时会产生偏差）。

Method: 提出proximal balancing：将经典协变量平衡思想推广到只能通过代理观测的混杂因素。方法学习协变量与代理变量的一个低维摘要，使处理组之间可比，然后针对该摘要进行调整。它不需要指定代理角色、不需要求逆问题、也不需要潜变量模型。文中给出识别理论、有限样本保证以及实用算法PROBE。

Result: 在低维代理、高维代理和图像代理上以及真实世界数据上验证了所提方法。

Conclusion: proximal balancing为存在未测量混杂因素且仅有代理变量时的因果效应估计提供了一种无需代理角色假设、逆问题或潜变量模型的统一新框架，并具备理论保证与实际算法支持。

Abstract: Estimating causal effects from observational data is central to science and policy, but the effects are not identified when confounders are unmeasured. Proximal causal inference addresses this problem with proxies of the unmeasured confounders. However, existing proxy-based approaches either designate proxy roles and solve an inverse problem, which is ill-posed and hard to estimate with high-dimensional proxies, or use a latent-variable model, which assumes that the learned latent variable matches the hidden confounder and leaves bias when it does not. To address these challenges, we introduce proximal balancing. It carries the classical idea of covariate balancing to confounders that are observed only through proxies: it learns a low-dimensional summary of the covariates and proxies that makes the treatment groups comparable, and then adjusts for this summary. It needs no designated proxy roles, inverse problem, or latent model. We give identification theory, finite-sample guarantees, and a practical algorithm, PROBE. We demonstrate the method on low-dimensional, high-dimensional, and image proxies and on real-world data.

</details>


### [152] [Signal Processing over Product DAGs: Causal Shifts and Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40275)
*Sundeep Prabhakar Chepuri,Antonio G. Marques,Maulik Devmurari,Gonzalo Mateos*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种针对两个有向无环图(DAG)乘积上、由线性结构方程模型(SEM)描述的信号的信号处理框架，引入新的DAG乘积使传递闭包矩阵可分解，从而实现可分离性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当线性因果关系沿两个域(如组件-制造阶段、基因-实验条件)作用时会出现此类信号。若不利用底层图的因式分解和双轴因果结构，傅里叶分析需对大小为两因子尺寸乘积的加权传递闭包矩阵求逆，代价高昂。

Method: 认识到标准图乘积无法产生可因式分解的传递闭包，提出一种新的DAG乘积算子，使可分离性成立。在顶点域对该算子进行动机论证，并证明它使SEM、傅里叶模式、因果移位以及乘积DAG上的滤波器均可在各图因子上分离。

Result: 新DAG乘积下，传递闭包可因式分解，SEM、傅里叶模式、因果移位与滤波器均可跨图因子分离。

Conclusion: 所提框架利用双轴因果结构实现可分离性，避免了大规模传递闭包矩阵求逆，为乘积DAG上的因果信号处理提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We develop a signal processing framework for signals indexed by the product of two directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and described by a linear structural equation model (SEM). Such a setup arises whenever (linear) causal relations act along two domains, as in component versus manufacturing stage or gene versus experimental condition. Disregarding the factorization of the underlying graph and the native two-axis causal structure requires inverting a weighted transitive closure matrix whose size is the product of the two factor sizes for Fourier analysis. Recognizing that standard graph products fail to yield factorizable transitive closures, we introduce a new DAG product under which separability holds. We motivate the new operator in the vertex domain, and show that it also renders the SEM, the Fourier modes, the causal shifts, and the filters on the product DAG separable across its constituent graph factors.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [153] [Computing Scaled Relative Graphs of Discrete-Time LTI Systems: A Frequency-Domain Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38272)
*Guoming Shi,Fredy Ruiz*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文刻画了因果、稳定、平方离散时间LTI系统的尺度相对图(SRG)闭包，证明该闭包等于变换频率响应矩阵数值范围的凸包，并为SISO实系数系统给出离散Nyquist轨迹的双曲凸包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SRG能同时在复平面刻画输入-输出算子的增益与相位特性，但其闭包在离散时间LTI系统中的刻画尚不清晰，且单边输入带来的Hardy空间限制（排除持续正弦）使问题更复杂。

Method: 证明中用显式构造的有限时长正弦信号替代持续正弦，从而绕开Hardy空间限制；并说明频率逐点SRG中的点如何作为由可行输入生成的算子SRG点的极限。基于状态空间实现，通过频率响应求值、数值范围和平面凸包来计算闭包，避免求解线性矩阵不等式。

Result: SRG闭包的Beltrami–Klein像等于变换频率响应矩阵数值范围的凸包；对实系数SISO系统，得到离散Nyquist轨迹的双曲凸包；并给出不依赖LMI的模型化计算方法。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了离散时间LTI系统SRG闭包的完整频域几何刻画，并提供可由状态空间模型直接计算的方法，为增益-相位联合分析提供了新工具。

Abstract: The scaled relative graph (SRG) represents the joint gain and phase properties of an input--output operator in the complex plane. This paper characterizes the SRG closure of causal, stable, square discrete-time linear time-invariant (LTI) systems on one-sided square-summable sequences. The Beltrami--Klein image of this closure equals the convex hull of the numerical ranges of the transformed frequency-response matrices. For real-coefficient single-input single-output systems, this yields the hyperbolic convex hull of the discrete-time Nyquist locus. The proof addresses the Hardy-space restriction imposed by one-sided inputs, which excludes persistent sinusoids, by replacing them with explicitly constructed finite-duration sinusoids. This construction shows how points in frequency-wise SRGs arise as limits of operator SRG points generated by admissible inputs. The characterization enables model-based computation of the closure from a state-space realization using frequency-response evaluations, numerical ranges, and planar convex hulls, without solving linear matrix inequalities.

</details>


### [154] [Timing Sensitivity in Actuated Traffic Signal Control: A simulation study on one urban network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38280)
*Nitai Aharoni*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 通过240次仿真比较自适应与固定配时信号，发现结论高度依赖配时参数设定；两种配时扫描均倾向最短设置，说明需先检验配时敏感性再评判控制器类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应与固定配时信号孰优孰劣，可能因配时设定的改变而发生反转，因此需要考察这种敏感性，避免将性能差异错误归因于控制器类型。

Method: 在基于OpenStreetMap的城市路网上做240次仿真：8种配置、3种到达率、10组配对需求种子。变动基于存在检测的最大绿时长、重新调整固定基线配时，并加入基于排放的相位终止规则。评价指标为有限时窗内每完成行程的耗时，含入口等待及对移除或放弃行程的惩罚。

Result: 最高负载下，最大绿为计划分割两倍的感应控制比原始固定方案均值高57.4%；倍数降至1.25则低70.7%。相比三种固定方案中的最优者，基于排放的终止在三种负载下分别降低均值14.8%、15.8%、18.3%。两组配时扫描均偏好最短设置，因此都未找到最优值。

Conclusion: 该探索性研究使用合成需求、忽略启动损失时间并物理移除长期静止车辆。结果表明应在将性能归因于控制器类型前先检验配时敏感性，但不足以确定实际部署的配时设置。

Abstract: A comparison between adaptive and fixed-time traffic signals can change when only their timing settings change. We examine this sensitivity in 240 simulation runs on one OpenStreetMap-derived urban network, using eight configurations, three arrival rates and ten paired demand seeds. The experiment varies the maximum green of presence-based actuation, retimes the fixed baseline, and includes a discharge-based phase-termination rule. The endpoint is finite-window time spent per offered trip, including entry waiting and penalties for removed or abandoned trips. At the highest tested load, actuation with a maximum green of twice the planned split has a mean endpoint 57.4 per cent above the original fixed plan. Reducing that multiplier to 1.25 puts it 70.7 per cent below the same plan. Against the best of three tested fixed plans, discharge-based termination reduces the mean endpoint by 14.8, 15.8 and 18.3 per cent across the three loads. Both timing sweeps favour their shortest tested setting, so neither identifies an optimum. This exploratory study uses synthetic demand, negligible start-up lost time and physical removal of persistently stationary vehicles. The results support testing timing sensitivity before attributing performance to a controller family; they do not establish a setting for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [155] [Low-Rank and Lifted Semidefinite Programming for Mixed-Integer Polynomial Power Grid Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38435)
*Samuel Chevalier*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文通过混合低秩SDP与Lasserre矩松弛，验证局部求解器(Knitro)可返回非凸混合整数电网优化(AC-OTS)的全局最优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非凸混合整数多项式电网优化问题难以保证全局最优，全局分支定界方法可扩展性差，作者探索能否用局部求解器获得全局最优解。

Method: 迭代收紧AC-OTS问题的矩松弛(基于Lasserre层级，加入高阶矩约束)直至tight(原问题可行)，再用低秩SDP局部求解器Knitro重解，并将对偶变量代入界定Lagrange对偶函数。

Result: 原问题与对偶目标一致且原问题可行，从而确认解为精确全局最优解。

Conclusion: 提出假设：混合低秩(高可扩展性)SDP方法与矩松弛收紧，可能成为全局分支定界方法的可扩展替代方案。

Abstract: Can a local solver return the guaranteed globally optimal solution to a nonconvex mixed-integer polynomial power grid optimization problem? By mixing low-rank semidefinite programming (SDP) and moment-based lifting in the Lasserre hierarchy, this paper provides anecdotal evidence in the affirmative. Specifically, we iteratively tighten a moment-based relaxation of the AC Optimal Transmission Switching (AC-OTS) problem, including higher order moment-based constraints, rooted in the Lasserre hierarchy, until it is tight (i.e., primal feasible). We then re-solve this problem using a local, low-rank SDP solver (Knitro), plugging the associated dual variables into a bounding Lagrange dual function. By demonstrating primal and dual objective agreement and primal feasibility, we confirm the solution as the exact, global solution. From these initial results, we hypothesize that mixing (i) low-rank (i.e., highly scalable) SDP methods with (ii) moment-based relaxation tightening could be a scalable alternative to global branch-and-bound-based methods.

</details>


### [156] [Condition-Based Maintenance of Degrading Assets underIntermittent Accessibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38474)
*Muhammet Ceyhan Sahin,Murat Yildirim,Onur A. Kilic*

Main category: eess.SY
