TL;DR: 本文研究可达性随机变化下的设备维修决策，建立有限状态马尔可夫决策过程，证明最优策略阈值随可达性状态变化，并量化其成本优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多维修模型假设随时可维修，但现实中天气、海况等环境不确定性使维修机会间歇且动态变化，影响当前能否维修及等待未来机会的价值。

Method: 将问题建模为有限状态马尔可夫决策过程，在长期平均成本准则下分析最优维修策略结构；在退化与成本单调条件下刻画最优阈值；并用海上风电运维数值实验比较不同策略。

Result: 最优策略保持资产状态阈值形式，但阈值随可达性状态变化；数值实验中，相对优化的状态维修策略降低成本4.31%，相对优化的年龄维修策略降低成本33.95%。

Conclusion: 维修阈值并非通用，应随系统退化与可达性特征自适应调整；忽略这些条件会导致显著成本增加。

Abstract: Many maintenance models implicitly assume that maintenance can be performed whenever intervention is warranted. In practice, however, environmental uncertainty, such as weather and sea conditions, can make maintenance opportunities intermittent and dynamically evolving. We consider a degrading asset for which preventive maintenance may be performed before failure, but intervention is possible only when the asset is accessible. Accessibility evolves stochastically over time and therefore affects not only whether maintenance can be performed now, but also the value of waiting for future opportunities. We formulate this setting as a finite-state Markov decision process under a long-run average cost criterion and investigate the structure of the optimal maintenance policy. Under monotone degradation and cost conditions, we show that an optimal policy retains a threshold form in asset condition, but unlike a single threshold, the optimal threshold varies with the accessibility state. Thus, intervention depends jointly on the asset condition and the expected evolution of future maintenance opportunities. Through a numerical study motivated by offshore wind turbine maintenance, we examine how accessibility dynamics, degradation characteristics, and economic parameters shape the optimal thresholds and compare the optimal policy with constant-threshold and age-based maintenance policies. In a representative setting, adapting the condition threshold to accessibility reduces long-run average cost by 4.31% relative to an optimized condition-based maintenance policy. Relative to an optimized age-based policy, the optimal policy reduces long-run average cost by 33.95%. The results show that maintenance thresholds are not universal: they should adapt to the degradation and accessibility characteristics of the system, and failing to account for these conditions can lead to substantial cost increases.

</details>


### [157] [A Frequency Domain Approach to Bounding Riccati Equation Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38515)
*Rachel Newton,Laura Balzano,Peter Seiler*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种频域方法，用于显式界定离散LQR中DARE解在数据扰动下的差异，并采用频域稳定性常数及更弱的可检测性假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DARE用于求解离散时间系统LQR最优反馈增益，但LQR数据扰动如何影响DARE解需要明确界限；已有结果多依赖时域度量，本文希望给出频域新途径并放宽假设。

Method: 采用频域方法推导DARE解差异的显式上界；引入衡量闭环稳定程度的频域常数，并在LQR状态代价矩阵上从更弱的可检测性假设出发。

Result: 得到与近期文献类似但有所区分的DARE解扰动界：使用频域闭环稳定度常数而非时域度量，且检测性假设更弱。

Conclusion: 该频域途径可在更弱假设下给出DARE解的扰动界，为LQR数据扰动敏感性分析提供了不同视角。

Abstract: The discrete algebraic Riccati equation (DARE) is used to solve for the optimal feedback gain in linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) control of discrete-time systems. In this letter, we consider the effect of perturbations to the LQR data on the DARE solutions. We present a new frequency domain approach to derive an explicit bound on the difference in DARE solutions under such perturbations. Our bounds are similar to other results that have recently appeared in the literature with two distinctions. First, we use a frequency domain constant that measures the degree of closed-loop stability, in contrast to other results that use a time domain measure. Second, we start from weaker detectability assumptions on the LQR state cost matrix.

</details>


### [158] [Data-Driven Communication Topology and Distributed Controller Synthesis: Control-Aware and Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38522)
*Michael C. A. Nestor,Jiaxin Wang,Fei Teng*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究数据驱动的分布式控制通信拓扑设计，提出协同设计与控制感知两种方案，在链路成本与控制性能间权衡，并用MISDP求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式控制中通信拓扑须在执行前设计，而以往数据驱动方法通常将拓扑设计与控制器设计解耦，忽略了二者的相互依赖及通信成本与控制性能的权衡。

Method: 提出数据驱动的协同设计方法，直接对拓扑与控制器在链路代价和闭环控制代价上联合优化；当拓扑设计者无法获取智能体控制目标时，提出控制感知方法，以序贯框架耦合两个设计问题。两种情形下拓扑均在中混合整数半定规划（MISDP）中优化。

Result: 含IEEE 14节点电力系统测试的仿真验证了协同设计与控制感知两种方案的有效性，数值示例表明控制感知方案的计算时间低于协同设计。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的拓扑-控制器协同设计可保证稳定控制器存在并实现通信与性能权衡，控制感知序贯方案在缺乏控制目标信息时仍有效且计算更高效。

Abstract: In distributed control schemes, the communication topology that defines information sharing between agents must be designed prior to online control execution. Previous data-driven works typically decouple the topology and controller design problems. This paper investigates data-driven approaches to topology design that guarantee the existence of a stabilizing controller, whilst trading off the level of required communication against control performance. We formulate a data-driven co-design scheme that directly co-optimizes the topology and controller over the link costs and closed-loop control cost. When the topology designer does not have access to the agents' control objectives, we propose a control-aware approach that couples the two design problems within a sequential scheme. In both cases, the topology is optimized within a mixed-integer semidefinite program (MISDP). Simulations including the IEEE 14-bus power system test case demonstrate the effectiveness of both co-design and control-aware schemes. Numerical examples show lower computation time for the control-aware case than for co-design.

</details>


### [159] [Probability-Based Collision Risk Evaluation of Trajectories for Optimal Control Problems with Moving Obstacles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38534)
*Florian Steppich,Matthias Gerdts*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出用B样条曲面逼近占用分布并借助正则化保证光滑与可微，将其解释为泊松随机场强度函数，从而融合多占用分布用于自动驾驶轨迹规划，降低求解计算量达50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶在不确定环境中进行轨迹规划时常用占用分布做概率表示，但需要光滑、可微且能融合多分布并支持风险控制的方法。

Method: 采用B样条曲面结合正则化技术逼近占用分布，保证光滑性与可微性；将逼近结果视为泊松随机场强度函数，以融合多个占用分布并保持概率分布语义；面向最优控制问题提供梯度及高阶导数信息，并保留时空结构。

Result: 在含移动障碍物且不确定性时变的自动驾驶轨迹规划场景中验证可行；通过正则化调参，求解器计算量最多降低50%。

Conclusion: 该公式支持可控风险接受，超越保守的“无碰撞”策略，允许原本被排除的可行轨迹，同时提升求解效率。

Abstract: This paper presents a method for approximating occupancy distributions, a common probabilistic representation used in trajectory planning for autonomous vehicles operating in uncertain environments. The proposed method employs B-spline surfaces in conjunction with regularization techniques to ensure smoothness and differentiability. Interpreting the resulting approximation as an intensity function of a Poisson random field enables seamless integration of multiple occupancy distributions into a coherent risk representation, while retaining compatibility with the semantics of probability distributions.
  The method is tailored to optimal control problems (OCPs), where solvers benefit from gradient and higher-order derivative information. It also preserves information about the spatial and temporal structure of occupancy distributions, which is critical for handling dynamic obstacles. We demonstrate the feasibility of the approach in a trajectory planning scenario involving autonomous vehicles and moving obstacles with time-varying uncertainty.
  By enabling controlled risk acceptance, our formulation extends beyond conservative "no-collision" strategies and allows for admissible trajectories that would otherwise be ruled out. In our application scenario, we report a reduction in solver computational load of up to 50\% through proper tuning of the regularization.

</details>


### [160] [VHF Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces for Meteor Burst Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38602)
*Rajiv Thummala,Luke Flores,Gregory Falco*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将可重构智能表面(RIS)集成到流星余迹通信(MBC)网络的新型系统架构，以应对MBC通信窗口短暂、信噪比低和信道可用性不稳定等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MBC利用流星电离余迹反射VHF信号，可在无地面或卫星基础设施条件下实现超视距远程通信，在严苛和对抗环境中具有韧性。但其受限于通信窗口短暂、低信噪比和信道可用性不稳定，亟需改进。

Method: 提出将RIS集成到MBC网络的新系统架构，包含实时自适应控制、优化部署策略，并采用蒙特卡洛仿真优化RIS放置与运行参数。

Result: 通过蒙特卡洛仿真对RIS放置位置和运行参数进行优化（摘要未给出具体量化结果）。

Conclusion: RIS为MBC提供了一种变革性解决方案，通过可编程反射元件动态控制信号传播，有望提升MBC通信性能。

Abstract: Meteor Burst Communication (MBC) utilizes the transient ionized trails left by meteors to reflect Very High Frequency (VHF) signals, enabling long-range, beyond-line-of-sight communication without reliance on terrestrial or satellite infrastructure. Despite its resilience in austere and contested environments, MBC is limited by brief communication windows, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and inconsistent channel availability. Recent advancements in Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) offer a transformative solution by enabling dynamic control over signal propagation through programmable reflective elements. This paper proposes a novel system architecture that integrates RIS into MBC networks, incorporating real-time adaptive control, optimized deployment strategies, and Monte Carlo simulations to refine RIS placement and operational parameters.

</details>


### [161] [Forward-Invariant Policy Classes for Safe Reinforcement Learning in Multicopter Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38655)
*Chieh Tsai,Muhammad Junayed Hasan Zahed,Jinzhi Shen,Yi Xie,Ruoshan Lan,Majed Obaid,Salim Hariri,Hossein Rastgoftar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种通过前向不变性诱导动作空间设计的强化学习框架，将安全性直接嵌入策略类，实现四旋翼悬停的安全增益调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RL安全方法依赖运行时屏蔽或惩罚约束，需额外安全过滤。作者希望将安全性内嵌到策略类本身，让策略优化无需运行时安全干预。

Method: 构建共享同一Lyapunov证书的有限反馈控制器库，建立规定容许集在任意切换下的前向不变性。任何动作限制在该库内的策略（含探索阶段）自动继承该证书。以四旋翼悬停为例，用DQN在已认证控制器间调度。

Result: 非线性MuJoCo仿真展示了状态相关增益调度，并实证评估了对风扰、模型失配、传感器噪声和传感延迟的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过学习前向不变策略类，可将安全认证与策略优化分离。

Abstract: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for safe gain scheduling based on forwardinvariance-induced action-space design. Under stated nominalmodel and inversion-domain assumptions, rather than enforcing safety through runtime shielding or penalty-based constraints, safety is embedded directly into the policy class. Specifically, we construct a finite library of feedback controllers sharing a common Lyapunov certificate that establishes forward invariance of a prescribed admissible set under arbitrary switching. Consequently, any policy whose actions are restricted to this library, including policies encountered during RL exploration, inherits the same certificate. Policy optimization can therefore focus on closed-loop performance without runtime safety filtering or action projection. The framework is instantiated for quadcopter hover regulation, where a DQN schedules among certified feedback controllers. Nonlinear MuJoCo simulations demonstrate state-dependent gain scheduling and empirically evaluate robustness to wind, model mismatch, sensor noise, and sensing delay. The results illustrate how safety certification can be separated from policy optimization by learning over a forward-invariant policy class.

</details>


### [162] [On the NP-Hardness of Unconstrained Static Output Feedback Stabilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38728)
*Gal Barkai,Iman Shames*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文将子集和问题多项式时间归约到无约束静态输出反馈镇定问题，证明后者是NP难的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究静态输出反馈镇定问题的计算复杂度，特别是其NP难性。

Method: 利用两个标量构建模块实现近似离散选择与加权和约束；通过带通变换实现频率分离，将N+1个解耦环路的稳定性与被控对象耦合后的稳定性相关联，并比较真实特征多项式与各模块在右半平面不同区域的根数。

Result: 证明了无约束静态输出反馈镇定问题是NP难的，构建自然限制了所有镇定增益并给出显式模量裕度估计，保证被控对象数据具有多项式二进制编码长度。

Conclusion: 静态输出反馈镇定问题具有NP难复杂度。

Abstract: In this paper we give a polynomial-time reduction from the Subset Sum Problem to unconstrained static output feedback stabilization, establishing its NP-hardness. The construction uses two scalar building blocks to impose approximate discrete choices and a weighted-sum constraint. Once the problem is encoded, we relate the stability of the $N+1$ decoupled loops encoding the problem to that of a coupled plant. This is accomplished by leveraging frequency separation via a band-pass transformation, and comparing the root counts of the true characteristic polynomial with that of the different blocks in different regions of the right half-plane. The construction then naturally bounds every stabilizing gain and gives explicit modulus-margin estimates, ensuring that the plant data have polynomial binary encoding length.

</details>


### [163] [Extreme Learning Machine-based Barrier Function Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39221)
*Ahan Basu,Mahathi Anand,Pushpak Jagtap*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出用极限学习机(ELM)合成障碍证书，对离散时间未知系统进行形式化安全验证，通过最小化Lipschitz常数与网格采样实现高效验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络类障碍证书虽简化了复杂非线性系统的安全证书计算，但数据驱动特性和复杂网络结构导致计算时间长、对未见数据的鲁棒性保证不足。

Method: 采用极限学习机(ELM)合成障碍证书，利用其结构简单和优化问题凸性的特点提升收敛保证与计算效率；通过最小化候选障碍的Lipschitz常数，提出基于网格的采样技术，用最少样本量形式化验证证书有效性。

Result: 数值算例验证了方法的有效性，并与传统基于深度学习的证书合成方法对比，突出了本方法在收敛性和计算时间上的优势。

Conclusion: ELM-based障碍证书在保证形式化安全验证的同时，显著改善了收敛保证与计算效率，是深度学习证书合成的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Deep learning methods like neural networks have greatly simplified the computation of safety certificates for complex nonlinear systems with unknown dynamics. However, due to the data-driven nature of these certificates and the complex architecture of neural networks, computation time as well as robustness guarantees across unseen data remain a challenge. This work aims to formally verify safety properties of discrete-time unknown systems by synthesizing extreme learning machine (ELM)-based barrier certificates. Compared to neural network counterparts, this approach greatly improves convergence guarantees and computational time due to its architectural simplicity and the convex nature of the underlying optimization problem. By minimizing the Lipschitz constant of the candidate barrier, we present a grid-based sampling technique to formally verify its validity using the minimum number of samples required. We demonstrate through numerical examples the effectiveness of our approach, and compare with traditional deep-learning based certificate synthesis to highlight its benefits.

</details>


### [164] [Learning to Fix: Optimisation-Aware Machine Learning for Accelerated Unit Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39396)
*Benjamin Fritz,Andreas Makrides,Maryam Fetanat,Pierre Pinson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种优化感知框架，为每台发电机生成特定的置信度阈值，将概率预测转化为对机组组合混合整数搜索空间的可控缩减，平均最优性间隙低于0.5%且加速20倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机组组合是高计算量的混合整数线性优化问题，需在调度周期内做大量二进制投运决策。现有基于置信度的方法依赖用户设定的概率阈值来决定固定哪些变量，但这些阈值与下游优化问题无关，忽略了固定错误对最终解质量的影响。

Method: 提出优化感知框架，基于固定错误对机组组合解质量的影响，推导出针对每台发电机特定的置信度阈值，从而将机器学习预测的概率值映射为对混合整数搜索空间的可控缩减。

Result: 在2025年EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment竞赛中获得第一名；平均最优性间隙低于0.5%，平均加速超过20倍。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种通用机制，将概率预测转化为对混合整数搜索空间的可控缩减，直接把学习决策与下游的计算和经济影响相连接。

Abstract: Unit Commitment is a computationally demanding mixed-integer linear optimisation problem requiring many binary commitment decisions across a scheduling horizon. To reduce this computational burden, machine learning approaches can predict a subset of these decisions, thereby shrinking the search space explored by the optimisation solver. Existing confidence-based approaches determine which variables to fix based on user-defined probability thresholds, which are agnostic to the downstream optimisation problem. We address this limitation by introducing an optimisation-aware framework that yields generator-specific confidence thresholds based on the impact of fixing errors on Unit Commitment solution quality. This approach won first place in the 2025 EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition. The proposed framework achieves a mean optimality gap below 0.5% while also delivering an average speed-up of more than 20x. It therefore provides a general mechanism for translating probabilistic predictions into controlled reductions of mixed-integer search spaces, directly linking learning decisions to their downstream computational and economic consequences.

</details>


### [165] [Sharing the Gains of Aggregation: Cooperative Imbalance Cost Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39398)
*Asmus Winther Eriksen,Jalal Kazempour*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究"不平衡净额结算博弈"中如何将聚合带来的不平衡成本节约在异质消费者间公平分摊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源生产者与消费者通过中介（facilitator）签订固定价格合同，中介作为平衡责任方管理市场残余不平衡。聚合不完全相关的残余量可降低组合总不平衡成本，但如何在异质消费者间分配节约成为一个分配问题。

Method: 将问题建模为合作博弈（imbalance netting game），在两价格不平衡结算下比较六种分配机制，从计算需求、预算平衡、群体理性和可加性四个维度评估，并给出三个解析结果。

Result: 证明：边际成本贡献机制预算平衡的充要条件；边际成本贡献与VCG机制的群体理性；Gately点良定义的充要条件。基于丹麦2024年19个消费者数据，聚合使不平衡成本降低10%，但节约分配高度依赖分配规则。

Conclusion: 按消费比例的统一费率分配（社会化解耦定价基准）会使部分消费者支付超过其独立成本两倍，而所有研究的博弈论机制在实践中均产生稳定分配。

Abstract: A facilitator is an intermediary that offers renewable producers and consumers fixed-price contracts and, acting as their balance responsible party, manages the residual imbalances in the market. Pooling imperfectly correlated residuals nets consumers' imbalances and reduces the portfolio's total imbalance cost, but raises an allocation question: how should these savings be divided among heterogeneous consumers? We formulate this as a cooperative game, the imbalance netting game, and compare six allocation mechanisms under a two-price imbalance settlement in terms of computational requirements, budget balance, group rationality, and additivity. We establish three analytical results: a necessary and sufficient condition for budget balance of the marginal cost contribution mechanism, group rationality of the marginal cost contribution and Vickrey-Clarke-Groves mechanisms, and a necessary and sufficient condition for when the Gately point is well-defined. On Danish 2024 data for 19 consumers, aggregation reduces imbalance cost by 10%, but how these savings are shared depends strongly on the allocation rule. A flat-rate allocation proportional to consumption, used as a benchmark for socialized imbalance pricing, charges some consumers more than twice their standalone cost, whereas all the game-theoretic mechanisms studied produce stable allocations in practice.

</details>


### [166] [Circuit-Based Dispersion Analysis of Periodic Cross-Shaped Unit Cells with Dirac Characteristics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39610)
*Mahyar Mehri Pashaki,Mohammad Hossein Koohi Ghamsari,Mohammad Memarian*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文用等效电路建模研究周期十字形单元色散，特别是Dirac型色散，并通过全波仿真与S参数提取验证模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解周期十字形单元的Dirac型色散与模式简并、阻带行为机理，并寻求直观物理建模框架。

Method: 分析简单十字与带中心贴片两种单元，采用全波本征模仿真和基于散射参数的色散提取，并建立等效电路模型。

Result: 电路模型与全波仿真在Γ点附近色散吻合良好，能捕捉主要耦合机制，并揭示低Q辐射模式下S参数提取色散方法的局限。

Conclusion: 等效电路模型为分析十字形单元Dirac色散、阻带与模式简并提供直观有效工具，同时指出S参数提取在辐射模式存在时的限制。

Abstract: In this paper, the dispersion behavior of periodic cross-shaped unit cells is investigated with emphasis on Dirac-type dispersion using an equivalent circuit modeling approach. Two unit-cell geometries, including a simple cross structure and a modified configuration with a central patch, are analyzed using full-wave eigenmode simulations and scattering-parameter-based dispersion extraction. An equivalent circuit model is developed to capture the dominant coupling mechanisms and accurately reproduce the dispersion characteristics near the $Γ$-point. The results demonstrate that the proposed circuit model exhibits good agreement with full-wave simulations and provides a physically intuitive framework for analyzing stopband behavior and mode degeneracy. Furthermore, the limitations of S-parameter-based dispersion extraction in the presence of low-Q radiative modes are highlighted.

</details>


### [167] [STELLA: A 16nm Spatio-Temporal Elastic Low-Latency CGRA for Multi-Stage Pipelined Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39703)
*Jun Yin,Chao Fang,Ryan Antonio,Xiaoling Yi,Yunhao Deng,Fanchen Kong,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: STELLA 提出一种 16nm 时空弹性粗粒度可重构阵列 (CGRA)，针对 LayerNorm、GeLU、FFT 等非矩阵 ML 内核，实现低延迟、高能效计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴非矩阵 ML 内核（LayerNorm、GeLU、FFT、循环卷积）需要低延迟、高能效的空间加速器，而传统以 MatMul 为中心的阵列难以胜任。

Method: 采用时空弹性 16nm CGRA，具备快速配置路径、每 PE 硬件循环控制，以及低延迟、深度流水的弹性互连结构，实现时空数据复用。

Result: 在 850 MHz 下达到最高 110 GOPS/mm²，有效内核吞吐量相较基线 CGRA 提升 4.84–7.14 倍。

Conclusion: STELLA 证明弹性时空 CGRA 能有效加速非矩阵 ML 内核，显著提升吞吐与能效。

Abstract: Emerging non-matrix ML kernels, such as LayerNorm, GeLu, FFT or circular convolutions, demand low-latency, energy-efficient spatial accelerators beyond MatMul-centric arrays. STELLA presents a spatio-temporal elastic 16 nm coarse-grained reconfigurable array (CGRA) with a rapid configuration path, per-PE hardware loop control, and a low-latency, deeply pipelined elastic fabric with spatio-temporal data reuse. STELLA reaches up to 110 GOPS/mm2 at 850 MHz, and improves effective kernel throughput by 4.84-7.14x over baseline CGRAs.

</details>


### [168] [Transient Triggering Grid-Forming Synchronization Control Under Voltage and Frequency Dips](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39719)
*Dewan Mahnaaz Mahmud,Vinu Thomas,Bogdan Marinescu,Mickaël Hilairet*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种瞬态触发型构网型逆变器同步控制（TTGFM），通过虚拟制动机制增强电压和频率跌落下的同步稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构网型（GFM）逆变器过流能力有限，在大扰动（电压/频率跌落）下会被推入限流运行，导致内部角度加速并失去同步，亟需改进同步稳定性。

Method: 提出瞬态触发型同步控制（TTGFM），利用两个反馈信号：端电压，以及未饱和功率与饱和功率之差，来调节由功率同步环（PSL）生成的内部角度。这两个信号操纵内部参考角度生成，构成虚拟制动机制；无需额外监督信号或整定参数。通过解析框架推导失稳机理与稳定裕度临界值。

Result: 该机制可在电压和频率跌落期间限制角度加速。与两种先进同步增强方案对比，并通过MATLAB/Simulink中基于电网动态等效（GDE）模型的高保真电磁暂态（EMT）仿真验证；GDE模型的推广表明该控制不限于单一配置，适用于任何标准基准系统。

Conclusion: TTGFM控制能有效抑制限流运行期间的角度加速，提升同步稳定性，且无需额外参数整定、具有良好通用性。

Abstract: Grid-forming (GFM) inverters are gaining attention as a promising alternative for conventional synchronous generators in the modern power systems. Unlike conventional synchronous generators, GFM inverters have limited overcurrent capability that makes them vulnerable during large disturbances. During disturbances i.e., voltage and frequency dips, GFM inverters are pushed into current-limited operation to protect the semiconductor switches. This causes the internal angle of the GFM inverters to accelerate and lose synchronism with the rest of the grid. To address this limitation, this article proposes a transient triggering grid-forming (TTGFM) synchronization control to enhance the synchronization stability performance under voltage and frequency dips. This method uses two feedback signals; terminal voltage and the difference between unsaturated and saturated power to adjust the internal angle which is generated by power synchronization loop (PSL) of the GFM inverters. These two signals manipulates the internal reference angle generation that act as a virtual braking mechanism. This mechanism limits the angle acceleration during voltage and frequency dips without requiring an extra supervisory signal or parameters to tune. The proposed method is benchmarked against two state-of-the-art synchronization enhancement schemes and validated through high-fidelity electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations with a grid dynamic equivalent (GDE) model in MATLAB/Simulink\textsuperscript{\textregistered}. An analytical framework is developed to derive the synchronization instability mechanism and the critical limits of the stability margins. Generalization of the GDE model further shows that the TTGFM control is not restricted to a single configuration but is applicable to any standard benchmark system.

</details>


### [169] [Parameter-Robust Sensorless Control of IPMSM Drives With Adaptive Flux Observer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39840)
*Fobao Zhou,Zhenxiao Yin,Xueyan Wang,Yang Shen,Yuanfeng Qu,Hang Zhao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种参数鲁棒的无位置传感器IPMSM控制框架，将自适应磁链观测器从表贴式扩展至凸极机，通过对d轴磁链标量自适应补偿与q轴电压高频注入在线辨识q轴电感，实现不依赖精确电阻、d轴电感和永磁磁链的控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内嵌式永磁同步电机（IPMSM）无位置传感器控制常受参数敏感性影响，自适应磁链观测器原用于表贴式电机，难以直接适用于凸极机。

Method: 将参数失配等效为含d、q轴分量的磁链矢量：永磁磁链、d轴电感与电阻失配映射到d轴分量，q轴电感失配映射到q轴分量；设计标量自适应磁链更新跟踪等效磁链幅值以补偿d轴磁链变化；由于q轴分量旋转观测磁链方向、无法用标量自适应消除，引入高频q轴电压注入辨识q轴电感；并通过稳定性分析证明等效磁链幅值跟踪有界并识别导致位置误差的残余切向磁链。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提方法无需精确的电阻、d轴电感和磁链参数，q轴电感由在线辨识提供。

Conclusion: 该框架将自适应磁链观测器成功扩展至凸极IPMSM，实现参数鲁棒的无位置传感器控制，降低了对电机参数的依赖。

Abstract: To address parameter sensitivity commonly in interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) sensorless control, this paper proposes a parameter-robust control framework by extending the adaptive flux observer from surface-mounted PMSM to salient-pole machines. First, parameter mismatches are interpreted as an equivalent flux vector with $d$-axis and $q$-axis components. Permanent magnet flux, $d$-axis inductance, and resistance mismatches are mapped to the $d$-axis flux component, whereas $q$-axis inductance mismatch is mapped to the $q$-axis component. Then, a scalar adaptive flux update is designed to compensate the $d$-axis flux variation by tracking the equivalent flux magnitude. Since the $q$-axis component rotates the observed flux direction and cannot be eliminated by scalar adaptation, a high-frequency $q$-axis voltage injection method is introduced to identify the $q$-axis inductance. Meanwhile, stability analysis proves bounded equivalent flux magnitude tracking and identifies the residual tangential flux responsible for position error. Finally, experimental results show that the proposed method does not require precise resistance, $d$-axis inductance, or flux, while the $q$-axis inductance is provided by online identification.

</details>


### [170] [Flatness-based Neural Network Control of DC-DC Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39849)
*Kamakshi Tatkare,Ufuk Topcu,Brian Johnson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出结合模型轨迹生成与策略学习的小型神经网络框架来控制功率变换器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型控制方法未利用变换器动力学的解析结构，导致在过宽的策略类中搜索，效率低。

Method: 利用平均模型的微分平坦性生成可行的状态与受限占空比轨迹，构造状态到占空比的标注数据，训练多层感知机以静态映射逼近控制律。

Result: 在Buck、Boost、Buck-Boost变换器上，通过拓扑相关的平坦输出选择与统一学习流程，学习轨迹与模型轨迹高度吻合，并在大幅同步输入和负载扰动下实现稳定调节。

Conclusion: 该框架为功率变换器控制提供了一种简单有效的学习方案，兼顾模型解析结构与学习能力。

Abstract: In this work, we present a simple method to engineer a small neural network to control power converters. Learning-based methods have emerged as a promising approach for power converter control over wide operating point variations. However, many of these approaches do not exploit the analytical structure of converter dynamics and, therefore, search over unnecessarily broad policy classes. We address this gap with a systematic framework that combines model-based trajectory generation with policy learning. First, we use differential flatness of averaged converter models to generate feasible state and constrained duty cycle trajectories where duty acts as a control effort signal. Then for policy learning, we use these model-generated trajectories to construct labeled state-to-duty data and train a multilayer perceptron to approximate the control law with a static map. We apply this framework across buck, boost, and buck-boost converters through topology-dependent flat output selection and a common learning pipeline. Simulations show close agreement between learned and model-generated duty trajectories and stable regulation under large synchronous input and load disturbances.

</details>


### [171] [Concept and Rationale for Stratospheric Balloon-Based Laser Debris Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39850)
*F. Ruiz Vincueria,M. Divoky,E. Sanchez-Laulhe,H. Yang,J. Rodrıguez,V. Montero,V. Canales,E. Alcalde,A. Zavoli,M. Rico,J. Klare,A. Ollero*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于平流层气球的激光碎片清除概念，作为地基与天基方案之间的折中路线，聚焦于概念设计与原理阐述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分米级轨道碎片足以引发灾难性碰撞，却因经济性差难以通过现有主动清除（ADR）手段捕获；激光去轨被视为潜在方案，但地基系统受大气吸收、散射与湍流限制，天基系统则面临高成本、复杂的轨道基础设施与部署维护难题。

Method: 提出平流层气球平台概念：在99%大气质量以上运行，可能实现地基被臭氧吸收所禁止的紫外（3HG/4HG）激光操作，改善传输与烧蚀耦合效率。工作以概念设计和原理论证为主，描述主要架构要素、预期运行包络，并与现有地基/天基方案进行定位对比。

Result: 本文非成熟系统，未给出实验或定量结果；主要输出为架构要素说明、运行包络讨论，以及对相对优势、关键挑战和局限性的识别。所提概念为工程约束不同于轨道系统的中间路线。

Conclusion: 平流层气球激光去轨概念在传输效率和紫外激光可用性上具备潜在优势，同时面临自身工程约束；相关概念在STRATOLASER（EIC Pathfinder Challenge项目）框架下开发，目标通过平流层气球实验达到TRL 4。

Abstract: Laser-based deorbiting has long been proposed as a promising technique for mitigating the growing population of orbital debris, particularly decimetre-scale objects -- large enough to cause catastrophic collisions yet too small to be economically captured by current active debris removal (ADR) missions. However, the practical implementation of laser-based approaches remains constrained by several factors. Ground-based systems suffer from atmospheric absorption, scattering, and turbulence, which degrade beam quality and limit effective energy delivery. Space-based platforms benefit from superior propagation efficiency, enabling more compact and lower-power systems, but require complex, high-cost orbital infrastructure with demanding deployment, maintenance, and scalability challenges. This paper proposes a stratospheric balloon-based concept for laser debris removal, exploring the intermediate regime between ground-based and space-based approaches. Operating above 99% of the atmospheric mass, such a platform may enable ultraviolet (3HG/4HG) laser operation -- largely precluded from ground level by ozone absorption -- with improved propagation and ablation coupling efficiency, while presenting a different set of engineering constraints than orbital systems. Rather than a fully developed system, this work focuses on the conceptual design and underlying rationale. We describe the main architectural elements, discuss the expected operational envelope, and position the concept against existing ground- and space-based solutions, identifying potential advantages as well as key challenges and limitations requiring further investigation. Developed within STRATOLASER, an EIC Pathfinder Challenge project targeting TRL 4 through stratospheric balloon experiments.

</details>


### [172] [Exact Noise Limits for Bounded Scalar Stabilization Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39895)
*Alexey Peregudin,Ngoc Tuan Dinh*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究标量离散时间有界输入系统在未知过程噪声下，何时仍能依据实验数据确证植物可镇定，并给出各类镇定要求的精确噪声上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际控制器设计中实验数据含未知噪声，需要知道"实验能容忍多大噪声"这一根本稳健性边界，区分不同镇定语义的可行性。

Method: 针对标量离散时间、有界输入、精确状态测量、噪声能量预算与实验长度成正比的设定，分别刻画：(1)每个一致模型的个体可镇定；(2)单一公共增益镇定；(3)公共二次证书；对每个漂移量求精确噪声上限，并用有界周期输入逼近上限。

Result: (2)与(3)重合；个体可镇定容忍的噪声一般更多。有界周期输入可逼近上限，但对抗性扰动阻止其达到。对不稳定植物，短实验可在长实验均失败的高噪声水平上确立个体可镇定；同一障碍给出实特征值多维系统的上界。

Conclusion: 结果给出基于数据认证的未知植物设计的根本稳健性基准；certification 仅用记录数据与噪声界，输入设计可用植物知识。

Abstract: How much unknown process noise can a bounded experiment tolerate while still establishing that the plant can be stabilized? We answer this question for scalar discrete-time systems with bounded inputs, exact state measurements, and a disturbance-energy budget proportional to the experiment length. We distinguish individual stabilizability of every consistent model, stabilization by one common gain, and a common quadratic certificate. We determine their exact noise ceilings for every drift. The last two requirements coincide; individual stabilizability generally tolerates more noise. Bounded periodic inputs approach the ceilings, while adversarial disturbances prevent their attainment. We also determine the long-horizon limits. For unstable plants, a short experiment can establish individual stabilizability at noise levels where every sufficiently long experiment fails. The same obstruction yields upper bounds for multidimensional systems with real eigenvalues. Input design may use plant knowledge, but certification uses only the recorded data and noise bound. The results therefore provide fundamental robustness benchmarks for unknown-plant designs.

</details>


### [173] [Globally Certified Invariant-Ellipsoid Control from Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39937)
*Ngoc Tuan Dinh,Egor Dogadin,Alexey Peregudin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数据的状态反馈设计方法，用于有界扰动下的离散时间线性系统，通过优化Lyapunov椭球不变量，实现对输出围包的最小化，并给出有限步内达到近似最优稳定增益的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在有界扰动下，直接基于数据设计状态反馈控制缺乏对输出围包（output enclosure）的优化与有限收敛保证，且通常假设已有稳定增益或达到下确界。本文试图去除这些假设，提供可计算且带保证的设计方法。

Method: 对每个容许反馈增益和标量设计参数，用Lyapunov方程确定一个状态不可离开的不变椭球。通过优化增益与参数来最小化基于迹的输出围包度量。对每个参数值，用值迭代给出成本下界，用独立的控制器评估给出可达上界，并借此评估整个参数区间而无需逐点求解。

Result: 证明搜索在有限次评估后停止，得到一个稳定状态反馈增益，其目标值在所给椭球族的下确界的任意指定绝对容差内。不假定初始稳定增益，也不假定下确界可达。保证基于精确算术和足够丰富的精确测量（含采集数据期间的扰动）。用位置-速度例子说明界限、控制器检验与计算成本。

Conclusion: 该方法为有界扰动下基于数据的离散线性系统状态反馈设计提供了有限收敛的近似最优保证，所得反馈仅使用状态，并通过数值例子展示了其有效性与计算表现。

Abstract: This letter develops a data-based method for designing state feedback for a discrete-time linear system under bounded disturbances. For each admissible feedback gain and scalar design parameter, a Lyapunov equation determines an invariant ellipsoid: a region that the state cannot leave under the permitted disturbances. We optimise the gain and parameter to minimise a trace-based measure of the resulting output enclosure. At each parameter value, value iteration gives a lower cost bound, while separate controller evaluation gives an achievable upper bound. These bounds also let us assess whole parameter intervals without evaluating every point. We prove that the search stops after finitely many evaluations with a stabilising state-feedback gain whose objective is within any prescribed absolute tolerance of the infimum over the chosen ellipsoid family. Neither an initially stabilising gain nor attainment of the infimum is assumed. The guarantee assumes exact arithmetic and a sufficiently informative batch of exact measurements, including disturbances during data collection; the resulting feedback uses only the state. A position--velocity example illustrates the bounds, controller checks, and computational cost.

</details>


### [174] [On the Input Sensitivity of METANET Models and the Robustness of Dynamic Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39968)
*Cameron Hickert,Shreyaa Raghavan,Cathy Wu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文从字符串稳定性角度解释METANET宏观交通模型对输入扰动的严重敏感性，并提出动态时变参数校准方法以提升鲁棒性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宏观交通仿真（如METANET）的交通建模与控制依赖有效校准，但实证研究显示模型对输入噪声极为敏感，这种敏感性可能损害其反事实分析能力（如大规模可变限速设计）。

Method: 通过字符串稳定性分析解释扰动沿走廊被放大的机理，并提出动态、时变的模型参数校准方法；在给定正则性与扰动假设下，解析证明动态校准比静态校准具有更紧的代价偏差界。

Result: 分析表明校准后的METANET会放大边界条件的小扰动导致状态偏离基线；动态校准在高速公路环境的合成与真实数据上验证了更好的鲁棒性与精度。

Conclusion: 动态校准可提升宏观仿真的可信度，支持更有效的控制策略评估，如大规模可变限速设计。

Abstract: While traffic modeling and control rely upon effective calibration of macroscopic traffic simulation models like METANET, recent empirical work shows these models can exhibit severe sensitivity to input noise. This paper explains this phenomenon through a string-stability analysis, demonstrating that a calibrated METANET model can amplify small additive perturbations to boundary conditions along the corridor, causing the simulated state to diverge from the nominal baseline. The input sensitivity in off-nominal cases may compromise the model's capabilities for counterfactual analysis, which is required for use cases of interest like the design of large-scale variable speed limits. To address these issues, this work demonstrates how a dynamic, time-varying approach to calibrate model parameters can achieve robustness and improved accuracy of the resulting macrosimulation. We show analytically that under stated regularity and perturbation assumptions, dynamic calibration achieves a tighter cost deviation bound than static calibration, and we validate this behavior in highway environments with synthetic and real-world data. Ultimately, this can enable more trustworthy traffic simulation and more effective evaluation of control strategies.

</details>


### [175] [Duration-Aware Ramp Adequacy Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40013)
*Qian Zhang,Aidan Looney,Chao Tian,Xu Andy Sun,Le Xie*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"时长感知"的爬坡充裕性筛选方法，评估已承诺机组能否在不同持续时间内满足预期净负荷爬坡需求，并据此设计滚动窗口爬坡备用采购与免预测的稀缺调度策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域电力市场广泛使用爬坡产品来获取跨时段灵活性，但产品设计常缺乏对爬坡持续时间（duration）的明确刻画，可能导致调度解不可行。因此需要一个能跨不同持续时间评估爬坡充裕性的框架，用以指导产品时长选择、评价不同产品与调度政策，并及早发现爬坡稀缺。

Method: 1) 构建时长感知的爬坡充裕性筛选方法，输出"爬坡充裕性裕度"，负值界定出能力不足的持续时间集合；2) 将裕度在持续时间维度上评估以支持产品时长选择，在时间维度上追踪以评估不同产品与调度政策下的充裕性；3) 建立含滚动窗口、预测不确定性随horizon变化的爬坡备用采购模型；4) 基于该框架提出免预测的爬坡备用稀缺调度政策，按剩余爬坡持续时间对资源排序。

Result: 产品可通过改变调度位置影响超出其设定时长的爬坡能力；所提免预测调度政策在无输电约束场景下，达到与完全预见（perfect-foresight）基准相同的最小运行安全损失。在10机系统和2751节点合成德州电网上的算例验证了框架在爬坡稀缺早期检测、产品设计与评估、以及筛选引导的应急调度方面的价值。

Conclusion: 持续时间感知的爬坡充裕性筛选框架能有效弥补现有爬坡产品设计中时长刻画不足的问题，为产品时长选择、政策评价、稀缺检测与应急调度提供统一工具，并在无约束情形下实现接近最优（基准等价）的运行安全性。

Abstract: Ramp products are widely used in regional electricity markets to procure intertemporal flexibility in anticipation of net demand changes. However, the design of such ramp products often lacks a clear specification of ramping duration, potentially leading to infeasible dispatch solutions. This paper develops a duration-aware ramp adequacy screening method that evaluates whether the currently committed and dispatched fleet can meet the anticipated net-demand ramp requirement across different durations. A negative ramp adequacy margin identifies an insufficient-duration set in which the fleet lacks adequate ramp capability. Evaluating this margin across duration supports product-duration selection, while tracking it over time provides a metric for assessing ramp adequacy under different products and dispatch policies. We further formulate rolling-window ramp-reserve procurement with horizon-dependent forecast uncertainty and show that a product can affect ramp capability beyond its designated duration through changes in dispatch positioning. Building on this framework, we develop a forecast-free ramp-reserve scarcity dispatch policy that prioritizes resources according to their remaining ramp-up durations and, in the transmission-unconstrained setting, achieves the same minimum operational security loss as a perfect-foresight benchmark. Studies on a 10-generator system and a 2751-bus synthetic Texas grid demonstrate the value of the proposed framework for early detection of ramp scarcity, product design and evaluation, and screening-guided emergency dispatch.

</details>


### [176] [Learning Higher Order DC-DC Converter Control from Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40056)
*Kamakshi Tatkare,Ufuk Topcu,Brian Johnson*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出一种基于神经网络的控制器，通过学习模型驱动有界逆框架生成的监督轨迹来控制高阶非线性变换器，在Cuk、SEPIC和Zeta变换器上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高阶变换器具有非线性动力学，控制设计困难：非线性控制模型复杂度高，线性控制抗扰能力差。目标是开发简单且兼具两者优点的神经网络控制器。

Method: 首先证明变换器模型的强可逆性；通过轨迹模型规定期望闭环行为以定义目标动力学；数值反演变换器动力学以获得占空比和状态轨迹；将这些模型驱动轨迹作为监督，训练神经网络逼近状态到占空比的控制律。

Result: 学习到的控制器能准确复现基于逆的控制作用，并在负载和输入电压扰动下实现有效调节。在四阶Cuk、SEPIC和Zeta变换器上验证了方法。

Conclusion: 神经网络控制器可有效学习基于逆的控制律，为高阶非线性变换器提供了一种简单且抗扰良好的控制方案。

Abstract: Control design for high-order converters with nonlinear dynamics is generally difficult. Nonlinear controls introduce formidable model complexity whereas linear controls suffer from poor disturbance rejection. Our objective in this paper is to develop a simple neural-network-based controller that learns the control law from supervised trajectories generated by a model-based bounded inversion framework. First, we establish strong invertibility for the converter models. Next, we prescribe the desired closed-loop behavior through a trajectory model that defines the target dynamics. We then invert the converter dynamics numerically to obtain the corresponding duty-cycle and state trajectories. We use these model-based trajectories as supervision and train a neural network to approximate the resulting state-to-duty control law. The results show that the learned controllers accurately recover the inversion-based control action and achieve effective regulation under load and input-voltage disturbances. We validate the method on fourth order Cuk, SEPIC, and zeta converters.

</details>


### [177] [Assessing Modeling Fidelity for Long-Term Battery Energy Storage Planning: Operation, Degradation, and Temporal Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40092)
*Hassan Zahid Butt,Xingpeng Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文评估长期电池储能系统（BESS）生命周期规划中所需建模保真度，通过对20年并网微电网进行顺序生命周期验证，比较不同降级、运行与时间表示的简化影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期BESS规划常依赖简化的退化、运行和时间表示以保持计算可行性，但这些简化对生命周期结论的影响尚不清楚。

Method: 用退化朴素规划模型对20年并网微电网进行容量配置，固定装机组合后进行顺序生命周期验证；参考表示包含非线性日历与循环老化、C率相关效率、健康状态相关性能、自放电、电池更换及完整8760小时时序；比较电池模型层级、定向消融、线性退化替代、健康更新间隔、时间缩减及组合简化。

Result: 参考案例在第9和18年更换电池，生命周期净现成本1.1125亿美元，累计未供能量24.01 MWh。忽略日历老化会消除两次更换并将成本低估35.1%；单独校准的线性替代模型可复现更换年份且成本偏差仅0.2%，但未供能量比参考低31.8%；峰值信息校准的12天表示保留更换时间但报告零未供能量；用最大日能量赤字日替代保留峰值日会因代表日闭合改变关键事件周围的电池状态而大幅高估未供能量。

Conclusion: 建模保真度具有指标依赖性，应根据需要保留的生命周期结果来选择相应的简化程度。

Abstract: Long-term battery energy storage system (BESS) planning often relies on simplified degradation, operational, and temporal representations to maintain computational tractability, yet their effects on lifecycle conclusions are not well understood. This paper assesses the modeling fidelity needed for long-term lifecycle evaluation of BESS designs used in planning studies. A 20-year grid-connected microgrid is sized using a degradation-naive planning model, after which the installed portfolio is fixed and evaluated through sequential lifecycle validation. The reference representation combines nonlinear calendar and cycle aging, C-rate-dependent efficiencies, state-of-health-dependent performance, self-discharge, battery replacement, and full 8,760-h chronology. Battery-model hierarchies, targeted ablations, linear degradation surrogates, health-update intervals, temporal reductions, and combined simplifications are compared using lifecycle cost, replacement timing, state of health, and energy adequacy. The reference case produces replacements in years 9 and 18, a $111.25 million lifecycle net present cost, and 24.01 MWh of cumulative energy not served. Omitting calendar aging eliminates both replacements and understates lifecycle cost by 35.1%, whereas a separately calibrated linear surrogate model reproduces both replacement years and limits the cost deviation to 0.2%, although energy not served remains 31.8% below the reference. A peak-informed calibrated 12-day representation preserves replacement timing but reports zero energy not served, while replacing the preserved peak day with the maximum daily-energy-deficit day substantially overstates energy not served because representative-day closure alters the battery state surrounding the critical event. The results show that modeling fidelity is metric-dependent and should be selected according to the lifecycle outcome to be preserved.

</details>


### [178] [A Modular State-Machine Based Event PID Controller](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40152)
*Sandesh Thapa,Zhen Qi*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化PID控制器，其计算和模式逻辑由上层状态机执行，在保证控制性能的同时显著降低计算频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向实时安全关键应用，计算负载、执行器抖动、传感误差与噪声是设计挑战。

Method: 将标准PID封装进含三个状态（pidInit、ErrorOutRange、ErrorInRange）的有限状态机，形成模块化、低计算复杂度的控制器，易嵌入硬件并与上层状态机集成。

Result: 在已发表的事件驱动PID基准的两个测试平台上仿真，计算控制更新次数远少于时间触发PID及两种主流事件驱动控制器，同时保持相当的控制性能；并给出实时流量控制的实验结果。

Conclusion: 该模块化状态机PID可用于实时安全关键场景，降低计算负载与执行器抖动，适合嵌入式部署。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a modular proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller whose computation and mode logic are executed by a higher-level state machine. Inspired by real-time safety-critical applications where computational load, actuator chattering, sensing error and noise are design challenges, the proposed algorithm wraps a standard PID inside a finite state machine with three states (pidInit, ErrorOutRange, ErrorInRange). The goal is to regulate a desired reference within a safe region of operation while reducing actuator chattering and creating a sizable hold band over the range of operation. This design is modular and can be easily integrated into a higher-level state machine with multiple low-level loops and states. The algorithm also has low computational complexity and is suitable for embedded hardware deployment. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the algorithm in simulation on the two test benches of a published event-based PID benchmark. The algorithm computes the control updates significantly less often than the time-triggered PID and less often than both dominant event-driven controllers, while keeping a fairly equivalent control performance profile. Furthermore, we also present some experimental results of the designed algorithm for a real-time flow control.

</details>


### [179] [Skill-Based AI Agents for Power-System Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40272)
*Pavel Etingov,Shuchismita Biswas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出基于MCP连接工程工具的技能型智能体框架，用于电力系统研究，两条实现路径成功完成仿真任务并大幅加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输电规划研究中电力系统动态仿真流程复杂，工程师需大量精力用于工具操作与结果提取，而非专家判断。

Method: 开发自定义MCP服务器，暴露Siemens PTI PSSE的潮流分析、动态仿真、结果提取与模型验证功能；构建两条实现路径，分别基于OpenAI Agents SDK与Claude Code CLI，均使用可复用技能、子智能体、MCP工具、数据仓库连接及本地shell/Python执行。

Result: 两种基于前沿模型的实现均成功执行代表性研究任务；依据公共数据集，从任务完成度、输出准确性和人工干预需求评估，智能体系统能大幅加速输电规划中的动态仿真流程。

Conclusion: 智能体系统有望承担常规仿真设置与结果提取，推动输电规划实践转变，让工程师专注于场景设计与结果解读等专家判断环节。

Abstract: This paper describes a skill-based agentic framework for power-system studies using Model Context Protocol (MCP)-connected engineering tools. A custom MCP server was developed to expose Siemens PTI PSSE functions for power-flow analysis, dynamic simulation, result extraction, and model-validation workflows. Two implementation pathways built on a programmable OpenAI Agents software development kit (SDK) and a Claude Code command-line interface (CLI) were evaluated, both using reusable skills, subagents, MCP tools, data-repository connections, and local shell/Python execution. Both frontier-model-based implementations successfully executed representative study tasks. Success was evaluated based on task completion, output accuracy, and the need for human expert interventions. Results based on public datasets show that agentic systems can greatly accelerate power system dynamic simulation process for transmission planning studies leveraging industry-grade simulation platforms. This points toward a shift in transmission planning practice, where agentic systems could handle routine simulation setup and result extraction, allowing engineers to focus expert judgment on scenario design and interpretation rather than tool operation.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [180] [Optimal Allocation and Volume under Surface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38875)
*Kai Feng,Han Hong,Jessie Li,Wenshi Wei*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个估计与推断投影临界函数集体积的框架，重点研究ROC曲面下的凸体（VUS），采用Aumann期望表示与Minkowski混合体积方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究多维或多分类场景下ROC曲面下体积（VUS）的估计与推断问题，并推广到误差集分析与不平等度量。

Method: 先用Aumann期望表示，再应用Minkowski混合体积计算体积；证明总体VUS与对称U统计量核的期望成正比，并提出双重/去偏机器学习（DML）估计量，推导其渐近性质并构建推断程序。

Result: 建立了VUS与对称U统计量核期望的比例关系，给出了DML估计量的渐近性质与推断方法；框架还适用于预定义群组的可行误差集分析和Gini系数的自然推广。

Conclusion: 该框架为投影临界函数集体积提供了统一的估计与推断工具，VUS为其核心应用，并可拓展至组间误差分析与不平等度量。

Abstract: This paper develops a framework for estimation and inference on the volumes of sets that are projections of critical function sets, focusing particularly on the convex body beneath the optimal receiver operating characteristic (ROC) surface. Specifically, we propose a volume calculation method that first uses an Aumann expectation representation and then applies Minkowski mixed volumes. Using this framework, we show that the population volume under the ROC surface (VUS) is proportional to the expectation of a symmetric U-statistic kernel. We then propose a double/debiased machine learning estimator of the VUS, derive its asymptotic properties, and develop an inference procedure. Further applications of this framework include an analysis of the feasible error set across pre-defined groups and a natural generalization of the Gini coefficient for measuring inequality.

</details>


### [181] [Partial identification with entropy regularized optimal transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40156)
*Bruno N. Costa,Florian F. Gunsilius*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 该论文将统计中通过线性规划界定参数集（部分识别）的问题统一表述为路径空间上的最优传输问题，引入熵正则使其可用 Sinkhorn 迭代高效求解，并给出收敛性、估计一致性速率与渐近分布的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多统计场景中，数据与假设不足以唯一识别模型参数，只能确定包含真实参数的集合（部分识别）。这类集合通常由在可行模型上优化的线性规划刻画，但其优化变量与约束数可能是无限维的，难以刻画和求解。

Method: 把这类优化问题统一表述为路径空间上的最优传输问题；再加入熵惩罚，将其转化为多边际熵正则最优传输问题，从而可用 Sinkhorn 迭代高效求解。

Result: 证明了正则化值收敛到最紧界（sharpest bound），推导了 plug-in 估计量的一致性速率，并给出了近似界的渐近分布；通过模拟验证了统计与计算性质，并在需求估计中给出应用。

Conclusion: 该方法具有通用性，适用于连续变量工具变量模型、异质需求模型中的福利估计等多种设定，为部分识别下的界估计提供了统一且可计算的理论框架。

Abstract: In many statistical settings, the available data and maintained assumptions do not suffice to uniquely identify the model parameters of interest. In such cases, one can only identify sets which are guaranteed to contain the true parameters. These are often characterized through linear programs that optimize over models compatible with the observed data. These programs can be infinite-dimensional in the optimizer and the number of constraints. We provide a unified way to characterize and solve such optimization problems by phrasing them as optimal transport problems on path spaces. This allows us to regularize the problem with an entropy penalty, recasting it as a multi-marginal entropic optimal transport problem, which can be solved efficiently via Sinkhorn iterations. In addition, it allows us to establish convergence of the regularized value to the sharpest bound, derive consistency rates for a plug-in estimator, and obtain asymptotic distribution for approximate bounds. The method is general and accommodates settings ranging from instrumental variable models with continuous variables to welfare estimation in heterogeneous demand models. We verify the statistical and computational properties in simulations and provide an application to demand estimation.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [182] [Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38282)
*Baode Wang,Zuming Huang,Kexuan Ren,Jun Huang,Wei Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GAD-RL 自适应调节教师蒸馏监督强度，用于视觉语言模型的 OCR 后训练，抑制图像文本被改写的问题，在 CHAOS-Bench 与 OmniDocBench 上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM 可能将图像中的异常文本改写为通顺表达，损害 OCR 转录忠实度；固定教师的蒸馏指导在学生能力提升后效果逐渐减弱，需要自适应调节。

Method: 提出 GAD-RL，在联合后训练中根据学生任务表现与局部分布自适应调节教师监督：(1) 冻结教师以参考转录和学生生成前缀为条件；(2) 对含任务奖励≥0.95 输出的响应组禁用蒸馏；(3) 随组平均奖励升高持续衰减蒸馏强度；(4) 以前向 KL 按学生对教师 Top-1 token 的概率加权，支持度低时削弱局部辅助更新。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-2B 上，CHAOS-Bench 的 Micro Recall 达 59.92%，分别超过 GRPO 和 GRPO+OPD（固定权重）8.45 和 4.43 个百分点；OmniDocBench v1.6 的 Overall 得分 91.18。

Conclusion: 固定教师监督随学生进步而边际效益递减，GAD-RL 通过按任务表现和局部分布自适应调节蒸馏，有效提升 OCR 转录忠实度与整体性能。

Abstract: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. GAD-RL disables distillation for response groups containing an output with task reward at least 0.95 and continuously attenuates distillation strength as group-mean reward increases. It also weights forward KL by the student's probability of the teacher's Top-1 token, moderating local auxiliary updates when student support for that candidate is low. On Qwen3.5-2B, GAD-RL achieves 59.92% Micro Recall on CHAOS-Bench, surpassing GRPO and GRPO+OPD (fixed-weight) by 8.45 and 4.43 percentage points, respectively, while achieving an Overall score of 91.18 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

</details>


### [183] [AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38288)
*Hongjin Qian,Chaofan Li,Kun Luo,Wenqing Wei,Jianlyu Chen,Shuqi Lu,Yuyang Hu,Hongwang Xiao,Hui Wang,Chaozhuo Li,Qiwei Ye,Zhicheng Dou,Defu Lian,Zheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AREX-2 通过从可验证的机器学习与算法编程任务中合成长时程迭代改进轨迹，训练出具备自我改进能力的 LLM 智能体，在多个推理与深度研究基准上取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升 LLM 智能体在测试时迭代优化解的能力（自我改进），其依赖反思与长时程执行两种能力，作者假设二者与领域无关，故可在适合监督的场景中学习。

Method: 从机器学习与算法编程两类具有可验证反馈、能维持持续迭代的任务中合成长时程改进轨迹，并基于 Qwen3-27B 训练智能体。

Result: MLE-bench Lite 达 81.8，Frontier-CS 达 70.7；迁移至深度研究任务：BrowseComp 84.0、HLE 52.6、GAIA 92.2、DeepSearchQA 93.8，且随迭代轮数预算增加持续改进。

Conclusion: 长时程反思型数据是通向自我改进智能体的有效途径。

Abstract: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. Trained on this data, our agent, built on Qwen3.8-27B, achieves strong results on MLE-bench Lite (81.8) and Frontier-CS (70.7), transfers to deep research with 84.0 on BrowseComp, 52.6 on HLE, 92.2 on GAIA, and 93.8 on DeepSearchQA, and keeps improving as its budget of rounds grows. These results show that long-horizon reflective data is an effective route toward self-improving agents.

</details>


### [184] [MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38294)
*Yining Lu,Aurelie Lozano,Xi Yang,Naoki Abe,Yu Deng,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MoFlow，将智能体工作流生成建模为多目标MDP，用凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索一次性覆盖帕累托前沿，支持任意偏好查询而无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作流生成方法只优化准确率或加权多目标之和，一次训练只固定一种权衡，偏好变化需从头重训，效率低。

Method: 将工作流生成形式化为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，采用Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search与乐观集合值回传，每个节点存储可达权衡集合而非单一加权分数，单次搜索近似覆盖帕累托前沿。

Result: 在数学、代码、问答等六个基准上对比六个强基线。由于基线为单标量优化器需针对每个测试偏好重跑，而MoFlow不接触这些偏好，即使在此不利设置下MoFlow仍取得最高平均超体积。

Conclusion: MoFlow用一次搜索覆盖多偏好工作流生成，避免重训练，并在严格公平性偏向下优于基线，验证了多目标搜索范式的有效性。

Abstract: We study the generation of agentic workflows that jointly optimize multiple objectives, such as accuracy, cost, latency, robustness, and consistency. Existing methods for workflow generation typically optimize accuracy alone or a weighted sum of objectives, so each trained generator commits to one fixed trade-off and must be retrained from scratch when preferences change. To alleviate this, we propose MoFlow, which generates workflows optimized across varied preferences. Specifically, MoFlow formulates workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process and solves it by leveraging Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups, where every node stores a set of reachable trade-offs rather than one weighted score. A single search thus approximately covers the Pareto front, from which MoFlow can return a workflow for any preference by lookup without retraining. We evaluate MoFlow against six strong baselines on six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, and question answering. Since the baselines are single-scalar optimizers by design, an apples-to-apples comparison is difficult. We instead adopt an evaluation setup that favors the baselines, in that they are rerun for each testing preference, which MoFlow never sees. Even under this stringent setup, MoFlow achieves the highest average hypervolume.

</details>


### [185] [AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38296)
*Ozgur Can Seckin,Shalmoli Ghosh,Alessandro Flammini,Kristina Lerman,Maria Elizabeth Grabe,Filippo Menczer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究模拟两个LLM对话，发现AI智能体易被激进化，且"共振"（强化既有信念）比"说服"（推广新信念）效果更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能影响人的信念，但它们是否能、以及如何相互操纵，尚不清楚。作者想探究AI智能体之间的信念操纵与激进化风险。

Method: 让两个智能体对话：一个扮演基于人口与心理属性的人设目标LLM，另一个作为影响者LLM试图使目标信念更极端。考察两条路径：共振（强化既有信念）与说服（推广目标原本不重视的信念）；并用不同影响策略（如谄媚、未经验证的主张）进行测试。

Result: 在情感与行为指标上，两种机制都能激化目标；但共振效果始终强于说服。不同策略产生不同程度激化，但跨指标不一致。共振还会传播到相关信念，表明AI智能体内部存在相互关联的信念结构。

Conclusion: AI智能体易被激进化，尤其当信息与其既有信念一致时，这对个性化AI智能体和多智能体生态系统的脆弱性提出了警示。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

</details>


### [186] [CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38340)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Zixiang Ni,Zhenzhu Li,Bin Chong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CARAT框架评估材料LLM是否真正基于结构推理，而非复制输入中已打印的答案，通过八种匹配视图与多种对照实验揭示准确率的误导性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料LLM回答晶体结构问题时，准确率无法区分模型是"推理"还是"抄袭输入中的答案字段"，因为结构描述往往直接印有被评分的字段。

Method: CARAT固定问题与金标准答案，跨八种匹配视图；在GraphSpace中单独命名每个结构关系；加入匹配微调、答案掩码、证据注入、成对推理及可拒绝作答规则；并自攻基准以消除捷径。

Result: grounded视图比公式输入高17.3分；GraphSpace比普通周期图高19.3分，但拆解后仅1.96分来自呈现方式，46.7分来自基线缺失字段；捷径规则可答对7个硬化家族中的4个，重构后11种捷径接近随机；冻结模型95.6%成对案例中重复关系却不使用，匹配监督后达99.8%，删除链接降至23.4%（低于最佳捷径27.0%）。

Conclusion: 表面准确率主要反映基线缺陷而非证据呈现方式；关系使用能力可通过监督学习获得，且CARAT能有效诊断和消除捷径。

Abstract: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

</details>


### [187] [Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38346)
*Bakhtawar Ahtisham,Kirk Vanacore,Alessandra Napoli,Josh Arens,Ksenia Ionova,Clayton Cohn,Shima Salehi,Rene Kizilcec*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析1130余次真实LLM辅导会话中的拦路虎（impasse）时刻，发现随着拦路虎持续，学生恢复几率下降，且"提问"策略效果随深度衰减，而"直接回应错误"更有效，为学习分析提供实时触发分层辅助的依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅导存在"帮助困境"：过早帮助阻碍有效挣扎，过晚帮助导致学生陷入持续僵局（wheel spinning）。生成式AI辅导者常用护栏限制直接给答案，但对其在拦路虎持续后的行为缺乏了解。

Method: 分析1260次真实LLM化学辅导会话中的20462个学生回合，识别出6630个拦路虎回合（三类：概念错误、表达不确定、求助）。用这些拦路虎模拟三种辅导条件（基线、禁止直接回答、引导式辅导），对150个拦路虎样本对比响应策略，并分析真实交互中的拦路虎轨迹。

Result: 提示特异性改变教学法：基线辅导50.7%直接给答案，禁答辅导每次都追问，引导辅导依情境多样回应。每多一个拦路虎回合，下一回合恢复几率降12.7%（AOR=0.873, p<.001）；早期退出者陷入递归概念引导。提问收益随深度衰减（脚本问题×深度AOR=0.78；追问×深度AOR=0.83），而回应错误收益上升（AOR=1.14）；脚本问题失败后重复它恢复率28.1%，改为回应错误则39.8%。

Conclusion: 拦路虎的深度与类型是可观测的回合级对话信号，学习分析可据此实时触发分层、随状态变化的辅助。

Abstract: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

</details>


### [188] [Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38359)
*Sumit Asthana,Michael Ion,Kevyn Collins Thompson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用GFlowNets生成多样化高质量合成对话数据，通过高斯混合密度建模潜在会话结构，在辅导与情感支持领域优于RL和LLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量合成数据对LLM后训练很关键，需要覆盖多样化的专家策略。但直接提示LLM或基于终端场景条件生成会导致数据多样性低、塌缩到主导模式。

Method: 使用Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) 生成潜在对话结构，对关键交互特征（如困惑片段动态、脚手架指令平衡）采用高斯混合密度建模，从而按训练数据中策略的流行度比例采样专家策略。

Result: 在两个结构不同的领域（辅导对话与情感支持对话）中，该方法在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性平衡上优于强化学习及端到端LLM基线，且不复制训练数据。在下游三个结果预测任务上，用其合成数据训练的模型提供更强训练信号。

Conclusion: 基于GFlowNet的合成数据生成能有效产生多样化高质量对话数据，覆盖专家策略分布，为下游任务提供更优训练信号。

Abstract: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

</details>


### [189] [Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38369)
*Yunus E. Zeytuncu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以广义Blaschke曲线作为可控环境，开展AI辅助数学再发现的单例案例研究：代理从80个边界配置的数值坐标出发，拟合出齐次三次式并预测480条直线，报告RMS残差8.88e-17，但承认存在局限，未证明相对多项式拟合的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索AI辅助数学再发现的可控实验环境，并区分猜想、数值验证与证明三个环节。作者希望用带明确局限的协议，检视代理能否从数据中"再发现"目标定理。

Method: 固定一个四次Blaschke乘积，向代理提供80个边界配置对应的六条配对直线的数值坐标；目标定理对代理保密。记录研究日志（含被拒的几何猜想、拟合到多边形边的齐次三次式）。冻结系数后预测80个未见参数对应的480条直线，并做尺度无关RMS残差评估；用发现集对角线做拟合外一致性检查（非完全留出测试）；另做单配置运行检验不变性；再加事后确定性次数搜索基线。

Result: 冻结系数对480条未见直线的尺度无关RMS残差为8.88e-17；单配置运行报告不变性证据不足；事后确定性次数搜索基线也能恢复该三次式，因此实验未显示出相对多项式拟合的优势。

Conclusion: 该单例案例可作为分离猜想、数值验证与证明的协议，但存在关于代理元数据、先验知识与可复现性的明确局限，且未证明AI方法的优越性。

Abstract: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

</details>


### [190] [Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38372)
*Qiankai Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出递归自我改进式harness自进化框架：同一冻结模型既当求解者又当提议者，跨五域多基准进化harness，两阶段（多任务预训练+持续训练）显著提升分布内外性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化harness多由独立提议器（依赖人工设计harness）修改求解者harness，且每个基准单独进化一套harness；而真实任务跨多领域，进化与评估都应覆盖多样化任务。

Method: 同一冻结模型在同一harness版本上先作求解者解题，再作提议者读取完整运行记录并直接编辑运行它的harness（接近递归自我改进）。每批进化任务取自五个不同域基准；严格分离训练与留出任务，另在五个进化中未见过的OOD基准上评估。将进化视为两阶段深度学习训练：多任务预训练与持续训练。种子harness仅49行。

Result: 第一阶段后，ID基准平均分提升4.48分，OOD基准提升12.64分，前者超越Codex、后者与Codex持平。第二阶段在Claw-Eval（OOD之一）持续进化，该基准分数由66.17升至68.06，超过Codex。并分析了进化中涌现的机制：输出截断、历史压缩、独立审查。

Conclusion: 跨域、同模型自提议的harness自进化可行且泛化良好，能超过或匹配Codex，并通过两阶段训练与持续进化进一步增益；涌现机制揭示了harness自动优化的有效设计。

Abstract: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark. Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. Each evolution batch draws tasks from five benchmarks in different domains. To measure generalization, training and held-out tasks are strictly separated, and we additionally evaluate on five out-of-distribution benchmarks never used during evolution. We frame the evolution process as deep-learning training with two stages, multi-task pretraining and continual training. Starting from a 49-line seed harness, the harness obtained at the end of the first stage improves the average score by 4.48 points on the in-distribution benchmarks and by 12.64 points on the out-of-distribution benchmarks, surpassing Codex on the former and matching it on the latter. In the second stage, continued evolution on Claw-Eval, one of the out-of-distribution benchmarks, further raises the score on that benchmark from 66.17 to 68.06, exceeding Codex. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms that emerged during evolution, including output truncation, history compaction, and independent review.

</details>


### [191] [Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38379)
*Yavuz Bakman,Duygu Nur Yaldiz,Baris Askin,Swastik Roy,Morteza Ziyadi,Salman Avestimehr,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"上下文混淆"现象：对齐训练在某一语境会让模型在其他语境产生不对齐行为，并给出跨域证据、缓解方法与机制解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐本质是语境依赖的：同一建议在某一场景对齐，在另一场景可能不当。仅靠过滤训练样本难以预判模型更新后的对齐状态，因此需研究跨语境的行为迁移问题。

Method: 在三领域（性别平等、隐私、身体安全）系统演示该现象；对比"通用对齐数据"与"针对性对齐数据"、以及推理时in-context示例的效果；并从表征层面分析不同领域查询在微调中的相似表征漂移与行为特征激活。

Result: 证实上下文混淆存在，属"狭义不对齐"（区别于涌现式不对齐）；注入通用对齐数据无法有效缓解，但加入目标领域对齐数据或推理时提供示例可显著缓解；机制上不同域查询经历相似表征偏移，导致同一行为特征被跨语境触发。

Conclusion: 仅凭训练数据难以预测训练后的对齐状态，需重视并开展全面的后训练对齐评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3) Physical Safety. We further show that context confusion causes narrow misalignment, in contrast to emergent misalignment, and is not effectively reduced by injecting general alignment data, but can be substantially reduced by including targeted alignment data for the misaligned domain or providing in-context learning examples during inference. Lastly, we provide a mechanistic explanation of *context confusion*. We observe that queries from different domains can undergo similar representational shifts during the fine-tuning. Consequently, a query from a different domain may activate the same behavioral feature learned during fine-tuning, which causes the behavior to transfer to a context where it is misaligned. Based on our findings, we argue that it is difficult to predict the alignment state of a model after training by inspecting the training data alone, which highlights the importance of comprehensive post-training alignment evaluations.

</details>


### [192] [Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38385)
*Loay Mualem,Lluís Pastor-Pérez,Vinh Tong,Andrei Manolache,Tanja Bien,Steffen Staab,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GoldiMask，用次模目标优化离散扩散语言模型SFT中的掩码模式（上下文选择+目标加权），在多个骨干和数据集上取得最优平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调依赖掩码模式，但均匀随机掩码未显式考虑“揭示哪些token作为上下文”与“预测哪些token”之间的相互作用。

Method: GoldiMask通过近似最大化次模目标来选择作为上下文的揭示token，利用模型信号平衡“揭示收益”与“作为预测目标的价值”；再根据剩余目标从选定上下文中获益的程度及剩余学习潜力对其进行加权。

Result: 在3个骨干和3个训练数据集上，多数设置取得最高平均准确率，在推理和代码生成上均有提升；消融显示上下文选择与目标加权均有贡献；GSM8K和MATH-500上减少了解码迭代次数，高置信阈值下保持可比准确率。

Conclusion: 显式优化掩码模式能同时提升训练效果与推理效率，验证了上下文选择与目标加权的互补价值。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

</details>


### [193] [Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38386)
*Gaurav Agarwal,Ashish Garg,Isha Singhal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DLFP是一种模型无关的预填充控制器，利用解码延迟反馈动态调整重叠预填充块大小，在vLLM+Qwen3-0.6B上降低P99 ITL约27.7%，但无法泛化到更大模型与张量并行配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发自回归推理存在根本性干扰：新到达的长prompt预填充会延迟正在解码请求的token生成。固定预填充块虽能缓解干扰，但最佳块大小依赖模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标，静态方案难以适配。

Method: 提出Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP)，一种无模型控制器，仅调整与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作。在每个受保护的调度周期后，用观测到的间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一个预填充块大小；孤立预填充不受限制。在vLLM中实现，用开放环Poisson到达、精确token计量、原始请求trace和NVIDIA遥测评估。

Result: 在单张A100 80GB上Qwen3-0.6B BF16，三次配对100请求实验将P99 inter-token延迟降低24.8%、30.1%、28.2%（均值27.7%，95%置信区间21.0%-34.3%），输出完全一致、无失败、SLO合规不变。代价是平均P99 TTFT增加34.8%（仍在SLO内）。但机制无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B及双GPU张量并行配置；失败源于异步调度器调用间隔仅是完成GPU迭代时间的代理量。

Conclusion: 该负结果界定了贡献边界，并推动面向并发CPU与端侧推理的完成时间驱动控制器。作者不声称移动设备性能，本文为可复现的概念验证与泛化研究。

Abstract: Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

</details>


### [194] [MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38392)
*Jinyi Ye,Yuangang Li,Chenxiao Yu,Preyashi Poddar,Priyanka Dey,Longtian Ye,Zihan Wang,Xiyang Hu,Emilio Ferrara,Yue Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MetaPersona-DB数据集（含11,000+项实证人类被试研究）与MetaPersona框架，通过检索任务相关证据、构建文献推导的人格依赖图并从实证先验中采样合成人群，以解决LLM社会模拟中人格设定的冷启动问题。在三个下游案例、三个基线和三个前沿模型上，效果因任务与模型而异，且每个任务构建成本降至0.5美元以下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM社会模拟中用于初始化的人格面临冷启动问题：现有方法缺乏原则性依据来决定纳入哪些属性及如何赋值，导致合成人群可能错误反映人口构成、潜在属性及依赖结构，从而影响下游行为。

Method: 构建MetaPersona-DB数据集，对11,000+项实证人类被试研究标注任务相关变量、报告关系和总体层面的人口统计。基于此提出MetaPersona框架：检索任务相关证据，构建文献推导的人格依赖图，并从连接人口统计、潜在属性与结果的实证先验中采样合成人群。同时提供MetaPersona-Studio交互式原型界面。

Result: 在三个下游案例研究、三个基线和三个前沿模型上，结果因任务和模型而异：MetaPersona在错误信息信念和AI工具情感任务上表现强劲，在收入再分配任务上结果参差；使用GPT-5.2可将每个任务的人格构建成本降至0.5美元以下。

Conclusion: MetaPersona通过实证文献驱动的数据与框架，为LLM社会模拟中的人格生成提供了有原则、低成本且可交互的方案，但效果受任务与模型影响，仍有改进空间。

Abstract: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

</details>


### [195] [SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38397)
*Yunan Lu,Shuang Xie,Meghna Allamudi,Mingyu Zhao,Han Li,Lingyun Wang,Zhou Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SimTrace框架，通过基于真实用户轨迹和网页环境的computer-use智能体，生成忠实、细粒度、多模态的合成点击流数据，以替代受隐私限制的专有日志，并在电商场景验证其保真度与下游效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟客户端（用于A/B测试、推荐系统开发、界面评估等）需要大规模、语义忠实、细粒度的在线用户轨迹，但专有日志受隐私限制、小企业流量不足。现有公开数据集要么抽象掉细粒度交互细节，要么虽有丰富上下文但平台特定且规模小。

Method: SimTrace对真实交互进行匿名化，并为给定网页环境构建模拟孪生（simulated twin），再基于两者用computer-use客户端智能体生成合成交互轨迹。每个动作都配对其对应的网页观测和用户上下文，形成可共享的数据替代品。

Result: 在电商场景中，SimTrace在8项保真度指标中的7项优于竞争基线；用合成数据训练的模型在购买预测、推荐等下游任务上与真实数据训练的性能相当；在下一动作预测中，真实数据+合成数据相比仅用真实数据准确率相对提升11.0%。

Conclusion: SimTrace可生成可共享的、忠实的合成点击流数据，适用于开发computer-use智能体式虚拟客户端，并已开源以促进在线用户行为建模研究。

Abstract: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation.
