### [337] [Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38424)
*Fred Xu,Thomas Markovich,Florence Regol,Yizhou Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EB-GAD是一个无需训练的节点级图异常检测框架，将正常性建模为图感知的广义OU弛豫，通过经验贝叶斯拟合图精度并将评分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GAD模型通过架构、消息传递或重构/对比目标间接编码正常性与异常评分，将图信任、图谱加权和评分选择纠缠在一起，导致评分昂贵、不透明且在不同图状态下不稳定。

Method: 提出无需训练的EB-GAD：将正常性建模为向图滤波模板的GOU弛豫；用经验贝叶斯从残差场似然拟合图精度；将评分转为闭式有限时域控制能量（将特征中性节点沿图谱弛豫引导至其观测端点的最小努力）。通过扫描弛豫时域和端点容差生成共享同一拟合先验的评分库，均衡Mahalanobis评分是其中一个极限；再用无标签选择器基于特征同质性、边密度和特征维度选择评分族，并按拟合零偏差和排名稳定性对候选排序。

Result: 在11个基准上且全程不使用标签，EB-GAD在9个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳AUROC，包括四个金融欺诈网络（最大370万节点）、YelpChi、Amazon、Weibo、Reddit和Facebook，领先幅度最高达21.7个百分点；在BlogCatalog和ACM上排名第二。

Conclusion: EB-GAD通过统一正常性建模与闭式控制能量评分，实现了无需标签、稳定且高效的图异常检测，在多种图状态和大规模网络上均表现优异。

Abstract: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-spectral relaxation. Sweeping relaxation horizon and endpoint tolerance yields a bank of scores that share one fitted prior: equilibrium Mahalanobis scoring is one limit, while finite-horizon control-energy and scale-normalized ratio scores reveal anomalies that static equilibrium scoring can mask. A label-free selector chooses the score family from feature homophily, edge density, and feature dimension, then ranks candidates by fitted-null deviation and rank stability. On 11 benchmarks and without labels at any step, EB-GAD has the best or tied-best AUROC on 9: the four financial fraud networks (up to 3.7M nodes), the YelpChi and Amazon review graphs, Weibo, Reddit and Facebook, with margins of up to 21.7 points. It is second on BlogCatalog and ACM.

</details>


### [338] [What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38446)
*Chiwun Yang,Xiaoyu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究预训练与midtraining如何提供信息与计算，使奖励适配有效。通过构造从随机初始化到奖励适配的有限采样Adam路径，证明预测机制如何获取执行/检索能力，奖励如何学习任务特定用途。实验表明源监督显著提升成功率，记忆回放保持检索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励只能标识正确答案，却无法确定新输入所需的计算过程。因此需要理解预训练和midtraining如何提供信息与计算，使奖励适配能够有效工作。

Method: 在顺序状态计算与上下文记忆中刻画机制：它们在所有训练奖励上一致，但要求不同的留出答案，任务无关的源观测可消除这一歧义。构造有限采样Adam路径，从指定随机初始化经源预测到同一参数中的奖励适配，证明预测如何获得执行或检索、奖励如何学习任务特定用途。用预训练Qwen2.5检查点进行八世界实验。

Result: 顺序模型在正确源与首操作监督下达到82.61%成功率，私有随机源对照为44.15%；记忆回放可在奖励适配中保持检索，独立八世界确认达75.32%，匹配替代检索训练为49.86%。GSM8K与HotpotQA在奖励进入时准确率、后续增益和最终性能上分离。

Conclusion: 结果将信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习连接起来：源观测提供任务相关信息以消除机制歧义，预训练获得执行或检索能力，奖励适配学习任务特定用法。

Abstract: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

</details>


### [339] [An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38447)
*Fernando Dupin da Cunha Mello,Prashant Kumar,Erick G. Sperandio Nascimento*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种节俭、可迁移、架构无关的深度学习框架，仅用常规天气数据加两个轻量静态输入预测作物产量，以巴西大豆为例，Transformer 精度最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的作物产量预报对市场稳定与风险管理很重要，但现有方法依赖昂贵或难以规模化的输入，亟需低成本、易迁移的方案。

Method: 以常规天气为唯一时变输入，另加作物年份与农业环境标签两个轻量静态输入；采用20季巴西大豆案例（2001/02–2020/21），留一年交叉验证，对比MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer、Mamba与岭回归及五年移动平均基线，并进行消融和SHAP分析。

Result: 所有深度学习模型优于岭回归，序列编码器均超过非序列MLP；Transformer全国精度最佳（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较农民基线误差降低47.6%；季内预报误差随发布时点单调下降，最新时点约降50%；农业环境标签与空间实例扩展有正贡献；SHAP显示作物年份主导长期趋势，季内天气与农业环境背景主导年际偏差。

Conclusion: 该框架易于部署到其他作物和地区，并可与业务化天气预报兼容，支持常规监测。

Abstract: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. All deep learning variants outperform ridge, and all sequential encoders surpass the non-sequential MLP. The Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg ha^-1; rRMSE 5.3%; R^2 = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to the farmer baseline. In-season forecasts improve monotonically from early- to late-season issuance, reaching approximately 50% lower error than the baseline at the latest forecast point. Ablations indicate that the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity. SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains most of the long-run trajectory, whereas within-season weather and agro-environmental context primarily drive interannual deviations, with moisture/cloud and thermal-demand variables dominating. Overall, the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and geographic regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts for routine monitoring.

</details>


### [340] [Grokking through the Lens of Minimum-Norm Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38453)
*Gil Kur,Ileana Rugina,Clémentine Carla Juliette Dominé,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立统计理论，刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何影响插值附近的泛化，解释 grokking 的延迟泛化现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 grokking 理论难以定量刻画延迟泛化如何依赖归纳偏置与信号结构。

Method: 在高维回归中研究稀疏促进正则化，证明强过参数无噪声下的零一律，并刻画特征维度与样本量成比例时沿 ℓ_r 正则化路径的训练与泛化误差。

Result: 构造凸范数族使插值器从全零预测器的平凡风险过渡到精确恢复且训练误差为0；泛化收益随范数更促进稀疏、目标更稀疏而增大，在无噪声与 ℓ_1 正则化时泛化出现急剧下降。对角线性网络与 modular arithmetic 上的 transformer 实验验证理论。

Conclusion: 除解释 grokking 外，还揭示最小范数插值的统计不稳定性：正则化强度的微小扰动可导致泛化性能剧变，同时保持较小训练误差。

Abstract: Grokking shows that fitting the training data and learning the underlying signal can occur at very different stages. However, existing theories offer limited quantitative insight into how this delayed generalization depends on inductive bias and signal structure. Our work addresses the gap by developing a statistical theory that characterizes how regularization geometry and signal sparsity govern generalization near interpolation. In particular, we focus on the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression and identify regimes in which sparsity-promoting regularization makes exact interpolation much more accurate than approximate fitting. In strongly overparameterized noiseless problems, we prove a zero--one generalization law and construct a family of convex norms whose interpolators transition from the trivial risk of the all-zero predictor to exact recovery, while keeping the training error equal to $0$. Furthermore, when feature dimension and sample size are proportional, we provide a precise characterization of training and generalization errors along $\ell_r$-regularization paths. This in turn allows us to quantify the generalization gain that remains near interpolation: we show that this gain increases as the norm becomes more sparsity-promoting and as the target becomes sparser, with a sharp drop in generalization reached for noiseless data and $\ell_1$ regularization. Experiments on diagonal linear networks and transformers trained on modular arithmetic demonstrate the generality of our theoretical predictions. Finally, beyond grokking, our work reveals a statistical instability in minimum-norm interpolation: small perturbations in the regularization strength can lead to drastically different generalization, while preserving small training error.

</details>


### [341] [Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38465)
*Shuyang Jiang,Fucheng Deng,Yuchuan Luo,Zhenyu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过可控测试平台GRIDUMM审计了多模态统一模型中"梯度冲突指标"作为诊断目标的合理性，发现方向性冲突指标与最终理解-生成权衡几乎无相关性，且抑制冲突并不改变权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型常以减少理解与生成目标间的梯度冲突为核心设计理念，但"降低冲突指标能改善下游理解-生成权衡"这一前提从未被直接检验。

Method: 构建GRIDUMM测试平台，镜像UMM训练的关键结构，同时使真实权衡可精确计算；在63种配置、372个检查点上测量冲突指标与最终权衡的Spearman相关性，并进行剂量-反应干预实验（单调抑制冲突）以区分相关与因果。

Result: 没有任何方向性冲突指标与最终权衡达到|Spearman|>0.3且置信区间不含零；剂量-反应干预使冲突单调下降但权衡保持平坦。范数比是生成失败的检测器，在生成已掌握的配置中失效；功能干扰度量优于方向性冲突指标，训练损失则与权衡强相关。

Conclusion: 这不表明冲突无用，而是说明其作为诊断目标的有效性必须被验证而非默认假设；作者将审计协议作为可复用标准发布。

Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

</details>


### [342] [RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38484)
*Xiaozhuang Song,Xuemin Chen,Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出RetroGEF，一种基于流的生成模型用于单步逆合成，通过在同一生成过程中添加原子和改变化学键，实现分子图连接性与图大小的同步变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆合成在现代药物发现和材料设计中至关重要。传统方法依赖固定大小的图画布，难以处理既改变连接性又改变图大小的分子图变换，且这些变换可能引入目标分子中不存在的反应物组分。因此需要一种能灵活处理图大小变化的生成式建模方法。

Method: RetroGEF是一种基于流的生成模型。以目标分子为起点，通过添加原子和修改化学键来构建可能的反应物，在同一生成过程中同时建模分子变换与图大小变化，而不依赖固定大小图。模型直接从产物—反应物对中学习，无需预定义的编辑顺序。

Result: 在代表性逆合成基准实验中，RetroGEF达到了state-of-the-art（当前最优）的性能。

Conclusion: RetroGEF通过流式生成框架统一建模分子变换与图大小变化，无需固定图画布和预设编辑顺序，验证了其在单步逆合成任务上的有效性与优越性。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [343] [Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38491)
*Joseph T Colonel,Daniel Katzman,Kelsey Kirker,Adam N Davidson,Shalaila S Haas,Cheryl Corcoran,René S Kahn,Guillermo Checci,Baihan Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究针对精神科临床对话录音中"指定说话人是否已被成功移除"的核验问题，提出并行对称的双流水线（验证医生语音已移除、验证患者语音已移除），先用音频脱敏再用音频-语言与大语言模型扫描残留，在48段二元录音上测试4个开放权重模型，OR集成达到F1=0.478。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神科临床研究日益依赖大规模语音数据以提取声学与语言学标记，但不断变化的知情同意与协议要求可能迫使研究者从多说话人录音中删除指定说话人，并需在大规模语料上核验删除是否彻底，而人工全量复核不可行。因此需要自动化的核验方法。

Method: 构建两条并行、对称的流水线：一条核验临床医生语音已从访谈录音中移除，另一条核验患者语音已移除。每条流水线先对目标角色的原始音频做脱敏（redact），再用音频-语言模型与大语言模型扫描剩余输出以找出漏删片段。在48段精神科二元录音上做仅推理评估，测试四个开放权重模型：Gemma-4-12B、Gemma-4-31B、Nemotron-3-Nano、Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni，并在十四个"模型-视图"配置上使用析取OR集成。

Result: 十四个模型-视图配置的OR集成取得综合F1=0.478（精确率0.330，召回率0.870），优于各单模型估计，提升主要来自召回增益，表明不同模型与上下文视图之间存在显著互补性。

Conclusion: 自动化的说话人移除核验在精神科双向对话中可行，多模型-多视图的OR集成能有效提高漏删检测的召回率；但精确率偏低，未来需在减少误报的同时保持高召回。

Abstract: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. We evaluate this approach on a corpus of 48 dyadic recordings drawn from psychiatry settings, testing four open-weight models in an inference-only setting: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Nemotron-3-Nano, and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni. A disjunctive OR ensemble over fourteen model-view configurations had a combined F1 of 0.478 (precision 0.330, recall 0.870), an improvement over individual model estimates driven by recall gains that point to substantial complementarity across models and context views.

</details>


### [344] [ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38521)
*Jonathan Mei,Sang Hyub Kim,Oliver Knitter,Chi Chen,Martin Roetteler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShamAN-Q是一种亚1比特训练后量化方法，通过用稠密曲率度量替代NanoQuant的对角重构几何，在更低比特下显著降低困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NanoQuant使用对角重构几何可能无法充分捕捉权重的曲率信息，限制了亚1比特量化的性能。

Method: 扩展NanoQuant，采用Shampoo优化器范式，对每个线性权重用KL最小化将Kronecker积拟合到经验Fisher信息矩阵，形成Mahalanobis重构损失；ADMM更新转为Sylvester方程解，量化投影与部署格式不变；逐层在分解前重测输入曲率并周期性刷新统计；在相同总比特预算下跨层重新分配均匀秩。

Result: 在Qwen3-Base上约1 bpw时，WikiText-2困惑度从27.56降至22.96（0.6B）、19.21降至16.72（1.7B）、14.29降至13.80（4B），零样本准确率持平或提升；0.6B模型约0.8 bpw达到NanoQuant约1.0 bpw的困惑度。

Conclusion: ShamAN-Q以稠密曲率度量改进了亚1比特量化，在保持部署格式的同时提升了精度并降低了比特需求。

Abstract: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

</details>


### [345] [Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38506)
*Umer Gupta,Saku Peltonen,Martin Ritzert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion，用流匹配 + SO(2) 等变 GNN 迭代扩展树状结构，在神经元和植物树生成上贴近真实分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树状分支结构（植物、神经元、血管等）的形态反映功能，建模其结构有助于理解系统机制；真实 3D 数据获取昂贵，现有形态学专用模型限制拓扑生成或依赖手工机制流程，通用 3D 图生成器又未利用树的固有结构。

Method: 提出自回归前沿扩展框架，通过迭代扩展模拟真实树的生物生长：每步用由 SO(2) 等变 GNN 参数化的流匹配模型，预测每个活跃分支是分叉还是终止，从而扩展前沿。

Result: 在皮层神经元和植物树上进行无条件、类别条件与形态引导生成实验，生成形态与参考分布高度吻合，条件实验中也与指定目标一致。

Conclusion: 该框架统一处理跨领域的树状结构生成，兼具生物学合理性与生成准确性，为树形态建模提供了通用且结构感知的生成方案。

Abstract: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

</details>


### [346] [Learning Continuous Neural Representation of Stochastic Hybrid Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38893)
*Sangli Teng,Hang Liu,Koushil Sreenath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将随机混合系统(SHS)近似为高维隐空间中的连续SDE，通过辅助变量编码重置分支实现拓扑粘合，从而消除HFP方程中的显式重置项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SHS由连续SDE与守卫面上的马尔可夫重置核共同支配，其概率演化对应含偏微分项和积分项的混合Fokker-Planck方程。重置导致的轨迹不连续给概率演化建模与学习带来困难，亟需一种无需事件模拟的连续化描述。

Method: 用辅助变量编码重置核的不同分支，将随机重置转化为确定性重置以实现拓扑粘合；借助嵌入定理将粘合流形嵌入高维欧氏空间，得到样本路径连续的高维隐SDE。基于该定理设计匹配演化状态分布的损失函数。

Result: 嵌入像上的概率演化不再需要HFP方程中的显式重置项；单个隐SDE即可恢复SHS的概率演化，且无需模式标注、轨迹分割或基于事件的模拟。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了SHS与高维连续SDE之间的近似等价，为混合系统的概率演化学习提供了无需事件模拟的实用框架。

Abstract: A stochastic hybrid system (SHS) is governed by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) describing the continuous dynamics and a Markov reset kernel triggered on the guard surface. Its probability evolution can be described by a hybrid Fokker-Planck (HFP) equation with a partial differential term corresponding to the SDE and an integral term arising from the reset kernel. This work shows that such an SHS can be approximated by an SDE in a higher-dimensional latent space where the sample paths are continuous. The key to this result is to encode different branches of the reset kernel using auxiliary variables, transforming the resets into deterministic ones that enable topological gluing. By the embedding theorem, the glued manifold can then be embedded into a higher-dimensional Euclidean space. We show that the probability evolution on the embedded image no longer requires explicit reset terms in the HFP equation. Building on this theorem, we design a loss that matches the evolving state distributions, enabling a single latent SDE to recover the probability evolution of the SHS without mode labeling, trajectory segmentation, or event-based simulations.

</details>


### [347] [Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38547)
*Eduardo Fernandes Montesuma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BaryFM，用流匹配学习整个Wasserstein单纯形上的重心家族，一次训练即可采样任意权重下的重心。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Wasserstein重心方法多针对固定权重向量，对整个单纯形上重心族（Wasserstein simplex）的近似研究不足，即"Universal Barycenter Approximation"问题未被充分探索。

Method: BaryFM基于flow matching，将边缘测度输运到Wasserstein单纯形中的任意重心；训练后通过求解常微分方程即可从任意重心测度采样。

Result: 在4个下游任务（域适应、泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合、算法公平性）上验证。在10个域适应基准上，BaryFM在15种对比方法中取得最佳平均排名，匹配或超越非通用求解器。

Conclusion: BaryFM能有效实现通用重心近似，以单一模型覆盖整个Wasserstein单纯形，性能优于或媲美专用固定权重求解器。

Abstract: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

</details>


### [348] [Does Text Steer Neural PDE Surrogates? A Controlled Diagnostic with OperatorCLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38517)
*Aadi Dash,Lennon J. Shikhman,Michael Galarnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以OperatorCLIP为例，指出文本条件神经代理模型误差更低并不能证明模型真的使用了文本语义，强调需要路径控制实验来排除混淆因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本条件神经代理（如算子学习模型）常以更低误差被解读为"利用了文本语义"，但更低误差可能仅来自条件信号的额外容量或正则化，而非对文本含义的真正理解。作者希望检验这种"归因谬误"。

Method: 提出OperatorCLIP，对比三种设置：无条件FNO、常量句子FiLM控制、以及用对比对齐训练的固定任务描述。在Darcy2D、ShallowWater2D、CNS3D上做三随机种子实验，并施加提示干预（prompt intervention）考察语义排序。文本编码器从头训练，每个条件模型只见到单一描述。

Result: 常量条件在两个2D任务上平均测试误差更低。相对该控制，任务文本+对齐在ShallowWater2D和CNS3D上均值相近，在Darcy2D上更高；这些比较有较大的种子不确定性。由于后者同时改变提示内容和损失，无法分离任一效应。成对InfoNCE在只有单一配对时无法识别匹配对，其最小值为log B；提示干预未显示可靠的语义排序。

Conclusion: 这是一项方法论警示：证明文本条件下的更低误差并不等于证明模型使用了文本语义，必须引入路径控制实验。本文既未确立编码器的语义能力，也未验证文本在不同物理语境下的有效性。

Abstract: Lower error from a text-conditioned neural surrogate does not, by itself, show that the model uses the meaning of the text. We examine this attribution problem with OperatorCLIP, comparing an unconditioned FNO, a constant-sentence FiLM control, and a fixed task description trained with contrastive alignment. Three-seed experiments cover Darcy2D, ShallowWater2D, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes (CNS3D). Constant conditioning has lower mean test error on both 2D tasks. Relative to this control, task text plus alignment has a similar mean on ShallowWater2D and CNS3D and a higher mean on Darcy2D; these descriptive comparisons have substantial seed uncertainty. The latter comparison changes both prompt content and loss, so it isolates neither effect. The text encoder is trained from scratch, and each conditioned model sees only one description during training. In this regime, pairwise InfoNCE cannot identify matched pairs and has minimum $\log B$. Prompt interventions show no reliable semantic ordering. This methodological caution demonstrates why pathway controls are needed; it neither establishes semantic competence of the encoder nor tests the effectiveness of text under varying physical context.

</details>


### [349] [Sharp Stationary Gaussian Approximation for Constant-Stepsize SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39144)
*Junghoon Seo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对常量步长SGD（由一致遍历马尔可夫链生成的有界加性噪声）的不变分布给出了尖锐的高斯逼近，误差在1-Wasserstein距离下为O(√α)，并提供匹配下界示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究SGD不变分布与其极限高斯之间的逼近精度，尤其是噪声具有时间相关性（马尔可夫链）时的精确收敛速率问题。

Method: 结合分块高斯比较（blockwise Gaussian comparison）与长期收缩（long-run contraction）技术；针对光滑、强凸、Hessian Lipschitz目标，且长期噪声协方差非退化。

Result: 中心化迭代乘以√步长后，与极限高斯的1-Wasserstein距离为O(√α)；四状态例子给出匹配下界，尽管单时刻噪声边缘对称且所有非零滞后自协方差为零，主导修正来自相邻三阶混合矩。

Conclusion: 该结果为相关噪声下SGD不变分布的高斯逼近提供了尖锐速率，并揭示高阶混合矩可成为主导误差来源。

Abstract: We prove a sharp Gaussian approximation for the invariant law of constant-stepsize SGD with bounded additive noise generated by an exogenous uniformly ergodic Markov chain. For a smooth, strongly convex objective with a Lipschitz Hessian and nondegenerate long-run noise covariance, the centered iterate normalized by the square root of the stepsize is $O(\sqrtα)$-close in 1-Wasserstein distance to its limiting Gaussian. The proof combines blockwise Gaussian comparison with long-run contraction. A four-state example gives a matching lower bound although the one-time noise marginal is symmetric and every nonzero-lag autocovariance vanishes. In this example, an adjacent third-order mixed moment produces the leading correction.

</details>


### [350] [Dynamics to decision: A mathematical theory of Lyapunov spectra and decision boundaries in deep classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39190)
*Shirin Panahi,Amirhossein Nazerian,Ali Pezeshki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将前馈分类器建模为有限时间非自治离散动力系统,研究数据样本随层数的轨迹的有限时间最大Lyapunov指数(FTMLE),从概率、logit到隐表示逐步回溯决策边界的动力学特征,并提出几何感知微调方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分类器的决策不仅由输出决定,也由形成决策的逐层变换序列决定。作者希望将这一演化视为随深度的动力系统,从而回答决策几何如何在深度中涌现,以及决策边界的动力学特征能回溯多远。

Method: 将前馈分类器视为有限、非自治离散动力系统(层为离散时间步),计算数据样本轨迹的FTMLE以衡量邻近轨迹的收敛/发散速率。将观测端点从概率退回到logit再到隐表示,针对高斯类证明概率级FTMLE具有与边界法向对齐的几何特征,进一步分析logit级与隐表示级下该关系成立的条件,并提出几何感知微调及高隐FTMLE集中于边界附近的条件。

Result: 理论上证明:概率级FTMLE的主导方向与决策边界法向对齐,是边界几何的清晰特征;logit级该关系不再普适,强烈依赖损失函数等训练方式;隐表示级则需可识别的结构条件才能保持边界相关FTMLE。数值实验验证了理论的通用性与有效性。

Conclusion: 将数据样本在分类器各层中的演化理解为动力系统穿越,为识别边界相关敏感性在何处涌现以及设计层感知正则化策略提供了原则性基础。

Abstract: A deep classifier is defined not only by the decision it produces, but also by the sequence of transformations through which that decision is formed. Treating this evolution as a dynamical system across layers provides a natural framework for asking how decision geometry emerges through depth and how far back we can trace a boundary's dynamical signature. We model a feed-forward classifier as a finite, nonautonomous discrete dynamical system, with layers playing the role of discrete time steps. We study the Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (FTMLE) of the data samples' dynamical trajectory through depths of the classifier. The FTMLE measures the rate of convergence/divergence of nearby trajectories. We move the observation endpoint backward from probabilities to logits and then to hidden representations. For Gaussian classes, we prove that probability-level FTMLE carries a clear geometric signature of the decision boundary, with its dominant direction aligned with the boundary normal. Moving one step backward to the logits, we prove this relationship is no longer universal but depends critically on how the classifier is trained, particularly on the choice of loss function. Moving further backward to the hidden representation, the connection becomes more conditional: boundary-related FTMLE can persist, but only under identifiable structural conditions. We propose geometry-aware fine-tuning for restructuring the classifier's hidden FTMLE, and propose conditions for guaranteed concentration of high hidden FTMLE near the decision boundary. Through our numerical results, we show the generality and validity of our theoretical results. Understanding the evolution of data samples as traveling through the layers of classifier provides a principled foundation for identifying where boundary-relevant sensitivity emerges and for developing layer-aware regularization strategies.

</details>


### [351] [Learning-Enabled Estimation: Tight Characterizations under Sample Selection Biases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38608)
*Vikram Kher,Jane H. Lee,Anay Mehrotra,Manolis Zampetakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出了在存在样本选择偏差时回归可识别性的完整刻画，提出最小假设，并给出首个通用的估计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 样本选择偏差广泛存在于临床试验、劳动力市场、拍卖等场景，忽略会导致系统性偏差。已有研究（如Heckman两阶段模型）只给出充分条件，缺乏对其可识别性的完整刻画。

Method: 通过刻画选择过程函数形式所需的最小假设，建立回归可识别性的充要条件；并在自然强化条件下给出有限样本估计保证、显式收敛率与oracle高效算法。

Result: 证明在某些情形下即使选择过滤器本身不可识别，回归函数仍可识别，突破了“先估计选择过滤器再去偏”的范式；在强化条件下给出收敛率与首个通用估计方法。

Conclusion: 该工作为复杂选择机制下的回归提供了理论刻画和通用估计方法，并应用于拍卖进入成本、劳动力市场等计量经济学场景。

Abstract: When can we learn from biased samples? We study regression when outcomes are observed only after passing through selection filters that depend on both covariates and outcomes themselves, a ubiquitous challenge spanning clinical trials with patient dropout, labor markets with self-selection, and auctions with strategic entry. Ignoring such selection yields systematically biased conclusions with real-world consequences. This challenge has a long history in econometrics and statistics, starting with Heckman's seminal two-stage model and followed by numerous generalizations. While these works provide various sufficient conditions for identification, a complete characterization of when such regression is possible has remained elusive.
  In this work, we provide a characterization for when regression is possible in the presence of sample selection bias. Our results establish the minimal assumptions required on the functional forms of selection processes under which regression remains possible, which are particularly relevant in modern settings where selection mechanisms are increasingly complex and opaque. As a corollary of our characterization, we show that there are settings where the regression function can be identified even when the selection filter itself cannot. This observation already goes beyond the ``estimate selection filter, then debias regression'' paradigm that is followed by virtually all existing approaches. Under natural strengthenings of our identification conditions, we also establish finite-sample estimation guarantees with explicit convergence rates and provide oracle-efficient algorithms. This yields the first general-purpose estimation method for this broad class of selection problems. Finally, we explore the implications of our results for several well-studied econometric settings with complex selection mechanisms such as auctions with entry costs and labor markets.

</details>


### [352] [Robustifying Asynchronous SGD via Soft Throttling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39357)
*Kaoru Otsuka,Maxime Meyer,Yuki Takezawa,Makoto Yamada,Anastasia Koloskova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Throttle，一种异步SGD的拜占庭鲁棒泛化方法，通过按因子q对更快客户端的更新进行指数降权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步SGD每个客户端的梯度更新按到达即应用，虽能加速，但也更易受攻击，因为快速客户端可能主导总更新。

Method: Throttle对来自更快客户端的更新按因子q进行指数降权，异步SGD（q=1）与同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD（q→∞）都是其特例。

Result: 提供收敛率理论分析，并从理论和实验验证鲁棒性；实验显示降权机制在非拜占庭场景下也能优于标准异步SGD。

Conclusion: Throttle统一了异步与同步拜占庭鲁棒SGD，并能在鲁棒性与性能上带来优势。

Abstract: Asynchronous SGD is a popular algorithm for distributed learning where each client's gradient update is applied on arrival. This leads to a speed-up, but also an increased vulnerability to attacks, as fast clients can dominate the total update. We introduce Throttle, a Byzantine-robust generalization of asynchronous SGD where the key idea is to exponentially down-weight updates from faster clients by a factor $q$. Both asynchronous SGD ($q=1$) and synchronous Byzantine-robust SGD ($q\to\infty$) correspond to specific settings of Throttle. We provide a theoretical analysis of the convergence rate and validate the robustness to attacks both theoretically and empirically. Remarkably, our experiments show that this down-weighting mechanism can also improve performance over standard asynchronous SGD even in the non-Byzantine setting.

</details>


### [353] [Markovian Dynamics Enforcer: Feasibility Preserving Correction on Learned Dynamics Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39888)
*Kevin Yu,Tao Guo,Constantinos Antoniou,Panagiotis Angeloudis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MaDE是一种时间不变的事后算子，将神经轨迹预测器的状态转移映射到学习到的可行动力学流形上，无需真值控制即可实现动力学一致并尽力满足不等式约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经轨迹预测器虽误差低，却常违反动力学、执行器限制或状态约束，尤其当控制未被观测、动力学仅部分指定时。

Method: MaDE对每个状态转移推断控制量，经"已知物理+学习残差"的补全模型重算状态，再用基于梯度的不等式削减修正控制；每次修正迭代都重新进入补全模型，使输出状态相对该模型及给定前一状态锚点动态一致。

Result: 在完全指定的仿真系统上动力学残差近乎为零；在欠指定系统上真实动力学残差小于基线。在实车轨迹上，对运动学自行车模型的单步残差MaDE为0.0071–0.0072，原始预测器为0.1703–0.1714；平均位移误差增大1.57–1.83倍。

Conclusion: MaDE可作为通用冻结算子附加于循环、结构化状态空间及Transformer预测器下游，以精度代价换取动力学可行性。

Abstract: Neural trajectory predictors can reach low prediction error while violating dynamics, actuator limits, or state constraints, especially when controls are unobserved and dynamics are partially specified. We introduce the Markovian Dynamics Enforcer (MaDE), a time-invariant post-hoc operator mapping state-transition proposals onto a learned feasible dynamics manifold, trained on feasible states without ground-truth controls. For each transition it infers a control and recomputes the state through a completion model of known physics plus a learned residual. It then corrects that control by gradient-based inequality reduction, so inequality satisfaction is best-effort within an iteration budget. Since every correction iterate re-enters the completion model, the returned state is dynamically consistent by construction relative to that model and the supplied previous-state anchor. MaDE drives dynamics residuals to essentially zero on fully specified simulated systems, and on an underspecified system leaves a smaller true-dynamics residual than the baselines. Designed to attach to arbitrary predictors, the frozen operator is evaluated downstream of recurrent, structured state-space, and transformer predictors. On recorded vehicle trajectories the one-step residual against a kinematic bicycle model is 0.0071 to 0.0072 for MaDE and 0.1703 to 0.1714 for raw predictors. MaDE raises average displacement error by a factor of 1.57 to 1.83.

</details>


### [354] [Understanding Off- vs On-Policy Distillation: A Tale of Distinct Training Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38666)
*Qiwei Di,Xuheng Li,Kaixuan Ji,Chenggong Zhang,Heyang Zhao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多教师序贯蒸馏中on-policy distillation (OPD)的优势与脆弱性，通过分析forward KL与reverse KL的聚合目标给出理论解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD相比SFT在减少遗忘方面有前景，但其收益来源与脆弱性尚未被充分理解，尤其在多教师场景下聚合方式的影响不明。

Method: 在多教师序贯蒸馏设定下，令学生最小化与教师的平均散度。分析forward KL产生加权算术混合、reverse KL产生归一化加权几何聚合；分别设计在off-policy与on-policy反馈下学习这些目标的算法，在tabular设定建立对数遗憾界，并扩展到函数逼近。

Result: 建立了tabular下的对数遗憾界并推广到函数逼近；识别出反向KL相比正向KL在无信息反馈下更能保留自信专家的偏好，但对给正确答案分配极低概率的教师更敏感；其token级条件依赖续写分布，长程下可能偏好错误前缀。

Conclusion: 通过对聚合目标的理论分析，揭示了OPD在多教师蒸馏中的收益与脆弱性机制，为其稳定性与鲁棒性提供了理解和算法基础。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) learns from teacher feedback on student-generated responses and has shown promise in reducing forgetting relative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, its benefits and fragility remain incompletely understood. We study sequential distillation from multiple teachers, where the student minimizes its average divergence from the teachers. Forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence yields a weighted arithmetic mixture, while reverse KL yields a normalized weighted geometric aggregate. We develop algorithms that learn these targets under off-policy and on-policy feedback, respectively, establishing logarithmic regret bounds in the tabular setting and extending the analysis to function approximation. By analyzing these aggregation targets, we identify mechanisms that help explain both the benefits and fragility of OPD. Relative to forward KL, reverse KL can better retain a confident expert's preferences under uninformative feedback, but is more sensitive to teachers that assign very low probabilities to correct responses. Its token-level conditionals also reveal a dependence on continuation distributions that can favor incorrect prefixes over long horizons.

</details>


### [355] [MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38523)
*Dong Shu,Yanguang Liu,Huopu Zhang,Saisai Hu,Haiyan Zhao,Hekun Huang,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出MM-FinEval，一个面向财报电话会议的多模态多任务金融评测基准，覆盖2019-2022年2045场S&P 500电话会议，含文本、幻灯片图像、音频三种模态及12类任务标签，并评测19个基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融评测基准多局限于单模态输入或单任务设置，难以评估多模态大模型能否胜任真实金融分析，而财报预测需要模型综合企业披露、市场预期和微妙沟通信号进行推理。

Method: 构建MM-FinEval基准，时间跨度为2019至2022年，包含2045场S&P 500财报电话会议输入，每场含逐词文本转录、演讲幻灯片和完整音频三种模态，输出12类金融任务标签；将19个基线模型划分为Image-Text、Audio-Text、Any-to-Any三类进行系统评测。

Result: 小型Any-to-Any模型在使用全部三种模态时表现强劲，甚至优于仅限双模态输入的大型专有模型，表明三模态设计引入了有用且非冗余的信息。

Conclusion: 文本、音频和视觉数据是重要且互补的信号，能够模拟专家人类分析师决策过程，验证了多模态多任务评测在真实金融分析中的价值。

Abstract: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

</details>


### [356] [Awakening of the Buddha: Subspace Learning During Population-Loss Plateaus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39408)
*Akash Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究神经网络在训练中"种群损失几乎不变但表征显著变好"的现象，为两层ReLU/leaky-ReLU网络在Gaussian输入下同时梯度下降建立了这种分离保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典观点将损失下降等同于表征学习成效，但作者指出种群损失可近似恒定，而预测表征（如AGOP对齐、refit MSE）却仍有实质改进。论文旨在理论上刻画这种"损失平台期内的表征改进"分离现象。

Method: 对两层ReLU与leaky-ReLU网络在高斯输入上做同步定步长种群梯度下降；针对结构化加性教师（链接为H^1(γ)中Gaussian阻尼三次函数的正混合），给出小IID高斯初始化下的高概率条件；分析rank-r教师子空间与预测器AGOP前r维特征子空间的最小对齐，以及系数预算不变的refit MSE；并对SwiGLU网络（精确拟合截距）在宽度和维度固定、初始化趋于零时证明损失平台期内的leading-AGOP对齐；辅以ReLU学生的种群矩实验（21个教师×50次初始化）。

Result: 在平台期检查点，最小AGOP对齐相对初始化至少增加1/2，且不变系数预算下的最小refit MSE下降超过0.399，随后轨迹达到低于平台期任一值的训练损失；对SwiGLU与平方可积教师（非零低阶Hermite内容）证明了leading-AGOP对齐；rank-one三次特化给出无限制refit同时增益；并给出近似下界，说明共享正交轴约束的ridge神经元对某些交互目标存在非零误差。

Conclusion: 种群损失平台期并不排斥实质的表征学习：AGOP对齐与refit MSE可在损失近似不变时大幅改善，并在后续下降。该分离由理论保证，并经种群矩实验验证，同时也揭示共享正交轴restriction的固有近似局限。

Abstract: Population loss can remain nearly constant while a neural network learns a substantially more predictive representation. We establish this separation for two-layer ReLU and leaky-ReLU networks trained on Gaussian inputs by simultaneous fixed-step population gradient descent on all parameters. For structured additive teachers whose links are positive mixtures of Gaussian-damped cubics in $H^1(γ)$, we give explicit conditions under which small IID Gaussian initialization yields a high-probability guarantee: at a checkpoint during a high-loss plateau, minimum alignment between the rank-$r$ teacher subspace and the leading $r$-dimensional eigenspace of the predictor's average gradient outer product (AGOP) increases by at least $1/2$, and the minimum refit MSE under unchanged coefficient budgets decreases by more than $0.399$, both relative to initialization. The same trajectory subsequently attains a trained loss below every value in the plateau window. A complementary result treats unequal-weight cubic teachers and small additive Sobolev perturbations using projected-feature refits. For SwiGLU networks with an exactly fitted intercept, we prove leading-AGOP alignment during a loss plateau at fixed width and dimension as Gaussian initialization vanishes, for square-integrable teachers with nonzero Hermite content of degree one, two, or three. A rank-one cubic specialization also gives simultaneous unrestricted-refit gains at a prescribed width. An approximation lower bound further shows that certain interaction targets retain nonzero error when ridge neurons are restricted to shared orthogonal axes within the teacher subspace. Population-moment experiments with ReLU students across 21 teachers and 50 initializations per teacher complement the analysis.

</details>


### [357] [Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38526)
*Ali Aouad,Aymane El Gadarri,Vivek F. Farias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个信息论基础的缩放律：对齐优化性能约按 Θ(√(min{log(M), K})) 缩放（M 为偏好比较数据量，K 为 KL 散度预算），并在真实标注实验中验证了极佳拟合（R² 97%–99%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缩放律只关注优化努力（KL 预算）与性能的关系，但未干净地刻画性能如何同时随训练偏好数据量 M 与散度预算 K 联合缩放。理解二者的联合影响对预测过优化（reward hacking）何时发生至关重要。

Method: 构建信息论模型，推导出性能约为 Θ(√(min{log(M), K})) 的上界，并给出构造性过程证明其紧致可达；同时采用真实标注设置进行实验：用 70B 金标奖励模型生成反馈数据，训练 0.6B–4B 的代理奖励模型，并用 best-of-N 与 policy tilting 等优化方法验证。

Result: 缩放律拟合度极高（R² 97%–99%），优于其他替代规格，且在模型规模、噪声及不同优化程序下保持稳健。结果表明奖励优化类似于一个简单选择任务：用噪声偏好反馈从 IID 高斯随机变量序列中选取最优者。

Conclusion: 性能由数据量与优化预算中较小的一者主导，二者联合缩放遵循 √min{log(M), K} 规律；该结论为预测和控制对齐中的过优化提供了理论与实证依据。

Abstract: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $Θ(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

</details>


### [358] [Amortized Data Borrowing with Exchangeability-Aware Neural Posterior Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38902)
*Chin-Hung Huang,JooChul Lee,Huan He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究摊销神经后验估计（NPE）作为贝叶斯动态借用（BDB）的灵活替代方案，用于药物开发中利用外部或历史队列增强小型并发研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物开发中入组慢、随访昂贵，常已有相关试验或真实世界数据。BDB可自适应控制外部数据影响，但经典实现依赖手工设定先验和MCMC推断，计算昂贵且不易泛化。

Method: 预训练单一神经网络，输入为模拟的当前/外部数据集对，涵盖协变量偏移、结果漂移和联合不可交换性，然后单次前向传播即可返回当前研究标量目标的近似后验。

Result: 模拟研究显示NPE在结果漂移和联合失配下最有用，困难漂移情形下绝对偏差比最佳经典基线低约五倍，Type I错误率接近名义值；预训练后每数据集约8毫秒获得后验摘要，比MCMC基线快约10^3倍。ADNI数据分析表明，当轻度认知障碍结果跨队列不同时，NPE能恢复后一队列的风险水平而不虚报精度。

Conclusion: NPE是一种灵活高效的BDB替代方法，在结果漂移和联合失配情形下表现优异，计算速度快，并在真实ADNI数据中验证了其可行性。

Abstract: Augmenting small concurrent studies with external or historical cohorts is attractive in drug development, where enrollment is slow, follow-up is expensive, and closely related trial or real-world data are often already available. Bayesian dynamic borrowing (BDB) provides a principled framework for adaptively controlling the influence of external data, but classical implementations often depend on hand-specified priors and MCMC-based inference, which can be computationally expensive and not generalizable. In this work, we study amortized neural posterior estimation (NPE) as a flexible alternative. A single network is pretrained on simulated current/external dataset pairs spanning covariate shift, outcome drift, and joint non-exchangeability, and then returns an approximate posterior for a scalar current-study target in a single forward pass. Through simulation studies, we find that NPE is most useful under outcome drift and joint mismatch: in the harder outcome-drift regimes, it gives up to about five-fold lower absolute bias than the best classical baseline and keeps Type I error close to nominal. After pretraining, posterior summaries are obtained in about 8 ms per dataset, roughly $10^3\times$ faster than MCMC-based borrowing baselines in our timing experiment. We further analyze Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) data and show that, when mild cognitive impairment outcomes differ across cohorts, the NPE formulation recovers the later-cohort risk level in this example without claiming greater precision. Code is available at https://github.com/ChinHungScott/NPE-for-Bayesian-Dynamic-Borrowing-MLHC-.

</details>


### [359] [Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38536)
*Jiacheng Qiu,Christopher E. Mower,Jan Peters,Haitham Bou-Ammar,Matthieu Zimmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对扩散式大语言模型(dLLM)智能体陷入"重试循环"的失败给出机制性解释，并提出无需训练的解药Reflect Reverse。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dLLM通过并行解码有望打破自回归智能体的串行延迟瓶颈，但评估显示这种效率无法转化为具身智能体能力：dLLM智能体反复落入重试循环，在动作早已失败后仍重新发出该动作。

Method: 作者将重试循环追溯到掩码解码的自适应性：采样器提交高置信度位置、推迟不确定位置，而在失败状态下上下文已为被推迟的决策提供了高置信填充（即失败动作本身），于是重试在未面对失败反馈的情况下被提交。作者把动作分布的扭曲建模为任务盲腐败：情境显著的动作（如刚执行的动作）获得膨胀概率，其因子依赖状态与动作但不依赖任务。基于此模型分析不变性命题：任务盲因子在逆向条件（给定状态与候选动作时任务的可能性）中恰好抵消，等价于理想无腐败模型的任务后验。掩码dLLM可原生评估逆向条件，只需对每个候选进行几次并行去噪。作者据此提出Reflect Reverse规则。

Result: 在四个多轮具身基准上评估，Reflect Reverse相对前向打分基线提升了任务成功率与推进率。

Conclusion: Reflect Reverse是一种无需训练的方法，通过利用任务盲腐败在逆向条件中的抵消特性，缓解dLLM智能体的重试循环问题，提升具身任务表现。

Abstract: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

</details>


### [360] [T-ARC: Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering via Distributionally Robust Stochastic Block Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39466)
*Serena Grazia De Benedictis,Andersen Ang,Nicoletta Del Buono,Flavia Esposito,Laura Selicato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: T-ARC将拓扑信息嵌入K-means优化目标，通过SBM建模隐图、DRO优化参数、持续同调构建相似度矩阵，纠正几何偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K-means存在几何偏置，无法处理非凸、弯曲或交织的簇结构，忽略数据潜在连通拓扑。

Method: 在K-means数据保真项中加入图割惩罚项；隐图用随机块模型(SBM)建模，标量参数在DRO框架下优化并得到闭式近端更新；SBM与DRO均基于H0持续同调导出的相似度矩阵作为拓扑先验；整体用块坐标下降求解，借助全局Lyapunov泛函证明收敛。

Result: 在非凸合成数据集和Fashion-MNIST随机子集上，T-ARC恢复了K-means失败的潜在拓扑结构，在弯曲与交织簇上准确率最高，真实数据上具竞争力且比K-means更稳定。

Conclusion: T-ARC通过耦合拓扑先验与聚类目标，有效弥补K-means几何偏置，为拓扑感知聚类提供了理论收敛保证与实证优势。

Abstract: In this work, we introduce a new clustering method, namely T-ARC (Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering), that corrects the geometric bias of K-means by embedding topological information directly into the optimization objective. Building on the assumption that the data admits an underlying hidden structure modeled via a latent graph, the idea is to uncover this information through the interplay between the standard K-means data-fidelity term and a graph-cut penalty, which discourages cluster assignments inconsistent with the connectivity structure of the data.
  To render this coupling tractable, the latent graph is modeled as a random realization from a Stochastic Block Model (SBM), whose scalar parameter is optimized within a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) framework, yielding a closed-form proximal update. Both SBM and DRO are informed by a persistence-based similarity matrix derived from zero-dimensional persistent homology ($H_0$), which translates the multiscale connectivity structure of the data into a pairwise topological prior. The overall optimization proceeds via Block Coordinate Descent; convergence is established through a global Lyapunov functional: the deterministic blocks satisfy monotonic descent, while the stochastic graph update satisfies descent in expectation, so that the expected energy converges.
  Experiments on synthetic datasets with non-convex geometries and on random subsets of Fashion-MNIST show that T-ARC recovers latent topological structures where K-means fails, achieving the highest accuracy on curved and interleaved clusters while remaining competitive, and markedly more stable than K-means, on real data.

</details>


### [361] [Flow Matching under Noisy Latent Structure: Beyond Exact Low-Dimensional Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38918)
*Lifeng Hao,Shaolin Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性Flow Matching在含噪潜在生成模型下的有限样本理论，证明其统计速率由潜在维度而非环境维度决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Flow Matching有限样本理论多假设环境空间具有正则性，或数据精确支撑在低维集合上。作者希望放松"精确低维支撑"的严格假设，探究当数据由低维Hölder映射加非退化高斯噪声生成（目标分布实际为全维）时，Flow Matching是否仍能保持潜在维度的统计行为。

Method: 采用含噪潜在生成模型：低维Hölder映射加非退化高斯噪声。构造空间正则的ReLU速度类，建立非渐近高概率逼近与估计界，并显式追踪环境维度与噪声依赖。利用速度误差经传输ODE传播，得到Wasserstein收敛保证。

Result: 逼近与估计界的主导样本量指数由潜在维度控制，而非环境维度；固定正目标噪声使插值在全时间区间非退化；空间正则性成功将速度误差传播至Wasserstein收敛界。

Conclusion: 精确低维支撑并非Flow Matching获得潜在维度统计速率的必要条件；即使目标分布全维，只要存在低维潜在结构，统计行为仍由潜在维度主导。

Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) learns a velocity field whose ODE transports a simple source distribution to a target law. Existing finite-sample theory largely treats ambient-space regularity or data supported exactly on low-dimensional sets. We study linear FM under a noisy latent-generator model, where a low-dimensional Hölder map is perturbed by nondegenerate ambient Gaussian noise, so the target law is full-dimensional despite its latent structure. We construct a spatially regular ReLU velocity class and establish non-asymptotic high-probability approximation and estimation bounds whose leading sample-size exponent is governed by the latent dimension rather than the ambient dimension, with ambient and noise dependence kept explicit. Fixed positive target noise keeps the interpolation nondegenerate over the full time interval. The same spatial regularity propagates the learned velocity error through the transport ODE, yielding a corresponding Wasserstein convergence guarantee. These results show that exact low-dimensional support is not necessary for Flow Matching to retain latent-dimensional statistical behavior.

</details>


### [362] [ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38538)
*Anthony Lavertu,Jacob Cote,Sophie Gobeil,Jacques Corbeil,Isabeau Premont-Schwarz,Pascal Germain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLaG：一种模态无关框架，通过层次潜变量建模样本相关性，用近邻图和社区检测推断相关样本组，生成独立的训练-测试划分，缓解随机划分导致的过乐观估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集（如生化研究）中常含相关样本，随机划分会使训练-测试子集不独立，导致泛化估计过于乐观。

Method: 用层次潜变量过程建模样本相关性，借助近邻图与社区检测推断相关样本组，从而产生独立划分；并提出无标签程序自适应划分分辨率。

Result: 在分子与蛋白质数据集上，性能与现有关系感知方法相当，但扩展性显著更好，可在以往不可行的大数据集上完成划分。

Conclusion: ReLaG提供有效、可扩展的独立划分方案，其推断的组可廉价估计有效数据集规模，支持多样性感知的数据扩展；开源，pip install relag 即可安装。

Abstract: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

</details>


### [363] [Fast Regularized Policy Mirror Descent with One-Step TD Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39837)
*Qipei Chen,Wenye Li,Yule Sun,Ke Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析持久critic（每次仅一次TD更新）耦合的策略镜像下降（PMD），在确定性Bellman更新下证明值函数全局线性收敛，并在单条离策略轨迹下给出O~(1/((1-γ)^5 σ_b ε))的样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PMD在正则化MDP中虽收敛快，但收敛保证通常依赖精确或逐渐精确的策略评估，计算代价高。作者希望放松这一要求，分析仅用一次TD更新的持久critic方案。

Method: 对有限折扣MDP：采用基于resolvent的辅助分布、衰减Bellman违例修正，以及按坐标逆权重加权的势函数证明。对随机TD-PMD：在单条离策略Markov轨迹下，使用一般强凸镜像映射、合适常数步长与有限批TD更新；利用由顶点Bregman散度一致界导出的逐轨迹正则化Lipschitz连续性，以及针对带符号critic误差传播的访问加权resolvent估计。

Result: 精确坐标Bellman更新下，对任意正常数actor步长与任意有限critic初始化实现值函数全局线性收敛。随机TD-PMD在单条离策略轨迹上以期望值间隙ε收敛，样本复杂度为O~(1/((1-γ)^5 σ_b ε))，对行为覆盖度σ_b呈逆线性依赖；无需轨迹重置、生成模型或嵌套策略评估循环。数值结果与理论一致。

Conclusion: 持久critic（单次TD更新）的PMD可在较弱假设下获得快速收敛与样本复杂度保证，显著放宽了正则化策略优化的评估要求，且数值实验支持理论分析。

Abstract: Policy mirror descent (PMD) enjoys fast convergence in regularized Markov decision processes (MDPs), but existing guarantees often rely on exact or increasingly accurate policy evaluation. We analyze PMD coupled with a persistent critic advanced by one temporal-difference (TD) update. For finite discounted MDPs, we establish global linear convergence in value for exact coordinate-wise Bellman updates, with any positive constant actor stepsize and arbitrary finite critic initialization. The proof combines a resolvent-based auxiliary distribution with a decaying Bellman-violation correction and a potential weighted by inverse coordinate weights. We then study stochastic TD-PMD with general strongly convex mirror maps under a single off-policy Markov trajectory. With suitably chosen constant stepsizes and a finite-batch TD update, the method achieves an expected value gap of $ε$ after $\widetilde{O}(1/((1-γ)^5 \widetildeσ_b ε))$ transitions. The stochastic analysis relies on the trajectory-wise Lipschitz continuity of the regularizer, derived from uniform bounds on vertex Bregman divergences, together with a visitation-weighted resolvent estimate for signed critic-error propagation that yields an inverse-linear dependence on behavior coverage $\widetildeσ_b$. In contrast to many prior guarantees for regularized policy optimization, our sample-complexity guarantee holds without trajectory resets, generative-model access, or nested policy-evaluation loops. Numerical results are consistent with the theoretical convergence analysis.

</details>


### [364] [A Rank Graduation metric for Algorithmic fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39025)
*Dalia Atif,Paolo Giudici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于秩的公平性框架（RGF/AURGF+置换检验+特征移除），将公平评估与预测精度和可解释性关联，并在模拟与HMDA数据上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统公平性度量在群体聚合层面计算，无法揭示哪些个体遭遇不公平及其成因，也难以与预测精度和可解释性结合。

Method: 构建秩基公平性框架：Rank Graduation Fairness（RGF）、AURGF综合指标、中心化Cramér–von Mises置换检验，以及用于公平性解释的特征移除流程；用逻辑回归、随机森林、梯度提升和多层感知机在模拟数据和HMDA房贷数据上评估。

Result: 模拟显示受保护群体不平衡会反转描述性公平比较，而所提推断程序能正确区分公平与不公平机制；HMDA数据上模型排序不同于经典公平准则，树模型在精度与秩基公平间组合最佳，四个模型均拒绝公平性原假设。差异在统计、bagging、boosting和神经网络设定下持续存在，特征移除结果说明不公平并非源于单一算法，而与贷款数据中的群体特征差异相关。

Conclusion: 支持将预测精度、公平度量、统计推断与可解释性结合的可信AI更广泛路径。

Abstract: Fairness assessment in algorithmic decisions that affect individuals, such as credit scoring, often relies on parity measures calculated at the aggregate group level. Such measures may not reveal which individuals experience unfairness or which explanatory factors contribute to it. In this paper, we propose a rank-based framework that evaluates fairness through the distribution of model prediction errors, thereby linking fairness assessment with predictive accuracy and explainability. The framework combines Rank Graduation Fairness (RGF), its integrated measure AURGF, a centered Cramer--von Mises permutation test, and a feature removal procedure for fairness explainability.
  We evaluate the methodology using logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting, and a multilayer perceptron. The simulation study shows that protected-group imbalance can reverse descriptive fairness comparisons, whereas the proposed inferential procedure correctly distinguishes fair from unfair mechanisms. Its application to HMDA mortgage data produces model rankings that differ from those obtained with classical fairness criteria. Tree-based models, rather than logistic regression, provide the strongest combination of predictive accuracy and rank-based fairness, while the fairness null hypothesis is rejected for all four models. The persistence of disparity across statistical, bagging, boosting, and neural network specifications, together with the feature removal results, indicates that the observed unfairness is not specific to a single algorithm or predictor, but is associated with group differences embedded in the characteristics of the lending data. These findings support a broader approach to trustworthy artificial intelligence that combines predictive accuracy, fairness measurement, statistical inference, and explainability.

</details>


### [365] [When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38540)
*Vicente Opazo,Jose Calatayud-Mateu,Cristobal Rojas,Cristian Buc Calderon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 曲率上界有效不等于可用于鲁棒性证书或内在训练干预；末层相对平坦度代理在两类用途下均存在失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纠正将"有效曲率上界"直接等同于鲁棒性证书或训练干预依据的常见推理，明确二者需额外条件。

Method: 分析末层相对平坦度代理：证明全局经验风险最小点处仍保留一阶损失项（证书低估损失增量超210倍），给出规范不变的特征空间修复；分析common-row softmax平移导致的预测不变但代理无界问题，提出行中心化（orbit最小化、恢复值与全模型梯度不变性）；在45组配对一步测试及CIFAR-10长时程实验中验证。

Result: 原始正则预测器在放大平移下分离，商正则预测器保持对齐；CIFAR-10上泛化被显著且可逆地抑制，而记忆后选择性延迟的证据不一致。

Conclusion: 曲率上界有效性本身不足以支撑其反演为鲁棒性证书或微分为内在训练干预。

Abstract: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

</details>


### [366] [Scalable Cox Regression via Grouped Risk Sets and Sharper LogSumExp Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40120)
*Elizaveta Iashchinskaia,Egor Gladin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究大规模 Cox 回归中 LogSumExp 目标的随机优化问题，提出 softplus 代理实现单样本无偏梯度，并对分组压缩风险集给出收敛率与渐近性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 Cox 回归计算开销大，LogSumExp 目标的 mini-batch 归一化估计会产生有偏梯度，因此需要无偏且高效的随机优化方法。

Method: 引入 softplus 代理，为每个归一化项增加一个辅助标量，从而获得无偏单样本梯度；针对 Cox 回归嵌套风险集结构，将相邻失效事件分组并共享辅助变量，得到压缩目标及统一的得分与曲率界。

Result: 平滑凸 LogSumExp 目标下达到 O(T^{-1/2}) 平均目标界（优于此前 T^{-1/4}）；加正则后取得 \widetilde{O}(T^{-1}) 的最后迭代平方误差率，且辅助变量无需强凸；Cox 压缩估计相对全量解的均方速率达 T^{-4/5}（忽略对数因子），并匹配全量估计的渐近分布；实验表现优于随机基线。

Conclusion: softplus 代理与风险集分组压缩为大规模 Cox 回归提供了理论保证良好且实用的随机优化方案。

Abstract: Motivated by the computational challenges of large-scale Cox regression, we study stochastic minimization of LogSumExp objectives over large sets. Mini-batch normalizer estimates generally yield biased gradients. We instead use a softplus surrogate that introduces one auxiliary scalar per normalizer and admits unbiased single-sample gradients. For smooth convex LogSumExp objectives, we prove an $O(T^{-1/2})$ averaged objective bound, improving the previous $T^{-1/4}$ analysis. With a strongly convex regularizer on the original variable, we also obtain a last-iterate squared-error rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})$ without strong convexity in the auxiliary variables. For Cox regression, the normalizers are defined over nested risk sets. We exploit this structure by grouping neighboring failures and sharing one auxiliary variable per group. The resulting compressed objective admits uniform score and curvature bounds that control the errors from grouping and softplus approximation. Together with the general optimization result, these bounds give a mean-square rate of $T^{-4/5}$, up to logarithmic factors, relative to the full Cox solution. The compressed estimator also matches the full estimator's asymptotic distribution. Experiments on synthetic and real survival datasets with slowly decreasing risk sets show a favorable performance relative to stochastic baselines.

</details>


### [367] [Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters: A Causal Intervention for Routing Collapse in Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39445)
*Hung Phan,Thuy T. Nguyen,Minh Ngoc Dinh,Nhat-Quang Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 单头适配冻结骨干的TSFM在异构区间欠拟合，改用MoE会因实例归一化导致路由崩溃；提出在原始输入上路由的RR-MoA可解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型通常给冻结骨干接单个可训练头，这种"一刀切"设置在异构数据区间会欠拟合。标准升级是用专家混合（MoE），但在实例归一化骨干（主流TSFM设计）上会失败：路由熵塌缩为零，单一专家吸收所有输入，称为"归一化引起的路由崩溃"。常规MoE补救机制无效，因为根因在路由器输入而非优化过程——预编码器归一化剥离了路由器区分区间所需的统计量。

Method: 通过互信息分解精确刻画该问题，得到一个信号比（训练前计算即可预测数据集脆弱性，Spearman ρ=-0.88）。用八个因果控制实验（含视觉模态复现）证明实例归一化是根因。提出最小因果干预——Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters (RR-MoA)，在归一化之前的原始输入上进行路由。另有两个架构不同的变体验证原理的普适性。

Result: 在严格冻结骨干下，RR-MoA 对最强固定适配器取得54/54全胜，并显著超过LoRA、TRACE、AdaMix和全量微调；效果泛化到六个骨干及一个插补任务。冻结的RR-MoA还比全量微调高出12-79%（"冻结悖论"）。

Conclusion: 根因在于实例归一化剥离了路由器所需统计量而非优化问题，因此在原始输入端路由（RR-MoA）即可解决路由崩溃；作为一个极简因果干预，它使冻结骨干的适配显著优于多种强基线和全量微调，并在多种骨干、任务与架构变体上泛化。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) commonly adapt to new data by attaching a single trainable head to a frozen backbone, a one-size-fits-all setup that underfits heterogeneous regimes. Replacing the head with a mixture of experts is the standard upgrade, but on instance-normalized backbones (the dominant TSFM design class) it fails: routing entropy collapses to zero and one expert absorbs every input, a failure we call normalization-induced routing collapse. Standard MoE rescue mechanisms do not repair it, because the cause is in the router's input, not its optimization. Pre-encoder normalization strips the statistics a router would need to tell regimes apart. A mutual-information decomposition makes this precise and yields a signal-ratio that, computed before training, predicts dataset vulnerability (Spearman $ρ= -0.88$). Eight causal controls, including a vision-modality replication, isolate instance normalization as the cause. The prescription is a minimal causal intervention: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters (RR-MoA), which routes on the raw, pre-normalization input. Under a strictly frozen backbone, RR-MoA wins 54/54 comparisons against the strongest fixed adapter and significantly outperforms LoRA, TRACE, AdaMix, and full fine-tuning. The effect generalizes across six backbones and an imputation task. Frozen RR-MoA also beats full fine-tuning by 12-79% (the Frozen Paradox); two architecturally distinct variants confirm the principle generalizes beyond this specific router.

</details>


### [368] [The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38565)
*Linkai Ma,Qilin Li,Petros Drineas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在迭代岭回归中，每步使用新的随机草图（fresh sketching）比复用草图具有可证明的优势，并提出残差感知采样规则以加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去25年，草图与采样广泛用于加速大规模回归。在迭代随机求解器中，是否每步复用同一草图还是重新采样是一个关键设计选择。对于列采样的（欠约束）迭代岭回归，fresh sketches 是否具有可证明优势此前一直是开放问题。

Method: 通过 fresh sketching，仅需沿当前残差解分析误差，而非在整个 Gram 矩阵上统一分析。这种方向性视角为 leverage score 和 ridge leverage score 采样带来更紧的收敛保证，并引出残差感知采样规则。通过最小化相关草图矩阵-向量乘积的方差，推导出 oracle 分布及其实际近似，包括具有（较弱）收敛保证的混合采样分布。

Result: 合成数据和真实数据实验（包括 Qwen2.5 表示上的 ridge probes）支持理论，显示出显著更快的收敛。

Conclusion: Fresh sketching 在迭代岭回归中确实优于复用草图，方向性误差分析和残差感知采样规则能显著加速收敛，且实际近似方案有效可行。

Abstract: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

</details>


### [369] [Policy Iteration Is Not Strongly Polynomial for Deterministic Markov Decision Processes: The Price of Algorithmic Anarchy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40147)
*Han Zhong,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明 Howard 策略迭代在至多两个动作的确定性折扣 MDP 上需要指数级迭代次数，从而否定其强多项式性，并与单纯形法形成指数分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望刻画 Howard 策略迭代在确定性折扣 MDP 上的计算复杂度，并理解其与经典单纯形法（如 Dantzig 规则）之间的本质差异。

Method: 针对每状态至多两个动作的确定性折扣 MDP，构造与分析 Howard 策略迭代的迭代下界，并与 Dantzig 枢轴规则下被证明为该类强多项式的单纯形法进行对比；同时考虑奖励为对数位长的情形。

Result: 证明当折扣因子属于输入时 Howard 策略迭代存在指数级迭代下界，否定其强多项式性；给出与 Dantzig 规则单纯形法的指数分离；即使奖励受限为对数位长，也得到伸展指数级下界。

Conclusion: Howard 的“去中心化同步自私改进”与 Dantzig 的“全局协调选择最大增益动作”之间存在显著差距，体现了算法无政府状态的“代价”。

Abstract: We establish an exponential iteration lower bound in the number of states for Howard's policy iteration on deterministic discounted Markov decision processes, with at most two actions per state. This rules out strong polynomiality of Howard's policy iteration when the discount factor is part of the input and yields an exponential separation from the simplex method with Dantzig's pivoting rule, which is proved to be strongly polynomial on this class. Even when each reward is restricted to logarithmic bit length, we obtain a stretched-exponential iteration lower bound. The gap between Howard's decentralized and simultaneous selfish improvements and Dantzig's coordinated selection of a single action with the largest gain across all states reveals a ``price'' of algorithmic anarchy.

</details>


### [370] [The Geometry of Randomized Smoothing on Feasible Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39497)
*Syed Izhan Khilji,Alireza Furutanpey,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究随机平滑在过滤预测器上的证书有效性，指出条件概率代入普通平滑公式会认证包含决策边界的球，并提出几何与认证的分离框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可行性或置信度过滤仅报告保留提案的标签概率，形成比值。其分子为固定高斯事件质量，分母为保留概率且随中心变化。将该比值代入普通平滑公式可能认证一个包含决策边界的球，因此需要澄清条件平滑何时有效。

Method: 将问题分为几何问题与认证问题：几何决定条件化何时保持高斯比较，凸保留集保持完整比较，一般集合需要对中心移动时保留分布进行几何控制；同时提出联合保留与标签概率始终给出对同一过滤预测器的有效证书；并用均匀协方差界将散度证书转移到保留分布。两种方法均给出有限样本界。

Result: 对于带训练选择非凸过滤器的学习图像分类器，条件Rényi界在无需额外模型评估时比联合质量界认证更多图像；一个已发布的置信过滤器在条件替换得到的半径内出现已验证的标签变化。

Conclusion: 条件替换可能无效并可认证含决策边界的球，除非具备保留分布的几何控制；联合质量证书始终有效，协方差界可在高斯事件比较失败时给出更大半径；自适应高斯组合可应用于带路径能量界的历史依赖中心移动的因果有限时域执行。

Abstract: Randomized smoothing certifies the probability of a fixed output event as the center of Gaussian noise moves. Feasibility or confidence filtering reports label probabilities only among retained proposals, producing a ratio. Its numerator is a fixed Gaussian event mass, while its denominator is the probability of retention and can change with the center. Substituting this ratio into the ordinary smoothing formula can therefore certify a ball that contains a decision boundary. We separate the problem into a geometric question and a certification question. Geometry determines when conditioning preserves Gaussian comparisons. Convex retained sets preserve the full comparison, while general sets require geometric control of the retained law as the center moves. Without such control, conditional probabilities imply no positive universal radius. Joint retention-and-label probabilities always yield a valid certificate for the same filtered predictor. A uniform covariance bound transfers divergence certificates to the retained law and can yield larger radii even when the Gaussian event comparison fails. Both methods admit finite-sample bounds. For a learned image classifier with a training-selected nonconvex filter, conditional Rényi bounds certify more images than joint-mass bounds without additional model evaluations. A released confidence filter exhibits verified label changes inside radii obtained by conditional substitution. An application of adaptive Gaussian composition covers causal finite-horizon executions with history-dependent center shifts under a pathwise energy bound.

</details>


### [371] [FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38585)
*Wang Wei,Harry Yang,Tiankai Yang,Samyadeep Basu,Hongjie Chen,Andy Zhao,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FlexRouter，一种基于行列式点过程（DPP）的 LLM 路由框架，通过建模模型互补性来优化"答案覆盖"，在无需预设预算下自适应选择模型子集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 路由方法独立打分并选 top-k，忽略了模型间的相关性，且强制固定计算预算。这导致选出的模型往往共享失效模式、存在冗余，从而限制了整体成功概率。

Method: 将路由建模为面向覆盖的子集选择问题，用 DPP 同时捕捉模型能力与冗余性；设计基于失效集边缘化的训练目标，无需真值目标子集即可直接优化覆盖率；推理时采用基于边际对数行列式增益的贪心策略，自适应确定子集大小。

Result: 在 RouterEval 大规模基准上，FlexRouter 在域内和域外任务上均取得比强基线更高的覆盖率与更低冗余，同时保持灵活的推理成本。

Conclusion: 显式建模模型互补性并以覆盖率为优化目标，可有效提升多模型集成式推理的成功概率，且无需预设计算预算，兼顾效果与灵活性。

Abstract: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

</details>


### [372] [Probabilistic Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39798)
*Andi Zhang,Xingyu Zhao,Siddartha Khastgir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 从概率视角出发，提出基于KL下界的鲁棒性目标，导出"概率对抗训练"，提升概率鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗样本源于距离分布p_dis与分类器诱导分布p_vic的重叠，二者重叠越小则越难生成对抗样本、鲁棒性越强，这一直觉需要可计算的目标来指导训练。

Method: 证明KL(p_dis||p_vic)-log Z_vic是概率鲁棒性(PR)的下界；因PR难算，最大化该KL下界作为可处理代理目标；进一步表明该目标等价于缩放形式的对抗训练，提出概率对抗训练方法。

Result: 实验表明该方法持续提升PR；消融研究显示其诱导的缩放因子甚至能增强非概率性对抗训练方法的PR。

Conclusion: 该工作为对抗训练提供概率解释，并给出有原理依据的鲁棒性提升路径，所提缩放因子具有通用增益价值。

Abstract: Building on a probabilistic perspective in which adversarial examples arise from the overlap between a distance-based distribution $p_{\mathrm{dis}}$ and a victim-classifier-induced distribution $p_{\mathrm{vic}}$, we start from a simple intuition: adversarial examples become harder to generate when these two distributions are pushed apart, as their overlap becomes smaller, thereby increasing robustness. This intuition naturally motivates a KL-based robustness objective. We then prove that $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{dis}}\|p_{\mathrm{vic}})-\log Z_{\mathrm{vic}}$ is a lower bound on probabilistic robustness (PR), where $Z_{\mathrm{vic}}$ denotes the normalizing constant of $p_{\mathrm{vic}}$. Since PR is generally intractable to compute directly, maximizing this KL-based lower bound provides a tractable surrogate objective for improving PR. We further show that this objective recovers a scaled form of adversarial training, offering a probabilistic interpretation of adversarial training and a principled route to robustness improvement. We call the resulting method probabilistic adversarial training. Experiments show that it consistently improves PR, and ablation studies demonstrate that the induced scaling factor can even enhance the PR of non-probabilistic adversarial training methods.

</details>


### [373] [NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38587)
*Yifan Wang,Haiping Liu,Yang Cui,Wenhao Cai,Shuhang Li,Xiaoyang Huang,Xianyang Liu,Jingyu Sun,Yizheng Sun,Cunhang Fan,Tianming Du,Jiancheng Yang,Zhenhong Li,Yunhao Zhang,Hongpeng Zhou,Jingyuan Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NeurDuo-EEG，一种具通道级持久记忆的因果EEG基础模型，通过多时间尺度记忆管理与离散频谱码自回归预训练，在长短序列任务上取得优异表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG连续记录数小时，相关动态跨越毫秒至小时级时间尺度，但多数EEG基础模型独立处理固定窗口，难以捕捉长时程动态；状态空间架构虽支持持续循环处理，长程信息仍被隐式压缩在循环状态中。

Method: 提出NeurDuo-EEG因果EEG基础模型：引入通道级持久记忆与多时间尺度记忆管理，含可学习巩固与选择性检索，以固定大小状态持续建模连续EEG；在17个公开数据集共3955小时EEG上，用离散频谱码的多通道自回归预测进行预训练。

Result: 在3个短窗口和2个长序列下游任务中，5项基准中4项最优，包括全部短窗口任务和癫痫检测（AUC-PR从0.285提升至0.471）；睡眠分期保持竞争力；支持高效流式推理，历史增长至1小时时每块延迟近乎恒定；Small变体主干仅4.7M参数。

Conclusion: 结果表明持久、多时间尺度建模对长序列与短窗口EEG分析均具价值，代码已开源。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory.
