More surprisingly, the proxy still correlates with generalisation gap on most tasks even when Hessian trace and top-eigenvalue relationships are weak or reversed, yet this signal does not reliably identify the deployment-best model. A curvature bound need not preserve cross-model rankings, and low geometric scores can even favour collapsed predictors. Thus, a generalisation signal need not be a model-selection signal.

</details>


### [444] [T-Router: Learning Thalamic Routing for Reasoning with Parameter-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39109)
*Liuxian Ma,Jiale Dai,Jiaqi Li,Lu Mi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Thalamic Router (T-Router)，通过可寻址块变换库与深度循环控制器实现参数高效强化学习，仅训练 0.466% 参数即超越全参数微调和 LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效强化学习需要以紧凑可训练接口提升预训练模型推理能力，核心在于如何有效复用已完成的计算。

Method: T-Router 将适配集中在完成计算的复用上：用压缩、可寻址的块保存块的变换；深度循环控制器调节其选择与相对尺度回写，从而学习接收层复用哪些早期贡献及其影响权重。以正确性奖励训练接口，保持主干参数和层序不变。

Result: 在 8.95B 主干上仅分配 41.73M 参数（0.466%），GSM8K RL 后 MathAvg 达 83.64±1.16，优于全参数 GRPO 的 73.79±1.83；同等参数预算下超过 LoRA 的 77.28±1.95，AIME 均值从 48.33 提升至 60.56。

Conclusion: 受控计算复用是参数高效推理强化学习的有效途径，可寻址块变换与循环上下文具优势，并可扩展至工具中介推理。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient reinforcement learning aims to improve reasoning with a compact trainable interface to a pretrained model. We introduce the Thalamic Router (T-Router), which concentrates adaptation on the reuse of completed computations. A compressed, addressable bank preserves block changes; a depth-recurrent controller conditions their selection and relative-scale writeback. This coupling gives thalamic context-dependent routing a concrete computational form: learn which earlier contributions a receiving layer uses, and with what influence. Correctness rewards train the interface while preserving backbone parameters and layer order. On an 8.95B-parameter backbone, T-Router allocates 41.73M parameters (0.466% of the backbone) and achieves 83.64 +/- 1.16 MathAvg after GSM8K RL, compared with 73.79 +/- 1.83 for full-parameter GRPO across three evaluation rounds. At a comparable parameter budget and with matched retries, it exceeds LoRA's 77.28 +/- 1.95 MathAvg, improving all three task families and raising mean AIME accuracy from 48.33 to 60.56. Capacity-controlled comparisons favor addressable block changes and recurrent context; separate search training extends the interface to tool-mediated reasoning. These results establish controlled computation reuse as an effective route to parameter-efficient reasoning reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [445] [The Row Normalization Puzzle in Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39114)
*Jiayu Zhang,Tianyi Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究NorMuon中按行重归一化对收敛性的影响，理论上给出与Muon相比出现维度相关因子的下界与匹配上界，揭示其最坏情况保证与实践表现之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NorMuon在LLM预训练中被广泛采用且表现优异，但其最坏情况收敛保证仍缺乏理解。核心疑问是：按行归一化是否带来可证明的收敛增益，以及这是否源于其与近似极坐标计算和EMA动量的交互作用。

Method: 在算子范数几何下分析按行归一化的最坏情况迭代复杂度；在确定性情形建立算法相关的下界与匹配上界，并将上界分析扩展到随机情形；上下界分析均允许近似极坐标计算。

Result: 按行归一化在最坏情况迭代复杂度中引入了维度相关因子，该因子在精确极坐标计算和任意固定动量参数下依然存在。合成实验表明NorMuon比Muon更慢，但在LLM预训练中NorMuon反而优于Muon。

Conclusion: 行归一化不带来最坏情况下的可证明收敛增益，反而增加维度相关代价，这加深了其实际有效的理论谜题，并补充了Dewulf等人的近期发现。

Abstract: This paper examines how row-wise renormalization affects Muon, focusing on the gap between NorMuon's worst-case guarantees and its practical performance (Li et al.). Despite its growing adoption and promising performance in large language model (LLM) pretraining, NorMuon's worst-case guarantees remain poorly understood. One fundamental question is: Does row normalization yield provable convergence gains, potentially through its interaction with approximate polar computation and exponential moving-average momentum? Our results show that row normalization introduces a dimension-dependent factor in the worst-case iteration complexity under the operator-norm geometry, which persists even with exact polar computation and any fixed momentum parameters. Indeed, we establish an algorithm-dependent lower bound and a matching upper bound in deterministic settings, and extend our upper bound analysis to stochastic settings. Both upper-bound analyses allow approximate polar computation. Experiments show that NorMuon is slower than Muon on synthetic problems inspired by our worst-case construction, yet outperforms Muon in LLM pretraining. These findings sharpen the puzzle of why row normalization helps in practice and complement the recent findings of Dewulf et al.

</details>


### [446] [Prequential E-Values for Selected-GP Near-Optimality Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39123)
*Ami Tavory,Noa Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用prequential e-values对GP/RKHS置信包络进行可审计的选择，使自适应调节下的停止/认证规则保持anytime-valid，在噪声RBF压力测试中显著降低错误认证风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序贯优化昂贵黑箱函数（如超参优化）时，希望当最优评估值被证明在全局最优ε范围内即停止。认证需两部分：所选值的置信下界与定义域上的置信上包络（通常由GP提供）。GP-UCB停止规则在核与常数预先固定时有效，但实践中常从同一批自适应评估中调参包络，再当作固定来认证，导致有效性受损。

Method: 使用prequential e-values使该选择过程可审计：从预声明的一组完全指定的GP/RKHS包络出发，每个候选由其自身的一步超前e-process检验，被否定的候选删除，认证时使用幸存者中最大的上界。配合有效的所选点下界，且至少一个声明候选具有有效的潜在覆盖率与噪声校准，则规则anytime-valid。

Result: 在512种子噪声RBF压力扫描中，相比先拟合后认证，在相当功效下将错误认证风险约减半；在光滑d=3、4目标上相对于随机固定GP预承诺，每多一个错误认证分别伴随3.0和13.5个额外正确认证。

Conclusion: prequential e-values为自适应调参后的GP认证提供严格有效性保证，在控制错误认证的同时保持较高功效，代价是较温和的正确认证增益。

Abstract: When optimizing an expensive black-box function sequentially, as in hyperparameter optimization, we may want to stop once the best evaluated value is certified within $\varepsilon$ of the global optimum. Such a certificate needs two ingredients: a lower confidence bound for the selected value and an upper confidence envelope over the domain, typically supplied by a Gaussian process (GP). GP-UCB-style stopping rules are valid when the kernel and constants defining this envelope are fixed before the run, but the practical temptation is to tune the envelope from the same adaptive evaluations and then certify as if it had been fixed. We use prequential e-values to make this selection auditable: starting from a predeclared set of fully specified GP/RKHS envelopes, each candidate is tested by its own one-step-ahead e-process, contradicted candidates are deleted, and certification uses the largest upper bound among the survivors. With a valid selected-point lower bound and one declared candidate having valid latent coverage and noise calibration, the rule is anytime-valid. On a 512-seed noisy RBF stress sweep, it roughly halves false-certification risk at comparable power versus fit-then-certify. Relative to random fixed GP precommitment on smooth $d=3,4$ objectives, each additional false certificate is accompanied by 3.0 and 13.5 additional correct certificates, respectively.

</details>


### [447] [CDMD: A Cross-Dataset Mixed-Type Diffusion Model for Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39124)
*Mohamed Amine Ketata,Maximilian Schambach,Stephan Günnemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CDMD是一种在混合类型特征空间直接扩散的跨数据集表格生成模型，单模型训练即可在多数据集上达到最优生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格生成模型通常针对每个数据集单独训练，限制知识迁移且需存储大量专用模型；已有跨数据集扩散模型又在连续表示空间中操作。

Method: 直接在混合类型特征空间定义扩散并端到端训练；提出schema受限的掩码扩散逆过程参数化，输出空间随每个特征的词表动态调整；将数值与类别特征级扩散组合为依赖schema的行级过程；用共享的schema感知Transformer去噪器建模特征依赖。

Result: 在七个真实数据集上，单个联合训练的CDMD取得最高的平均生成质量，且总参数量远少于分别训练的模型集合；在337个数据集上预训练可提升对未见数据集的生成效果。

Conclusion: 直接混合类型扩散为共享且可迁移的表格数据生成提供了潜力。

Abstract: Generative models for tabular data are typically trained separately for each dataset, limiting knowledge transfer and requiring the storage of many specialized models. In this paper, we introduce CDMD, a tabular diffusion model trained jointly across heterogeneous datasets with different schemas and variable numbers of numerical and categorical features. Unlike existing cross-dataset tabular diffusion models that operate in continuous representation spaces, CDMD defines diffusion directly over the mixed-type feature space and is trained end-to-end. To accommodate heterogeneous categorical domains, we introduce a schema-restricted reverse-process parameterization for masked diffusion models, in which the output space dynamically adapts to each feature's vocabulary. We then compose numerical and categorical feature-level diffusion processes into a schema-dependent row-level process. A shared schema-aware Transformer denoiser captures dependencies between features and parameterizes the reverse process across varying schemas. On seven real-world datasets, a single jointly trained CDMD achieves the highest average generation quality among strong single-dataset and cross-dataset baselines, while using substantially fewer total parameters than the collection of separately trained models. Furthermore, pre-training on a corpus of 337 datasets improves generation on previously unseen datasets under both limited target data and limited adaptation epochs. These results demonstrate the potential of direct mixed-type diffusion for shared and transferable tabular data generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/ketatam/cdmd.

</details>


### [448] [Characterizing High Bandwidth Flash for LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39131)
*Zack Yu,Chloe Wong,Coleman Hooper,Minjae Lee,Wonjun Kang,Youngjin Cho,Michael W. Mahoney,Yakun Sophia Shao,Kurt Keutzer,Amir Gholami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文评估高带宽闪存(HBF)用于高吞吐LLM智能体服务的系统设计与调度，提出HBM-HBF-主机分层存储和缓存感知调度，仿真显示完成时间降低36.1-87.0%、能耗节省达55.8%，并将HBF写入寿命从4.77年延长至14.82年。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM服务需大量内存存储模型权重和KV缓存。随模型增大、上下文变长，内存容量与带宽成为服务性能瓶颈。智能体工作负载通过不断增长的上下文反复交互，进一步加剧压力，使保留KV状态以复用变得重要。HBF可扩展加速器内存容量，但其访问成本和有限写入寿命带来使用挑战，因此需评估何时增加容量能真正提升性能与能效。

Method: 面向高吞吐智能体服务评估HBF，在系统设计与调度选择上展开分析。提出HBM-HBF-主机分层存储系统与缓冲缓存感知调度（buffered cache-aware scheduling），并采用trace驱动的仿真分析其对性能、能耗及HBF写入寿命的影响。

Result: 在所评估工作负载中，最快的HBF增强系统相比仅HBM系统将完成时间减少36.1-87.0%；建模能耗节省最高达55.8%，但在部分轻负载下HBF反而增加能耗。缓冲缓存感知调度将估计的HBF写入寿命从4.77年延长到14.82年。

Conclusion: 结果表明，协调数据放置与调度对于提升服务效率并维持可实用的HBF写入寿命至关重要。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving requires substantial memory to store model weights and KV caches. As models grow larger and contexts become longer, memory capacity and bandwidth increasingly become bottlenecks for serving performance. Agentic workloads compound this pressure through repeated interactions over growing contexts, making it increasingly important to retain KV state for reuse. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers a way to expand accelerator memory capacity for large language model (LLM) serving, but its access costs and limited write endurance complicate its use. We evaluate HBF for high-throughput agentic serving across system design and scheduling choices to understand when additional capacity improves serving performance and energy efficiency. We introduce an HBM-HBF-host hierarchical storage system and buffered cache-aware scheduling, and use trace-driven simulations to analyze their effects on performance, energy consumption, and HBF write lifetime. Across the evaluated workloads, the fastest HBF-augmented systems reduce completion time by 36.1-87.0% relative to HBM-only systems. Modeled energy savings reach 55.8%, although HBF increases energy consumption on some light workloads. Buffered cache-aware scheduling extends estimated HBF write lifetime from 4.77 to 14.82 years in the evaluated configuration. These results demonstrate the importance of coordinating data placement and scheduling to improve serving efficiency while sustaining a practical HBF write lifetime.

</details>


### [449] [ID Balancing: Stable Training of Extremely Sparse MoE via PID-Based Load Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39137)
*Peng Jin,Zihan Qiu,Zekun Wang,Bo Zheng,Yang Xu,Tian Xie,Xiao Li,Huaqing Zhang,Haoran Lian,Rui Men,Dayiheng Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将无辅助损失的MoE负载均衡方法统一为不完整的PID控制器，提出ID Balancing（积分-微分控制器），在更高稀疏度下大幅降低专家负载不平衡并保持模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE通过稀疏路由实现参数规模扩展，但稀疏度提高导致专家负载不平衡加剧，降低参数利用率和训练效率，甚至危害训练稳定性，成为可靠扩展的瓶颈。

Method: 将DeepSeek的无损方法视为固定步长积分控制器，Kimi K3的Quantile Balancing视为广义比例控制器，从而统一为不完整PID控制器。据此提出ID Balancing：积分项随负载误差缩放，微分项仅在失衡恶化时激活，实现大误差/恶化时强校正、接近平衡时小更新。

Result: 在768专家、Top-10/5/3路由下，Top-3设置中最坏情况backbone MaxVio和训练平均backbone MinVio分别比最佳基线降低超50%和12%。参数从18.9B增至69.9B（Top-10-of-768）时，最坏情况MaxVio几乎不变，比辅助损失基线低约89.6%，并保持有竞争力的语言建模与下游性能。

Conclusion: ID Balancing优势随稀疏度增加而增强，是扩展更大、更稀疏MoE模型的有前景方案。

Abstract: Scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) via Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables massive parameter growth with nearly constant per-token computation. However, further scaling the parameter count requires increasingly sparse routing, where expert load imbalance becomes more severe. This imbalance reduces parameter utilization and training efficiency, and can undermine training stability, becoming a bottleneck to reliable scaling. In this work, we unify two representative auxiliary-loss-free methods as incomplete Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers: DeepSeek's loss-free method acts as a fixed-step integral controller, while Kimi K3's Quantile Balancing functions as a generalized proportional controller. Building on this control perspective, we propose ID Balancing, an Integral-Derivative controller. It scales its integral term with load error and activates its derivative term only when imbalance worsens, enabling stronger corrections for large or worsening errors and smaller updates near balance. Evaluated across Top-$10$, Top-$5$, and Top-$3$ routing over $768$ experts, ID Balancing reduces worst-case backbone MaxVio and training-average backbone MinVio by over $50\%$ and $12\%$, respectively, relative to the best baselines in the Top-$3$ setting. When the total parameter count increases from $18.9$B to $69.9$B (Top-$10$-of-$768$), ID Balancing's worst-case backbone MaxVio remains nearly unchanged and is approximately $89.6\%$ lower than that of the auxiliary-loss baseline. ID Balancing also maintains competitive language-modeling and downstream performance. The advantages of ID Balancing grow as sparsity increases, making it a promising solution for scaling larger, sparser MoE models.

</details>


### [450] [QuanVI: Score-based Variational Inference via Quantum Maximally Mixed States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39164)
*Yuchen Cong,Zerui Tao,Chao Li,Zhe Sun,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QuanVI，用混合态密度算符结合量子张量网络（MPO）参数化，解决score-based VI中特征值方法的高维障碍，可扩展到高维非高斯目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Score-based VI通过最小化Fisher散度提供替代KL-VI的方案，其先前的特征值形式变分分布由低能本征态构成，但在高维下存在两大障碍：参数数量随维度指数增长；低能简并或近简并子空间中的本征向量不唯一。

Method: QuanVI = 混合态密度算符形式 + 量子张量网络参数化。用最大混合态表示简并低能子空间（避免依赖不唯一的单个本征向量），用矩阵乘积算符（MPO）结构压缩密度算符，避免参数指数增长。

Result: 实验与消融显示：低维下与精确解一致；可扩展到高维合成基准与贝叶斯后验近似基准，包括具有挑战性的非高斯目标。

Conclusion: QuanVI为score-based VI提供了一种可扩展的量子启发算法，通过密度算符与张量网络结合克服了高维简并问题。

Abstract: Score-based variational inference (VI) provides an alternative to Kullback--Leibler (KL)-based VI by minimizing the Fisher divergence between the variational distribution and the target. A prior score-VI approach formulates this optimization as an eigenvalue problem, with the variational distribution constructed from low-energy eigenstates. However, this eigenvalue-based formulation faces two high-dimensional obstacles: an intractably large parameter count due to exponential scaling and non-uniqueness of individual eigenvectors in degenerate or nearly degenerate low-energy subspaces. We propose QuanVI, a scalable quantum-inspired algorithm that combines a mixed-state density-operator formulation with a quantum tensor network (QTN) parameterization using the matrix product operator (MPO) structure. In degenerate low-energy subspaces, the density-operator formulation represents the subspace by its maximally mixed state rather than relying on a non-unique individual eigenvector, while the QTN parameterization compresses the density operator to avoid exponential parameter growth. Experiments and ablations show that QuanVI agrees with exact solutions in low dimensions and scales to high-dimensional synthetic and Bayesian posterior-approximation benchmarks, including challenging non-Gaussian targets.

</details>


### [451] [Whitening Improves Robustness to Spurious Correlations in Linear Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39177)
*Floris Holstege,Bram Wouters,Noud van Giersbergen,Cees Diks*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性探针中深度网络依赖虚假特征的问题，发现max-margin分类器偏好大特征值方向，提出白化作为预处理来减少虚假相关依赖并提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络倾向依赖可能虚假的简单特征，导致泛化失败。作者希望在不需先验知识或标注数据的情况下减少对虚假相关的依赖。

Method: 在线性探针设定下，利用广义线性模型与max-margin分类器的联系，分析其偏好大特征值方向；通过白化均衡协方差矩阵特征值以消除该偏好，并将其作为预处理步骤。

Result: 在合成数据生成过程和标准虚假相关基准上验证，白化提升了鲁棒性；加入现有方法中也能提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 白化是一种无需标注或先验知识、可减少虚假相关依赖并提升鲁棒性的有效预处理方法，且可与现有方法结合使用。

Abstract: Deep neural networks tend to rely on simple features that may be spurious and thus fail to generalize. We study this problem in the setting of linear probes, where a (generalized) linear model is fitted on the representations of a (pretrained) model. We use the connection of these models to the max-margin classifier, and show they favor directions associated with large eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. Whitening removes this preference by equalizing the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. This observation motivates whitening as a preprocessing step that can reduce reliance on spurious correlations without requiring prior knowledge of their presence or labeled data. We examine the effect of whitening on a synthetic data-generating process and standard spurious correlation benchmarks, and find that it improves robustness. We also find that whitening can improve robustness when added to existing approaches.

</details>


### [452] [Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39185)
*Snigdha Chandan Khilar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mamba式与混合语言模型将历史压缩为每步都重写的定长循环状态。低精度存储状态虽省带宽，但每步舍入误差会被反馈并累积。作者发现一种无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动（golden-ratio Weyl dither），在多种模型、存储格式和长解码场景下，比随机舍入更接近全精度模型，且零额外成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产系统以低精度存储循环状态以节省内存带宽，但每步重写状态会使舍入误差被反复反馈、长期累积。业界常用随机舍入，但缺乏对不同舍入规则在长生成场景下表现的系统研究。

Method: 对比不同舍入规则（随机舍入、就近舍入、以及提出的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动），在纯Mamba与混合模型、多种存储格式、长解码时长下评估量化模型与全精度模型的接近程度；并通过误差差异分析解释排序原因。

Result: 确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动无需随机数，在各场景下均比随机舍入更接近全精度模型且无额外开销。就近舍入因丢弃微小更新导致误差持续增长，短期评估看似最优，长期生成则明显落后。分析解释了这一排序，并记录了会静默消除该收益的实现陷阱。

Conclusion: 循环状态量化缓存应采用确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动作为舍入规则，它无需随机性、零成本且在长生成中一致优于随机舍入；评估须覆盖长解码时长，并警惕实现陷阱。

Abstract: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precision one than stochastic rounding, across pure and hybrid models, storage formats, and long decoding horizons, at no extra cost. Round-to-nearest behaves differently: because it discards small updates, its error keeps growing, so it can look best in short evaluations yet falls far behind over long generations. A discrepancy analysis explains this ordering, and we document implementation pitfalls that silently remove the benefit.

</details>


### [453] [Attention Function as an Intrinsic Inductive Bias: How Models' Behavior Diverges in Novel Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39188)
*Dong Gyun Kang,Megha Thukral,Kwangsoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出MoFA（Mixture of Function Attention），在训练前固定softmax与sigmoid注意力头的比例，发现该比例在分布内影响甚微，但在零样本分布偏移下影响剧烈，表明激活函数可充当"先天先验"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发展心理学认为婴儿具有先于经验的先验，其在强约束条件下被抑制、在弱条件下重新显现。作者想验证Transformer是否也有类似机制，即注意力头的激活函数能否作为内在归纳偏置。

Method: 提出MoFA：对多头注意力做无参数修改，在训练前固定softmax头与sigmoid头的比例。在5种比例、124M参数GPT-2模型、5个随机种子上进行实验。

Result: 分布内各比例差异统计上可忽略（中等混合几乎无差，极端情况差异也小）；但在15个分布外领域的零样本偏移下差异剧增，困惑度差距扩大逾一个数量级。最佳比例沿单一域结构轴变化：短文本/非正式（偏好softmax）vs 技术长文本（偏好sigmoid），解释78.3%方差。头层面：sigmoid头随比例增加注意力熵加速下降，softmax头响应温和，形成稳定分工。

Conclusion: 激活函数的选择可作为一种"先天先验"，其影响在分布内被掩盖、在分布外重新显现，印证了发展心理学中先验被强约束抑制、弱条件下重生的原理。

Abstract: Developmental psychology holds that certain priors are given to infants prior to experience rather than induced from data, and that the influence of such priors is suppressed under strong, well-constrained conditions but reasserts itself under weak ones. We ask whether an analogous principle holds for the Transformer: can the activation function given to attention heads serve as an intrinsic inductive bias? We propose Mixture of Function Attention (MoFA), a parameter-free modification to multi-head attention that fixes a ratio of softmax and sigmoid heads before training. Across five ratios, a 124M-parameter GPT-2 model, and five seeds, we find that this given ratio has little effect in-distribution -- differences between ratios are statistically negligible for moderate mixtures and remain small even at the extremes -- but its influence re-emerges sharply under zero-shot distribution shift across 15 out-of-distribution domains. Perplexity gaps between ratios widen by more than an order of magnitude on several domains, and the best-performing ratio tracks a single axis of domain structure, separating short, informal text (softmax-favoring) from technical, long-form text (sigmoid-favoring), that explains 78.3% of the variance in domain response. This reorganization is visible at the head level: sigmoid heads show an accelerating drop in attention entropy as their ratio increases, while softmax heads respond more modestly, yielding a consistent division of labor between the two head types. Our results suggest that activation choice functions as a given prior whose influence is masked in-distribution and re-emerges out-of-distribution.

</details>


### [454] [Importance-Aware Feature Sparsification for Wireless Split Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39194)
*Bumjun Kim,Yoon Huh,Wan Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ICS方法，由服务器用Grad-CAM分数对特征通道排序，生成类别平衡的重要性向量供客户端复用以剪枝，无需额外客户端计算，提升非i.i.d.场景下SL精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线拆分学习(SL)将上层卸载到服务器以减少端侧计算，但每轮传输高维中间特征造成通信瓶颈。现有客户端特征选择方法依赖任务无关准则(幅值、统计、聚类)，增加客户端处理且非i.i.d.数据下精度下降。

Method: ICS：服务器用反向传播中真实类别logit的Grad-CAM分数对特征通道排序，将各类分数聚合为类别平衡、标签无关的重要性向量，缓解标签偏斜下的头部类偏差；客户端下轮复用该向量保留top-N通道，不增加前向/反向计算。推导非渐近收敛界，分析稀疏化误差及稀疏比与小批量大小的联合影响，评估通信与计算开销，并扩展到并行SL和Transformer模型。

Result: 实验表明ICS持续优于基线，在严重非i.i.d.划分下增益更大。

Conclusion: ICS通过服务器端Grad-CAM重要性排序实现轻量级、类别平衡的特征稀疏化，降低通信开销并提升非i.i.d.场景精度，且可推广至并行SL与Transformer模型。

Abstract: Wireless split learning (SL) reduces on-device computation by offloading upper layers to a server, yet transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features at each iteration remains a major communication bottleneck. Existing methods select features at the client side using task-agnostic criteria such as magnitude, statistics, or clustering, which increases client-side processing and often degrades accuracy under non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) client data. We propose importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), a lightweight approach in which the server ranks feature channels using Grad-CAM-based scores obtained from the true-class logit during backpropagation. The per-class scores are aggregated into a class-balanced, label-agnostic importance vector that mitigates head-class bias under label skew, and each client reuses this vector in the next round to retain the top-$N$ feature channels, incurring no additional client-side forward or backward passes. We further derive a non-asymptotic convergence bound that isolates the sparsification-induced error and characterizes how the sparsification ratio and mini-batch size jointly affect convergence under a fixed communication budget, and we analyze the communication and computational overhead of ICS against representative baselines. Beyond sequential CNN-based SL, we extend ICS to parallel split learning and to transformer-based models. Experiments show that ICS consistently outperforms the baselines, with larger gains under severe non-i.i.d. partitions.

</details>


### [455] [In a Streaming World, Should You Stand Still? A Comprehensive Benchmark of Anomaly Detection in Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39215)
*Magali Parrino,Antoine Ajenjo,Emmanuel Remy,Pierre Stephan,Pierre Senellart,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次大规模对比流式与静态时间序列异常检测(TSAD)方法，发现在真实流式场景下静态方法显著优于流式方法，暴露了现有流式方法设计与现代TSAD需求的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式TSAD方法多源自流式离群点检测文献，忽略了时间序列异常的核心特性，且评估多基于合成或小型基准，难以判断其真实优势。

Method: 在统一的流式评估基准下，开展首次大规模实验研究，模拟初始批次训练+在线评估的realistic设置，评估检测准确率与计算效率；并提出基于真实时间序列的分布漂移数据集TSB-drift。

Result: 与普遍假设相反，静态TSAD方法在大多数流式设置中显著优于流式方法。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了现有流式方法设计与现代TSAD需求之间的关键差距，呼吁重新思考如何将流式能力整合进TSAD。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is increasingly deployed in streaming settings, where data arrive sequentially and may exhibit non-stationarity. As a result, several works from the recent literature propose streaming anomaly detection methods that rely on incremental updates to adapt over time. However, most of these approaches originate from the streaming outlier detection literature and largely ignore core characteristics of time series anomalies. Moreover, their empirical evaluation is typically conducted on synthetic or small-scale benchmarks with limited diversity, making it unclear whether streaming methods are truly advantageous in realistic TSAD scenarios. In this work, we carry out the first large-scale experimental study comparing streaming and static TSAD methods under a unified streaming evaluation benchmark. We consider a realistic setting in which an initial batch of data is available for model training, followed by online evaluation of both detection accuracy and computational efficiency. In addition, we propose a distribution-drift dataset of real time series, called TSB- drift, to isolate scenarios where streaming updates are theoretically justified. Our results show that, contrary to common assumptions, static TSAD methods significantly outperform streaming approaches in most streaming settings. Such finding highlights a critical gap between the design of existing streaming methods and the requirements of modern TSAD, and calls for a rethinking of how streaming capabilities should be integrated into TSAD.

</details>


### [456] [QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39223)
*Weili Xu,Jisen Li,Yuqing Jian,Chenxi Li,Zhizhou Sha,Yifan Yu,Qingyang Wu,Chenfeng Xu,Zhongzhu Zhou,Tianyi Zhang,Ben Athiwaratkun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QATFactory 是一个开源框架，用于部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏（QAD）与强化学习（QARL），在 BF16 硬件上模拟低精度量化训练，将模型直接导出到 vLLM 和 llama.cpp。在 8B–230B 模型上，QAD 在 NVFP4/MXFP4/Q4_K 等格式下持续优于强 PTQ 基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理日益走向低精度以发挥硬件加速器吞吐，但激进的后训练量化（PTQ）会损害模型质量，需要一种能在不具备目标格式原生支持的硬件上进行的量化感知训练方案。

Method: 提出 QATFactory：在 BF16 矩阵乘法中模拟部署时量化，使模型适应量化噪声，无需原生支持目标格式的训练硬件（如在 H100 上训练 NVFP4）。支持 NVFP4、MXFP4 和 llama.cpp Q4_K，覆盖稠密与 MoE 模型，以及全参数与 LoRA 训练；可将 checkpoint 直接导出至 vLLM 和 llama.cpp，无需额外有损转换或推理开销。

Result: 在 8B–230B 模型上的广泛实验表明，QAD 在生产推理引擎中的部署质量持续超过强 PTQ 基线。Qwen3.5-9B 上，QAD 在 NVFP4 下平均基准准确率 68.9%、MXFP4 下 66.0%，优于最佳 PTQ 的 65.4% 与 56.4%。发现最佳训练策略依赖格式：NVFP4 在仅量化权重时更优，MXFP4 则需同时量化权重与激活。固定 token 预算下，用更少的 32K 序列训练比更多 4K 序列平均提升 1.9 个百分点。

Conclusion: QATFactory 证明部署对齐的量化感知蒸馏可有效缓解激进量化带来的质量下降，并揭示训练策略与量化格式相关。作者开源完整训练代码与所得 checkpoint。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without requiring training hardware that natively supports the target format; for example, it supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs, which lack FP4 Tensor Cores. The framework supports NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format; dense and mixture-of-experts models; and both full-parameter and LoRA-based training. It exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp without an additional lossy conversion step or added inference overhead. With QATFactory, we conduct extensive experiments on models ranging from 8B to 230B parameters and evaluate exported checkpoints in production inference engines. Across models and formats, QAD consistently improves deployed-model quality over strong PTQ baselines. On Qwen3.5-9B, QAD achieves average benchmark accuracies of 68.9% under NVFP4 and 66.0% under MXFP4, outperforming the best PTQ results of 65.4% and 56.4%, respectively. Through our experiments, we found that although both FP4 formats quantize weights and activations at deployment, the best training strategy is format-dependent: NVFP4 generally performs better when only weights are quantized during training, whereas MXFP4 benefits from quantizing both weights and activations. At a fixed training token budget, training on fewer 32K sequences improves average accuracy by 1.9 points over training on more 4K sequences. We release the complete QATFactory training code and the resulting checkpoints.

</details>


### [457] [What Streaming Anomaly Detection Finds (and Misses) in Industrial Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39232)
*Magali Parrino,Antoine Ajenjo,Emmanuel Remy,Pierre Stephan,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在真实核电站数据集上对比流式异常检测方法与在线部署的时序异常检测（TSAD）模型，并评估自动异常检测，发现在线TSAD一致性更高、集成策略鲁棒性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EDF需对电厂持续监控以尽早发现异常，但无监督场景下不存在通用最优的流式方法，故需在真实数据上对比流式方法与在线TSAD模型，并评估自动化异常检测在流式环境下的表现。

Method: 在真实核电站数据集上，将流式方法与当前最优的TSAD模型以在线方式部署并进行对比，同时针对流式上下文评估自动异常检测（Automated Anomaly Detection）。

Result: 在线TSAD表现出一致性更高，集成（ensembling）策略展现出很强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 在无监督流式异常检测缺乏通用最优方法的情况下，在线TSAD与集成策略是核电站监控中更可靠的选择。

Abstract: EDF relies on continuous monitoring of its power plants to detect anomalies as soon as they occur. Given the absence of a universally optimal streaming method in unsupervised settings, we compare streaming methods with state-of-the-art TSAD models deployed online on a real nuclear power plant dataset. This work also evaluates Automated Anomaly Detection in a streaming context. Results show higher consistency for online TSAD and strong robustness from ensembling strategies.

</details>


### [458] [A differentiability framework for zigzag persistent homology via linear interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39242)
*Enrico Maria Ferrari,Clemens Bannwart,Matteo Biagetti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 为 zigzag persistence 建立可微分框架，支持随时间非单调演化的拓扑结构进入学习流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久同调可微分并已集成到学习流程，但 zigzag persistence（结构随时间非单调变化时所需）尚无类似框架。

Method: 对固定复形上时变过滤值做阈值化得到单纯复形序列；用线性插值过滤值穿越阈值的实数时间标记持久图端点，将过滤值连续性转移到图点上，得到图值映射的局部光滑提升，并在温和正则条件下推导几乎处处微分；证明排除集（显式零测集）外的局部 Lipschitz 连续性。

Result: 标准随机次梯度收敛保证不直接适用；但论证排除集在实践中足够小，可有效优化。在传感器网络覆盖优化与动态图分类两个实验中验证。

Conclusion: 该框架使 zigzag persistence 具备可微分性，尽管缺乏标准收敛保证，实际优化仍可行且有效。

Abstract: Persistent homology can be differentiated and incorporated into learning pipelines, but no analogous framework exists for zigzag persistence, which is needed when the underlying topological structure evolves non-monotonically over time. We develop such a framework for sequences of simplicial complexes obtained by thresholding time-dependent filtering values on a fixed complex. By assigning persistence diagram endpoints the real-valued times at which linearly interpolated filtering values cross the threshold, we transfer the continuity of the filtering values to the diagram points. This yields smooth local lifts of the resulting persistence-diagram-valued map, from which we derive differentials almost everywhere under mild regularity conditions on the parametrization of the filtering values. We prove local Lipschitz continuity outside an explicit measure-zero exclusion set; standard stochastic subgradient convergence guarantees therefore do not apply directly. We argue that, even without such guarantees, this exclusion set is small enough in practice to allow effective optimization. We test this empirically in two experiments: sensor network coverage optimization and dynamic graph classification.

</details>


### [459] [Right Answer, Wrong Mechanism: Detecting Pernicious Divergence in Causal Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39243)
*Beiming Liu,Minjie Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文通过植入隐藏通路，发现现有因果干预方法常通过非自然机制产生预期结果，并难以区分无害与有害偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果干预（如activation patching、DAS）是神经网络机制分析的主要工具，但干预常使表征偏离自然分布——有时无害、有时会激活模型自然输入下不用的通路，导致"正确答案、错误机制"。现有方法无法区分这两种情况。

Method: 在预训练语言模型中植入隐藏通路（构造上对基准提示静默），使依赖该通路的干预可被精确识别；在GPT-2 small上运行72种配置、100,800次干预；提出无标签测试HPC——将下游单元钳制到相同输出的自然运行区间，测量决策消失程度。

Result: (i) 最近邻与local-PCA距离判别植物通路的AUROC仅0.35-0.47，低于随机；(ii) HPC在通路表现为单元级越界活动时AUROC≥0.99，但当所有单元保持在自然范围时失效；(iii) 优化干预会主动寻找隐藏通路：性别任务上DAS 3/4家族90-95%的成功经由植物通路，加on-manifold惩罚后降至5%以下，代价是成功率损失6-11个百分点；未修改GPT-2中成功干预几乎不依赖单元级越界。

Conclusion: 现有分布外检测指标无法识别通过隐藏通路实现的干预成功；HPC可有效检测单元级越界情形，但"全单元在自然范围内"仍是开放问题；优化干预会系统性利用隐藏通路，需引入on-manifold约束。

Abstract: Causal interventions such as activation patching and distributed alignment search (DAS) are the main tool for making mechanistic claims about neural networks. Recent work showed that these interventions routinely push representations off the model's natural distribution, and that such divergence is sometimes harmless and sometimes pernicious: it can recruit pathways the model never uses on natural inputs, so that an intervention produces the expected answer through the wrong mechanism. No method currently tells the two cases apart. We make this question testable by planting hidden pathways inside pretrained language models; the pathways are silent on every benchmark prompt by construction, so which interventions depend on them is known exactly. Across 72 configurations and 100,800 interventions on GPT-2 small, we find three things. (i) Nearest-neighbour and local-PCA distances at the intervention site, as used in prior work, score below chance (AUROC 0.35-0.47) at picking out interventions that give the right answer through a planted pathway. (ii) Hidden-Pathway Contribution (HPC), a label-free test that clamps downstream units to the regime of natural runs with the same output and measures how much of the decision disappears, flags pathway-dominated interventions with AUROC >= 0.99 when the pathway shows up as unit-level out-of-regime activity, but fails when every unit stays within its natural range, which we identify as the open problem. (iii) Optimised interventions actively seek hidden pathways: on a gender task, DAS routes 90-95% of its successes through planted pathways for three of four families, and a downstream on-manifold penalty cuts this share to under 5% at a cost of 6-11 points of success rate. In unmodified GPT-2, successful interventions show almost no unit-level out-of-regime reliance.

</details>


### [460] [Trust the Critic More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39247)
*Kaiyue Wen,Luke Bailey,Arvind Mahankali,Tengyu Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 AC2，用动作块级 critic 信用分配替代传统 token 级终端奖励分配，无需将每条轨迹 rollout 到终点，在 IMO-ProofBench 上以更少 FLOPs 超越 GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 LLM RL 给长轨迹所有 token 同一优势值，actor-critic 虽能细粒度分配，但学习到的 critic 被认为不准确，仅用作 baseline，导致每条轨迹必须跑到终点。作者希望打破这一限制。

Method: AC2 将信用分配给动作块（前缀的短延续），由 critic 给块末状态打分，使策略无需终端奖励即可更新。三个关键设计：1) local readiness，仅在 critic 对某问题足够准确时使用其更新；2) 提供此前成功 rollout 的参考解给 critic；3) 以 10k token 的动作块而非单 token 分配信用。在 FineProofs-RL 上训练 Qwen3-4B。

Result: AC2 超过 GRPO 峰值验证分数 18.5%，且解码 FLOPs 减少 2.5 倍。收益来自两方面：达到该分数所需训练步数减少 25%；每步生成更少 token，因为策略无需将每条轨迹跑到终点。

Conclusion: 从概念上证明可以消除"每条轨迹必须 rollout 到完成"的需求，为 LLM RL 算法开辟了此前未被探索的广阔设计空间。

Abstract: Standard language model RL algorithms credit every token of a long rollout with the same advantage determined by the terminal reward. Actor-critic methods can provide finer-grained credit assignment, but learned critics are generally considered too inaccurate to trust when training LLMs with RL. In recent works, even when a critic is present, it is used only for baseline estimation, so every trajectory must be rolled out to its terminal reward. We introduce Actor-Critic with Action Chunking (AC2) that removes the need to roll every trajectory to completion. AC2 instead assigns credit to action chunks: short continuations of prefixes of past trajectories. A learned critic scores the state reached at the end of each action chunk, allowing the policy to update without observing a terminal reward. We make critic-based credit assignment reliable through three design choices. First, we introduce local readiness which uses critic-based updates on a problem only when the critic is sufficiently accurate on that particular problem. Second, when available, we provide the critic with a reference solution from a previous successful rollout. Third, we assign credit over action chunks of 10k tokens rather than individual tokens, giving the critic a more meaningful portion of the trajectory to evaluate. We train Qwen3-4B on FineProofs-RL using AC2 and evaluate on IMO-ProofBench. AC2 exceeds GRPO's peak validation score of 18.5% using 2.5x fewer decoding FLOPs. This gain comes from two sources, (1) AC2 requires 25% fewer training steps to reach this score, and (2) each step generates fewer tokens because the policy does not need to continue every trajectory to completion. Conceptually, we demonstrate that we can remove the need to roll out every trajectory to completion, opening up a large previously unexplored design space for LLM RL algorithms.

</details>


### [461] [Client and Training Data Selection for Computationally Efficient Synchronized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39250)
*Muzaffer Citir,Hiroki Nishikawa,Sangyoung Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中掉队客户端与非独立同分布(non-iid)数据导致的收敛慢问题，提出一种联合客户端-训练数据选择算法，在CIFAR-100上显著加速收敛并提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习通过不上传原始数据保护隐私，但存在两大收敛难题：一是掉队客户端造成聚合延迟，二是客户端间non-iid数据分布。尤其在客户端数量较少时，现有基于概率的客户端选择方法在non-iid数据下表现不佳，作者展示了其失败场景。

Method: 提出一种联合客户端-训练数据选择算法(joint client-training data selection)，同时考虑non-iid数据以及异构计算能力，以加速全局模型收敛。

Result: 在CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，相比能处理non-iid数据和异构计算的先前工作，该方法的联邦模型收敛显著加快，且模型精度更高。

Conclusion: 联合优化客户端选择与训练数据选择可有效应对掉队者与non-iid数据问题，实现FL模型快速收敛与更高精度。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising paradigm of machine learning, which preserves user privacy by enabling learning without sharing raw data with a cloud server. Straggling clients have been a problem for FL as they introduce delays in aggregating the local models and hence, the convergence of the global model. Therefore, it is important to have a mechanism that ensures fast convergence of the global model as well as good FL participation rate. Another issue for the convergence of a model in FL is the non-independent and identically distributed (non-iid) data across the clients. Prior approaches based on probabilistic client selection do not work well under non-iid data especially when the number of clients is small. We show scenarios where such approaches fail and propose a joint client-training data selection algorithm for fast convergence of FL models. Our experiments on CIFAR-100 dataset show that convergence of the FL model can be significantly improved over prior works that can consider non-iid data and heterogeneous computation and higher model accuracy.

</details>


### [462] [From Benchmarks to Production: Transferring Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods for Electricity Production Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39257)
*Nicolas Vautier,Paul Caron,Nardi Xhepi,Félicie Bizeul,Manel Boumghar,Christophe Degouy,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EDF提出TAMIS系统，用于短期电力生产预测中的异常检测，通过分析日生产时间序列、基于历史模式学习自动识别异常日，兼顾可扩展性与可解释性，并已公开数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力生产预测对能源企业运营效率与战略规划至关重要，工业场景需每日生成预测以平衡供需、优化资产管理。但现代电力系统与数据流日益复杂，预测的可靠性与一致性面临挑战，需检测预测中可能反映数据质量或运营异常的异常模式。

Method: 将问题定义为识别非典型的日内模式（短期生产预测异常检测）。提出TAMIS系统，分析每日生产时间序列，基于从历史数据学到的模式偏离来自动检测异常日；面向人在回路工作流，通过每日自动简报呈现排名靠前的异常，支持专家高效复核与持续监控。

Result: 在真实工业数据上的大量实验表明，TAMIS相比基线方法实现了最佳的精度-效率权衡。同时公开了研究中使用的匿名化应用数据集，以促进后续研究与可复现性。

Conclusion: TAMIS为EDF短期电力生产预测提供了可扩展、可解释的异常检测方案，适用于工业级人在回路监控，并在真实数据上验证了其精度与效率优势，公开数据集有助于推动相关研究。

Abstract: Accurate forecasting of electricity production is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency and strategic planning of energy utilities. In industrial settings, such forecasts are generated daily to ensure supply-demand balance and optimal management of production assets. However, the increasing complexity of modern power systems and data flows poses significant challenges for ensuring the reliability and consistency of these forecasts. This paper addresses the problem of anomaly detection in short-term production forecasts at EDF, formulated as identifying atypical intra-day patterns that may signal data quality issues or operational irregularities. We introduce TAMIS, a scalable and interpretable system that analyzes daily production time series to automatically detect anomalous days based on deviations from historical patterns learned from past data. Designed for human-in-the-loop workflows, TAMIS surfaces top-ranked anomalies through an automated daily newsletter, enabling efficient expert review and continuous monitoring. An extensive experimental evaluation on real-world industrial data demonstrates that TAMIS achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off compared to baseline methods. To foster further research and reproducibility, we publicly release the anonymized application datasets used in our study.

</details>


### [463] [A Tilted Bowl Is Not a Slippery Slope: Compressing Looped Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39277)
*Steven Kolawole,Pearse Jim,Opegbemi M. Busoye,Glory Bagai,Virginia Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究循环模型的权重压缩崩溃问题，发现崩溃并非源于舍入误差累积，而是循环收敛点漂移所致，并据此提出恢复策略与控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环模型通过重复应用同一权重块进行推理，压缩该权重块可节省每次循环的内存流量。但压缩后的循环模型常发生崩溃，通常被归因于逐圈累积的舍入误差。作者希望检验这一解释是否正确。

Method: 在来自五个家族、超过30个模型上进行测试，分析循环是否收敛与舍入误差累积的关系；提出无标签的单次测量来预测哪些模型会失败，并设计一个控制器，在模型停止头触发时停止，随后用8位权重的循环完成推理。

Result: 发现舍入误差累积仅发生在永不收敛的循环中；当循环收敛时，固定的舍入误差不会累积，而是移动收敛点（类似倾斜碗使球停在不同位置），仅当偏移超过读出容忍度时答案才丢失。基于此可预测失败模型，并解释失败模型的恢复：其循环仍收敛，最后几步8位循环可恢复答案。在Sudoku-Extreme和Maze-Hard上，控制器以约三分之一的权重流量击败固定深度推理最多15个点。

Conclusion: 压缩循环模型的崩溃主要不是舍入误差累积，而是收敛点漂移；利用收敛特性可预测失败、恢复答案，并通过停止头加8位循环的控制器实现更高效且更准确的推理。

Abstract: Looped models reason by applying the same block of weights many times, so compressing that block saves memory traffic on every loop. Compressed looped models, however, often collapse, and the collapse is usually blamed on rounding error that accumulates from loop to loop. In this work we test that account on more than 30 models from five families and find, to our surprise, that it holds only for loops that never settle. When a loop settles, a fixed rounding error does not accumulate. It moves the point where the loop settles, much as tilting a bowl moves where a ball comes to rest, and the answer is lost only when the shift is larger than the readout tolerates. This picture lets us predict which models fail from a single label-free measurement, and it tells us why failed models recover: their loops still settle, so a few final loops with 8-bit weights bring the answer back. Motivated by these findings, we build a controller that stops when the model's halting head fires and then finishes with 8-bit loops. On Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Hard it beats fixed-depth inference by up to 15 points under a third of the weight traffic.

</details>


### [464] [A Time-Aware Bag-of-Receptive-Fields for Interpretable Irregular Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39268)
*Francesco Spinnato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将BORF变换扩展到不规则时间序列，提出时间加权归一化方案，结合高效滑窗递推保持线性复杂度，在PYRREGULAR数据集上取得有竞争力的分类性能，并具备可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则时间序列广泛存在于医疗、移动性和环境监测中，但现有分类方法要么依赖插补（掩盖时间结构），要么使用复杂难解释的神经网络，缺乏有效且可解释的分类器。

Method: 扩展BORF（Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields）变换至不规则设置，核心是时间加权归一化：按每个观测的时间增量比例加权，使模式提取反映实际时间分布而非仅索引位置；推导时间加权标准差的高效滑窗递推，保持BORF的线性时间复杂度。

Result: 在PYRREGULAR仓库数据集上与最先进的不规则时间序列分类器对比，取得有竞争力的分类性能，同时提供人类可解释的说明。

Conclusion: 该方法为不规则时间序列提供了快速、确定性、可解释且具竞争力的分类方案，平衡了性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Irregular time series, characterized by non-uniform sampling intervals, missing observations, and variable lengths, are ubiquitous in healthcare, mobility, and environmental monitoring, yet effective and interpretable classifiers for this setting are limited. Existing approaches often rely on imputation, which can obscure the temporal structure of the data, or require complex neural architectures that are opaque and difficult to explain. In this work, we extend the Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields (BORF), a fast, deterministic, and interpretable transform for time series, to the irregular setting. Our key contribution is a time-weighted normalization scheme in which each observation is weighted proportionally to its associated time delta, making pattern extraction sensitive to the actual temporal distribution of samples rather than only their index position. This requires deriving an efficient sliding-window recurrence for the time-weighted standard deviation, preserving the linear time complexity of BORF. We benchmark the resulting method against state-of-the-art irregular time series classifiers on datasets from the PYRREGULAR repository, demonstrating competitive classification performance with the added benefit of human-interpretable explanations.

</details>


### [465] [RW-Flow: One-Step Generation on Compact Manifolds via Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39271)
*Ualibyek Nurgulan,Seungwoo Yoo,Prin Phunyaphibarn,Minhyuk Sung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RW-Flow：基于Wasserstein梯度流的紧流形一步生成模型框架，通过Sinkhorn散度构造可识别的速度场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流形值数据（如地理事件、分子扭转角）广泛存在，现有扩散/流模型虽已扩展到紧流形，但采样需数十至数百次串行网络评估，效率低。

Method: 提出RW-Flow，利用Wasserstein梯度流学习紧流形上的一步生成模型。核心挑战是�identifiability：将速度场驱动至零须保证模型分布匹配目标分布。作者建立了紧连通黎曼流形上可识别性的充要条件，证明对对称Lipschitz连续代价函数，Sinkhorn散度诱导的速度场可识别当且仅当相应Gibbs核非退化。

Result: 给出�设计可识别代价函数的一般原则；发现平方测地距离（欧氏平方距离的自然流形类比）并非总能保证可识别性。在地理事件、蛋白质侧链扭转角、RNA骨架扭转角及三角网格离散的一般流形等基准上，RW-Flow在公平比较下几乎全面优于现有一步方法。

Conclusion: RW-Flow为紧流形上可识别的一步生成模型提供了理论基础与实用框架，性能优于现有一步法。

Abstract: Manifold-valued data, and consequently the distributions they induce, are prevalent across many domains, ranging from the locations of geospatial events, such as earthquakes, to biomolecular torsion angles that encode information about three-dimensional structure. While diffusion and flow-based generative models have been successfully extended to compact manifolds, sampling typically requires tens or hundreds of sequential network evaluations. We introduce RW-Flow, a theoretically grounded framework for learning one-step generative models on compact manifolds via Wasserstein gradient flows. The main challenge is identifiability: driving the velocity field to zero should guarantee that the model distribution matches the target distribution. We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for identifiability on compact, connected Riemannian manifolds. We specifically show that, for a symmetric, Lipschitz-continuous cost function, the velocity field induced by the Sinkhorn divergence is identifiable if and only if the associated Gibbs kernel is nondegenerate. This characterization provides a general principle for designing identifiable costs on compact manifolds. It also reveals that the squared geodesic distance, the natural manifold analogue of the squared Euclidean distance, does not always guarantee identifiability. Across benchmarks involving geospatial events, protein side chain torsion angles, RNA backbone torsion angles, and general manifolds discretized as triangular meshes, RW-Flow outperforms existing one-step methods in nearly all settings under fair comparison conditions.

</details>


### [466] [ReTaCo: Residual-Target Control for On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39275)
*Zixiang Ni,Zhuo Hu,Renjie Cao,Weijie Ren,Binqin Shi,Weijia Zhang,Shuheng Cao,Zhicheng Shi,Zhenhao Zhang,Haomin Wen,Zhiyuan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出熵感知在线策略蒸馏(EOPD)因对top-k概率重归一化导致教师非平稳点问题，提出ReTaCo方法，通过残差符号保留被遗漏词表的质量并配以无偏反向KL估计器，理论证明其最优解性质并实验验证优于EOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中传递或存储教师全词表分布代价高昂，EOPD虽用top-k概率降低成本并加入前向监督，但其重归一化使被省略词表质量为零，导致即使学生匹配了教师top-k内部相对概率，损失仍不断把学生top-k质量推向1，教师本身并非平稳点。

Method: 提出ReTaCo(Residual-Target Control)：保留top-k各token，将剩余token归为一个残差符号；配以单样本估计器，其期望等于全词表反向KL。设教师top-k质量为m，残差目标为(1-β)(1-m)，β∈[0,1]，β=0保留教师质量，β越大将越多质量移到top-k但不改变其相对概率。

Result: 理论证明固定前缀下总体目标有唯一最优解，其top-k质量介于m与m+β(1-m)之间且随β单调递增；β=0时被低估的top-k token仍获得非消失的恢复梯度。数值优化验证了这些预测，且在三个师生对上，ReTaCo在多数数学和代码基准上优于EOPD。

Conclusion: ReTaCo通过残差目标控制解决了EOPD的教师非平稳点和质量流失问题，在保持低成本的同时提供有原则的前向监督，理论与实验均表明其优于EOPD。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated prefixes with token-level teacher feedback, but transmitting or storing the teacher's full-vocabulary distribution at every token is costly. Entropy-aware OPD (EOPD) adds forward supervision to reverse KL to help the student recover plausible tokens it underestimates, using only the teacher's top-$k$ probabilities to limit cost. Because EOPD renormalizes these probabilities, its target assigns no mass to the omitted vocabulary. We prove that the resulting loss keeps pushing the student's top-$k$ mass toward one even after the student matches the teacher's relative probabilities within the top-$k$ set, so the teacher itself is not a stationary point whenever the omitted tokens have positive teacher probability. We propose ReTaCo (Residual-Target Control), which keeps the top-$k$ tokens individually and groups the remaining tokens into one residual symbol, and pairs this forward target with a single-sample estimator whose expectation equals the full-vocabulary reverse KL. With teacher top-$k$ mass $m$, the residual target is $(1-β)(1-m)$ for $β\in[0,1]$: $β=0$ preserves the teacher's mass, and larger $β$ moves more mass onto the top-$k$ tokens without changing their relative probabilities. At a fixed prefix, we prove that the population objective has a unique optimum whose top-$k$ mass lies between $m$ and $m+β(1-m)$ and increases monotonically with $β$; at $β=0$, underestimated top-$k$ tokens still receive non-vanishing recovery gradients. Numerical optimization confirms these predictions, and across three teacher-student pairs, ReTaCo outperforms EOPD on most mathematics and code benchmarks.

</details>


### [467] [When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39496)
*Jike Zhong,Ming Li,Yuxiang Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该报告发现类型化决策模型（如Jev）在候选集无正确答案时存在"算术依赖的拒绝瓶颈"：能正确选答却难以正确拒绝，但通过简单的决策阈值可大幅缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类型化决策模型在决策工作流中比生成式LLM更高效，但TypeSafe建议加入"other/none-of-the-above"选项以支持拒绝。作者怀疑这种拒绝机制在算术场景下可能失效，因此探究其拒绝能力的瓶颈。

Method: 通过配对算术问题进行实验：有正确答案时（answer-present）与无正确答案时（answer-absent）对比；考察不同数值规模、运算深度、上下文表述、拒绝标签，并扩展到时间计算、容量取整等场景；同时用原生布尔验证测试同一answer-absent算术案例。

Result: answer-present准确率达99%，但answer-absent正确拒绝率仅7%；该差距跨多种设置持续存在。原生布尔验证在相同answer-absent案例上达到99%精确匹配，说明分类拒绝可在模型能正确验证候选时仍失败。单独开发集上选定的简单决策阈值将拒绝准确率从7%提升至79%，同时保持97%的answer-present准确率。

Conclusion: 类型化决策模型存在算术依赖的拒绝瓶颈，分类拒绝失败并不意味模型无法验证候选正确性；一个简单阈值即可在无需重训或额外推理的情况下显著缓解该失败。

Abstract: Typed decision models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative LLMs in decision-making workflows by selecting directly from predefined options. When candidate sets contain no valid answer, TypeSafe recommends including an "other" or "none-of-the-above" option to enable rejection. In this report, however, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck: Jev reliably selects correct numerical answers when available but frequently accepts incorrect alternatives when they are absent despite an explicit rejection option. On paired arithmetic problems, answer-present accuracy reaches 99%, while correct rejection falls to 7%. Moreover, this gap persists across numerical magnitudes, operation depths, contextual formulations, and rejection labels, and extends to scenarios such as time calculation and capacity rounding. Yet native Boolean verification achieves 99% exact-match accuracy on the same answer-absent arithmetic cases, showing that categorical rejection can fail even when the model successfully verifies candidate correctness. Finally, we show that a simple decision threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection accuracy from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, substantially mitigating the failure without retraining or additional inference.

</details>


### [468] [Physics-Informed Method of Group Data Handling: Adaptive Construction of Functional Representations with an Application to the Navier-Stokes Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39291)
*Mykhailo Minin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PI-GMDH，在求解过程中逐步构造物理场表示，用目标泛函的一阶变分评估候选方向，并在Taylor-Green基准上验证，获得极高精度与更小表示规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统物理信息计算方法通常预先固定函数表示结构，缺乏对表示结构的自适应构建，可能影响精度、规模与效率的平衡。

Method: 提出物理信息分组数据处理法（PI-GMDH）：在求解中逐步构造耦合物理场表示；以完整物理与观测目标的一阶变分评估候选函数方向，分批引入，并采用块坐标阻尼高斯-牛顿法优化系数；演示中使用张量积Chebyshev函数。

Result: 在二维非定常Taylor-Green不可压Navier-Stokes基准上，自适应PI-GMDH验证损失与测试损失分别达5.299e-19和5.296e-19，u、v、p分别使用204、201、175个活跃函数；与逐阶、全项PI-GMDH及部分PINN、KAN配置对比显示选择性渐进构造在精度、表示规模和计算时间上较优。

Conclusion: 在该受控合成基准中，选择性渐进构造能提供精度、表示规模与运行时间的良好组合；该比较为示例性结果，并非声称对所有物理信息方法具有普遍优越性。

Abstract: Physics-informed computational methods usually optimize parameters within a functional representation whose structure is fixed in advance. This work proposes a Physics-Informed Method of Group Data Handling (PI-GMDH), in which representations of coupled physical fields are progressively constructed during solution. Candidate functional directions are evaluated through the first variation of the complete physical and observational objective, introduced in packages, and followed by block-coordinate damped Gauss-Newton coefficient optimization. The framework is demonstrated with tensor-product Chebyshev functions on the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations using a two-dimensional time-dependent Taylor-Green benchmark. Under the tested configuration, adaptive PI-GMDH reached validation and held-out test losses of 5.299e-19 and 5.296e-19 with 204, 201, and 175 active functions for u, v, and p. Complete degree-by-degree and all-terms PI-GMDH variants, together with selected PINN and KAN reference configurations, are used to examine the effect of structural construction policy. The results show that, for this controlled synthetic benchmark, selective progressive construction can provide a favorable combination of accuracy, representation size, and wall-clock time. The comparison is illustrative rather than a claim of universal superiority over alternative physics-informed approaches.

</details>


### [469] [Semantic-Aware Joint Source-Channel Optimization for Encoder-Agnostic Digital Video Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39296)
*Xiangben Zhu,Caili Guo,Yang Yang,Chuanhong Liu,Meiyi Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出轻量级语义感知联合信源信道优化(SAJSCO)方案，可即插即用地集成到现有数字视频通信系统，提升传输效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数现有视频语义通信方法依赖计算密集的深度学习编解码器，难以在资源受限场景部署。

Method: 构建收发系统模型，基于帧间语义重要性和信道状态联合优化信源/信道编码参数；建立最大比特率约束下最大化语义重要性加权重建质量的优化问题；用余弦相似度+滑动窗口机制量化帧间语义重要性；提出多智能体近端策略优化(MPPO)算法联合调整信源压缩率与信道编码率，且无需针对特定编码器重训。

Result: 集成H.265实现34.86%、DCVC-RT实现18.01%的BD-rate降低；硬件实测中H.265的PSNR最高提升1.448 dB，DCVC-RT的LPIPS最高降低0.033。

Conclusion: SAJSCO作为即插即用模块，兼容传统与深度学习编码器，在资源受限场景下有效提升视频传输效率。

Abstract: Video semantic communication has attracted increasing attention as a promising approach to improving video transmission efficiency. However, most existing approaches rely on computationally intensive deep learning-based video encoders and decoders, which hinders their deployment in resource-constrained scenarios. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight semantic-aware joint source-channel optimization (SAJSCO) scheme that can be integrated into existing digital video communication systems as a plug-in module. Specifically, we develop a video communication system model in which the transmitter jointly optimizes source and channel coding parameters based on the inter-frame semantic importance of the input video and estimated channel state information. On this basis, we formulate an optimization problem that maximizes semantic importance weighted video reconstruction quality under a maximum bitrate constraint. To solve it, we first quantify inter-frame semantic importance using a cosine similarity-based metric with a shifted window mechanism. We then develop a multi-actor proximal policy optimization (MPPO) algorithm to solve the formulated problem by jointly adapting the source compression rate and channel coding rate. The learned policy can be directly applied to different video encoders without encoder-specific retraining or fine-tuning. SAJSCO achieves Bjøntegaard Delta rate reductions of 34.86\% and 18.01\% when integrated with H.265, a conventional video encoder, and DCVC-RT, a deep learning-based video encoder. Over-the-air experiments on a hardware testbed further demonstrate a PSNR gain of up to 1.448 dB with H.265 and an LPIPS reduction of up to 0.033 with DCVC-RT compared with the respective best-performing fixed-parameter baselines.

</details>


### [470] [ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39306)
*Shengjie Jin,Hengbo Xu,Zelong Sun,YuJie Guo,Zhiwu Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReSAIL，一种可插拔的基于特权信息( PI )的迭代自蒸馏增强方法，用于解决LLM agent在连续部署中自蒸馏导致的性能崩塌问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代自蒸馏让LLM agent从连续部署中学习，是实现递归自我改进(RSI)的路径。但实验发现现有方法在多个循环中出现部署性能崩塌，且有特权信息( PI )时的任务性能也下降。需要一种更稳健的学习机制来缓解迭代自蒸馏的性能崩塌。

Method: ReSAIL作为迭代PI自蒸馏的插件式增强，包含两部分：(1) 优先选择PI最强改变教师预测的交互步骤进行蒸馏，并平衡各轨迹间的蒸馏损失；(2) 将学生的PI条件输出分布正则化到冻结教师的分布（在选中和未选中步骤上），以在下一轮循环中保留PI条件行为作为监督信号。

Result: 在ALFWorld和TextCraft上，ReSAIL在三个循环中于不同模型规模上持续获得显著提升，加到底线自蒸馏方法上时最终循环成功率平均绝对提升22.5%。在AITZ上，敏感性引导的离线数据选择也提升了多模态GUI agent的动作预测准确率。

Conclusion: 研究表明更稳健的学习机制能够有效缓解迭代agent自蒸馏在部署轨迹中的性能崩塌，这是首个相关证据。

Abstract: Iterative self-distillation enables LLM agents to learn from successive deployments, offering a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet our experiments with existing methods reveal a collapse in deployment performance across cycles, while task performance with privileged information (PI) also declines. We address this collapse by prioritizing informative interaction steps for distillation and preserving PI-conditioned behavior as the student becomes the next teacher. We introduce Retentive and Selective Augmentation for Iterative Self-Distillation (ReSAIL), a plug-in augmentation for iterative PI-based self-distillation. ReSAIL selects interaction steps where PI most strongly changes the teacher's predictions and balances the resulting distillation losses across trajectories. It also regularizes the student's PI-conditioned output distributions toward those of the frozen teacher at selected and unselected steps to preserve PI-conditioned behavior for supervision in the next cycle. On ALFWorld and TextCraft, ReSAIL sustains substantial gains across model scales over three cycles, with an average absolute gain of 22.5% in final-cycle success rates when added to self-distillation baselines. Sensitivity-guided selection of offline data also improves action prediction accuracy for multimodal GUI agents on AITZ. These findings provide the first evidence that a more robust learning mechanism can effectively mitigate performance collapse in iterative agent self-distillation over deployment trajectories.

</details>


### [471] [GRPO Training Dynamics for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39321)
*Rajat Ghosh,Vaishnavi Bhargava,Henry Wong,Aryan Singhal,Debojyoti Dutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在单节点8xA100预算下，针对1.5B–7B小语言模型（SLM）的GRPO微调，涵盖数学、代码与科学选择题等推理领域，分析group size、训练稳定性与张量级更新动态，并通过改进LoRA与奖励塑形提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO作为内存高效的强化微调方法虽已出现，但其在小语言模型（SLM）上的训练动态尚不清楚，限制了在开放且资源受限环境下的可靠采用与复现。

Method: 在单节点8xA100计算预算下，对1.5B–7B的多个模型族进行GRPO微调；跨数学、代码和科学选择题任务，分析group size对策略收敛、训练稳定性和下游基准表现的影响；刻画张量级更新动态，并探究LoRA目标模块与层的选择是否能提升GRPO微调模型性能。

Result: 初始GRPO微调模型在约80%的数学基准评测中优于基座模型，但在选择题和代码推理任务上表现有限；基于机制性评估，研究者调整LoRA与奖励塑形配置后提升了这些领域的性能。

Conclusion: 该研究为小语言模型的GRPO训练提供了实践指导，揭示了其训练动态并给出LoRA与奖励塑形的优化方向。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a memory-efficient reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) technique for reasoning-intensive tasks. How- ever, GRPO training dynamics on small language models (SLMs) remain poorly understood, limiting its reliable adoption and reproducibility in open and resource- constrained environments. In this work, we present a systematic study of GRPO fine-tuning for SLMs ranging from 1.5B to 7B parameters under a practical single- node 8xA100 compute budget. Our study spans multiple model families and reasoning domains, including mathematics, coding, and multiple-choice question answering (MCQ) in science. Across these settings, we analyze how group size affects policy convergence, training stability, and downstream benchmark per- formance. We further characterize tensor-level update dynamics during GRPO training and investigate whether the choice of LoRA target modules and layers can improve the performance of GRPO-tuned models. While our initial GRPO-tuned models outperform their base counterparts on approximately 80% of mathematical benchmark evaluations, they demonstrate limited capability on MCQ and code reasoning tasks. Guided by our mechanistic evaluations, we refined our LoRA and reward-shaping configurations to improve performance in latter domains. These findings provide practical guidance for GRPO training for SLMs.

</details>


### [472] [PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39329)
*Chanryeol Lee,Chanhyuk Lee,Yeonwoo Choi,Donggyun Kim,Seunghoon Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PatchKV，一种免训练框架，通过将部分上下文信息编码进权重补丁来补偿 KV cache 压缩，在激进压缩预算下显著提升长上下文推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理受限于随线性增长的 KV cache 内存。现有压缩方法（token 淘汰或近似）在激进压缩预算下性能急剧下降。

Method: PatchKV 将现成的压缩 KV cache 与上下文特定的权重补丁配对。权重补丁在上下文加载时计算一次，通过岭回归闭式求解，将上下文派生参考查询 token 的分块激活在完整 cache 与压缩 cache 下对齐。合并后补丁脱离前向图，在单上下文多查询场景下不改变单次查询推理成本。

Result: 在三种模型架构上，於长上下文 QA（SCBench 最高 170K token、SQuAD、NIAH）与数学推理（GSM8K）基准中，PatchKV 一致地提升了各类 cache 压缩方法的效果。

Conclusion: 在激进压缩预算下补偿 KV cache 压缩是一个可行方向，PatchKV 提供了一种用权重携带部分上下文的替代思路。

Abstract: Long-context inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linearly growing memory of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing compression methods reduce the cache through token eviction or approximation, but degrade sharply at aggressive compression budgets. We propose PatchKV, a training-free framework that compensates KV cache compression methods by carrying part of the context in the model's weights. PatchKV pairs an off-the-shelf compressed KV cache with a context-specific weight patch, which is computed once at context-loading time and served for downstream queries for the context. The weight patch is derived in closed form via ridge regression, by aligning the block-wise activations of context-derived reference query tokens under the full cache and the compressed cache. Once merged into the model, the patch leaves the forward graph and per-query inference cost unchanged in the single-context, multi-query setting. Across long-context QA (SCBench with up to 170K tokens, SQuAD, NIAH) and math (GSM8K) benchmarks on three model architectures, PatchKV consistently improves cache compression methods, suggesting an alternative direction to compensate them at aggressive budgets.

</details>


### [473] [RoPE at the End of Its Rope? Theory, Diagnosis, and Mitigation of Long-Context Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39929)
*Yuyang Wu,Yufeng Du,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文精确刻画RoPE在长上下文中的行为，提出理论分析、诊断工具RoPE Profiler及高频重缩放方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RoPE存在"维持稳定token偏好"与"区分邻近位置"之间的内在权衡，导致长上下文失败，但需更精确刻画以决定解决哪种弱点及如何解决。

Method: 放宽先前理论限制，允许不同RoPE频率上query-key尺度不等；使两种脆弱性对每个head和输入可测；推导context-length理论界限；提出轻量级即插即用诊断工具RoPE Profiler，复用缓存激活零额外前向。

Result: 在49个长上下文任务设置中，推理任务主要受语义反转影响，检索任务主要受位置不敏感影响；高频重缩放无需额外训练即可提升准确率，Qwen3-8B最高+20个百分点，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct最高+25个百分点。

Conclusion: 理论与诊断揭示RoPE长上下文失败的两种可测量脆弱性，RoPE Profiler可指导针对性修复，高频重缩放实现即时性能提升。

Abstract: Long-context failures of RoPE-based language models can arise from RoPE's intrinsic tradeoff between maintaining stable token preferences and distinguishing nearby positions. Determining which weakness to address, and how, requires a more precise characterization of RoPE's behavior in trained models across context lengths. We address a key limitation of prior theory by allowing unequal query-key scales across RoPE frequencies, which aligns well with practical empirical observations. Our theory makes both vulnerabilities measurable for individual heads and inputs, and quantifies how high-frequency components support positional sensitivity while potentially disrupting semantic stability. We also derive a theoretical context-length bound beyond which, under specified conditions, a fixed attention-score comparison cannot jointly avoid semantic reversal and positional insensitivity. Guided by our fresh theoretical insights, we introduce RoPE Profiler, a lightweight, plug-and-play diagnostic toolkit that augments existing evaluations with zero additional forward passes by reusing cached query and key activations. Reusing activations collected during evaluation, the toolkit incurs little overhead. It supplements standard benchmark scores with two diagnostic scores that reveal semantic and positional weaknesses and help users prioritize which aspect to address. Crucially, our evaluations across 49 long-context task settings reveal a distinct pattern where reasoning tasks predominantly suffer from semantic reversal, whereas retrieval tasks are primarily vulnerable to positional insensitivity. Guided by our theory and diagnostic profiles, targeted high-frequency rescaling achieves immediate gains without additional training, improving task accuracy by up to 20 percentage points on Qwen3-8B and 25 percentage points on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.

</details>


### [474] [How Many Samples Are Enough for Learning Across Domains?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39336)
*Hong Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过建立新的学习界，给出每个训练域的样本量充分性判据，揭示了训练域数量与每域所需样本数之间的逆线性缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明增加训练域数量或增大分布偏移可提升泛化，但"每个域样本何时算充分"这一前提条件尚未被探究，本文填补该空白。

Method: 基于所提出的学习界，建立per-domain样本需求的判据，并据此推导域数量与样本数的缩放关系，同时证明域内学习与域外泛化的紧密联系。

Result: 揭示了训练域数量与每域所需样本数之间的逆线性缩放律，阐明了数据充分性假设的根本原因，并与经典学习理论形成对比。

Conclusion: 该判据为评估现有数据集充分性、指导数据集构建提供理论依据。

Abstract: Understanding the fundamental mechanisms of learning is essential for designing systems with strong generalization. Recent studies have shown that increasing the number of training domains, or enlarging the distribution shift among them, improves generalization when each domain contains sufficiently many data samples. However, the conditions under which the data samples can be considered sufficient remain unexplored. In this work, we fill this gap by establishing criteria for per-domain sample requirements based on the presented learning bounds. These criteria not only reveal an inverse linear scaling law between the number of training domains and the number of samples required per domain, but also explain the fundamental rationale behind the assumption of data sufficiency, thereby providing theoretical guidance for assessing the adequacy of existing datasets and constructing datasets. This differs from classical learning theory, as the number of samples required is highly dependent on the number of training domains. Additionally, we prove the close relationship between in-domain learning and out-of-domain generalization through the presented generalization bounds, and lastly discuss some key arguments.

</details>


### [475] [LARC: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections for Learning in Frozen Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40063)
*Junyi Zou,Avrova Donz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LARC（低秩自适应残差连接），为冻结模型提供可从反馈学习的紧凑数值状态，通过慢状态ρ与快速状态Φ实现跨任务与在线自适应，并在MiniCPM5-1B-SFT上验证其因子空间动力学与学习生命周期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为冻结模型赋予可学习、可更新的紧凑数值状态，使其能从反馈中在线适应，同时区分残差容量、相对起点的适应能力与对后续决策的实际有用性。

Method: 采用输入侧低秩残差h+BAh（rank-4，12,288可训练参数），在冻结MiniCPM5-1B-SFT上实现：慢状态ρ学习跨任务起始因子，快速私有状态Φ复制并随反馈更新、可重置到训练初始化；并比较反馈梯度步与直接支持损失选择规则。

Result: 四候选程序选择任务中，两步反馈梯度将期望查询执行误差相比静态与适应后初始化分别降低24.65和36.65个百分点；直接支持损失选择达0.78125%误差；在CI任务时间回放中，保留在线更新使半Brier损失从0.1274升至0.1808，后续干预显示同批非下降及未来收益不一致。

Conclusion: 代数与测量结果区分了残差容量、相对起点的适应能力以及后续决策中的实用性，表明低秩自适应残差具有学习价值但在线更新未必带来稳定长期收益。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptive Residual Connections (LARC) give a frozen model a compact numerical state that can learn from feedback. The map $h+BAh$ adds a low-rank correction to a hidden representation. A slow state $ρ$ learns starting factors across tasks; a private fast state $Φ$ copies them, changes with feedback, and resets to the trained initialization. This report specifies an input-side realization of the numerical policy carrier in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture and examines its factor-space dynamics and learning lifetime. We study a rank-4 input residual with 12,288 trainable parameters on a frozen MiniCPM5-1B-SFT substrate. In a four-candidate program-selection task, two feedback-gradient steps reduce expected query execution error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points relative to resetting to the respective trained static and post-adaptation initializations. These development results cover 16 parameter groups and three paired training seeds. A direct support-loss selection rule is much more accurate, reaching 0.78125% error. In a repository-balanced chronological replay of public continuous-integration jobs, retaining online updates raises half-Brier loss from 0.1274 to 0.1808. A fixed follow-up intervention records same-batch non-descent and inconsistent future benefit from shrinking updates. Together, the algebra and measurements distinguish residual capacity, adaptation relative to a starting point, and usefulness on later decisions.

</details>


### [476] [WinoTS: Wavelet-based Self-Distillation for Time Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39337)
*Noam Major,Kathy Razmadze,Yoli Shavit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WinoTS，一种基于小波时频增强的自蒸馏预训练范式，用于时间序列，超越现有SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列自监督预训练以预测和重建为主，在连续值域中浪费容量于高频点噪声，牺牲不变结构学习；视觉领域的自蒸馏虽有效，但时序适配需要合适的增强手段，空间裁剪会移动周期或扭曲信号，简单抖动变化不足。

Method: 基于不变性的自蒸馏预训练，核心是用小波时频增强构造多尺度结构视图，不扭曲信号动态，架构无关。

Result: 在长期预测、跨域零样本迁移和无监督异常检测上优于SOTA；冻结表示的线性探测常超过从头训练的完全监督模型。

Conclusion: WinoTS是灵活、架构无关的框架，在多种时序骨干上均有增益，表明时频变换是视觉式空间增强的原则性替代方案。

Abstract: Self-supervised pre-training of time series models is currently dominated by next-token prediction and reconstruction objectives. In continuous-valued domains, these paradigms often waste model capacity on high-frequency, point-wise noise at the expense of learning invariant structure. While invariance-based self-distillation has proven highly effective in computer vision, its application to temporal data remains largely underexplored. Effectively adapting such methods to time series requires carefully designed augmentations: spatial operations like cropping can shift the timing of repeating cycles or distort the signal, while basic jittering may provide limited variation. We introduce Wavelet-based self-distillation for time series (WinoTS), an invariance-based pre-training paradigm designed specifically for temporal signals. At its core, WinoTS leverages time-frequency augmentations to construct multi-scale structural views without distorting underlying signal dynamics. Across extensive evaluations, WinoTS outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in long-term forecasting, cross-domain zero-shot transfer, and unsupervised anomaly detection. Notably, linear probing on frozen WinoTS representations frequently surpasses fully supervised models trained from scratch. Systematic ablations demonstrate that WinoTS is a flexible, architecture-agnostic framework yielding gains across time series backbones, and establish that time-frequency transformations provide a principled alternative to vision-style spatial augmentations.

</details>


### [477] [Learning Beyond Full Imitation: Task-Preserving Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39338)
*Qianfeng Yuan,Wenbing Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了知识蒸馏中"完全模仿"与"条件学习"的精确分离：当正确类相对每个错误类的优势需被保留时，学生若对所有错误类分配不超过教师的概率，完全KL最小化就会被阻断，但教师错误类间的相对概率仍可学习；据此提出任务保持蒸馏TPKD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏让学生匹配教师的类别概率，虽传递了正确类置信度与错误类间关系，但更接近的模仿未必更好：学生可能已比教师更锐利地区分正确类，强制模仿反而要求其放弃已获得的判别力。因此需要厘清"完全模仿"与"条件学习"何时冲突。

Method: 作者首先给出完全模仿与条件学习的精确分离定理：在正确类对每个替代类得分优势须保持的条件下，当且仅当学生对每个错误类分配的概率不超过教师时，完全的师生KL最小化被阻断，同时教师错误类间的相对概率完全可学。进而刻画迁移代价：补偿最大条件概率失配所需正确类对数几率的最小增幅。基于此提出TPKD，保持标签梯度不变，仅最小修正条件梯度，使其输出更新保留标签步骤对每个错误类的增益。

Result: 修正后的条件方向在相同步长下保留超过一半的原始一阶条件下降，且该界限是紧的。对于固定的正条件目标和足够小的常数输出步长，标签误差与条件误差同时趋于消失。实验从精确头部更新追踪到普通网络训练：TPKD在CIFAR-100上达88.05%，CLINC150上达93.81%，三个随机种子下较标准蒸馏分别提升0.47和0.35个百分点。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上分离了完全模仿与条件学习，说明完全教师KL发散时标签拟合与条件匹配仍可完成，并提出TPKD实现任务保持的蒸馏，在理论与实验上均优于标准知识蒸馏。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge by encouraging a student to match a teacher's predicted class probabilities. These probabilities express not only confidence in the correct class, but also relations among incorrect alternatives. Yet closer imitation does not necessarily yield a better student. A student may already distinguish the correct class more sharply than its teacher, so further imitation can require giving back discrimination it has acquired. Our main result is an exact separation between full imitation and conditional learning. When the correct class's score advantage over each alternative must be preserved, full teacher-to-student KL minimization is blocked exactly when the student assigns no more probability than the teacher to every incorrect class. Crucially, the teacher's relative probabilities among incorrect classes remain fully learnable. We characterize the exact price of this transfer: a minimum increase in correct-class log-odds that compensates for the largest conditional-probability mismatch. Label fitting and conditional matching can therefore be completed even as full teacher KL diverges. This separation motivates task-preserving knowledge distillation (TPKD), which keeps the label gradient intact and minimally corrects the conditional gradient so that its output update preserves the label step's gains against every incorrect alternative. The corrected conditional direction retains more than half of the original first-order conditional descent at the same step size, with a tight bound. For a fixed positive conditional target and sufficiently small constant output steps, label and conditional errors vanish together. Experiments trace this learning from exact head updates to ordinary network training. TPKD reaches 88.05% accuracy on CIFAR-100 and 93.81% on CLINC150, improving over standard distillation by 0.47 and 0.35 percentage points across three seeds.

</details>


### [478] [Learning Functional Subspaces for Neural Network Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40127)
*Massimo Bini,Anders Christensen,Stephan Alaniz,Judah Goldfeder,Ole Winther,Yann LeCun,Ravid Shwartz-Ziv,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP)，通过学习端到端的子空间投影进行低秩权重分解，在大幅压缩下显著优于现有局部准则方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩权重分解方法用局部闭式准则（激活能量、逐层重构误差、损失二次近似）选择要移除的子空间，忽略了误差在网络中的传播，导致高压缩率下误差随深度累积、性能崩溃。

Method: 为每个线性层（或共享激活的绑定层组）分配正交投影器，所有投影器在权重冻结下针对全局目标（对稠密模型输出分布的KL散度或原训练损失）联合优化；投影器由白化SVD截断初始化，秩按每个投影器每节省参数所诱导的输出KL分配；训练后投影器合并为标准低秩因子，绑定组共享一个因子，并使注意力可缓存一个窄潜在向量替代完整K/V。

Result: 在OPT-125M/1.3B、Qwen3-4B、Llama-2-7B和ViT-B/16上优于基线，压缩越大优势越明显。Llama-2-7B在-70%压缩下达10.9 WikiText-2困惑度和42.2%零样本平均准确率（最强基线为13.3和36.0%）。小批量下解码快达1.6倍，128k上下文时权重与KV缓存合计内存缩减13.5倍（未绑定基线最多6.5倍）。

Conclusion: LSP通过端到端学习丢弃子空间，克服了局部准则的误差累积问题，在高压缩下保持性能，并带来推理加速与内存节省。

Abstract: Modern transformers pair impressive capabilities with substantial memory and compute demands. Low-rank weight factorization reduces both while keeping the matrices dense, and thus efficient on standard hardware. Existing methods, however, choose the subspace to remove from each weight matrix with local closed-form criteria: activation energy, layer-wise reconstruction error, or a quadratic approximation of the loss. These criteria ignore how errors propagate through the network, so at high compression the errors compound with depth and performance collapses. We introduce Learnable Subspace Projections (LSP), which instead learns the subspaces to discard end-to-end. Each linear layer, or tied group of layers that read the same activations, is assigned an orthogonal projector. All projectors are optimized jointly against a global objective--the KL divergence to the dense model's output distribution or the model's original training loss--while the pretrained weights remain frozen. Projectors are initialized from a whitened SVD truncation, and ranks are allocated by the output KL each projector induces per parameter saved. After training, the projectors merge into standard low-rank factors, with each tied group sharing one factor. In attention, this also lets the model cache one narrow latent in place of full keys and values. Across LLMs (OPT-125M/1.3B, Qwen3-4B, Llama-2-7B) and ViT-B/16, LSP outperforms baselines, and its advantage widens as compression increases. At -70% compression, LSP brings Llama-2-7B to 10.9 WikiText-2 perplexity and 42.2% mean zero-shot accuracy, versus 13.3 and 36.0% for the strongest baseline. The factorized model decodes up to 1.6x faster than the dense model at small batch sizes, and aching the shared latent shrinks the combined memory of weights and KV cache by 13.5x at a 128k-token context, versus at most 6.5x for untied baseline factorizations.

</details>


### [479] [ElectrolyteFM: Unifying Electrolyte Property Prediction through Cross-Property Knowledge Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39340)
*Jiaxin Yu,Shuo Wang,Peng Wang,Yongcai Wang,Deying Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ElectrolyteFM统一多性质预测模型，通过识别共享与特有特征解决电解质性质间的干扰与迁移问题，在12项性质上平均降低14.8%误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电解质配方设计需平衡多种理化性质，但现有模型多只关注部分性质。孤立学习各性质会忽略可迁移化学信息，而无差别共享又会引入跨性质干扰，且不同性质间存在非对称迁移效应。

Method: ElectrolyteFM独立学习各性质的专用表示，并通过单独训练的专家池捕获跨性质知识。路由器为每个配方和目标性质选择相关共享信息，性质专用残差适配器将其转化为对应表示的修正用于预测。

Result: 在Electrolyte12上，12项性质的平均归一化MAE较最强电解质专用基线降低14.8%；在训练未见过的独立钠电解质数据集上，电导率MAE较最佳基线降低6.7%。

Conclusion: 统一多性质预测能有效利用共享知识并避免跨性质干扰，提升电解质性质预测精度与泛化能力。

Abstract: Electrolyte formulation design requires balancing multiple physicochemical properties, yet existing models often focus on a limited subset. Learning each property in isolation can overlook transferable chemical information, whereas indiscriminate sharing can introduce cross-property interference. Our directed transfer analysis shows that jointly learning two property prediction tasks can improve or degrade prediction relative to separate training, with asymmetric transfer effects between the tasks.
