We propose ElectrolyteFM, a unified multi-property prediction model which can more accurately predict multiple properties of each electrolyte by effectively identifying and utilizing property-specific features and knowledge shared across properties. More specifically, ElectrolyteFM learns property-specific representations independently and captures cross-property knowledge through a separately trained expert pool. A router selects relevant shared information for each formulation and target property, and property-specific residual adapters convert this information into corrections to the corresponding representation for prediction. Experiments on Electrolyte12 show that ElectrolyteFM reduces normalized mean absolute error averaged across 12 electrolyte properties by 14.8% relative to the strongest electrolyte-specific baseline. On an independent sodium-electrolyte dataset unseen during training, it reduces conductivity mean absolute error by 6.7% relative to the best-performing baseline.

</details>


### [480] [PhantomEnvironments: Training LLM Agents in Fictional Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40221)
*Anmol Kabra,Swathi Saravana Selvam,Albert Gong,Chao Wan,Christian Belardi,Dongyoung Go,Katie Z. Luo,Kilian Q. Weinberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用纯规则生成的虚构环境（无需LLM、零边际成本）训练LLM搜索智能体，可迁移到真实多跳搜索基准，甚至超越真实数据训练效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL训练LLM智能体受限于环境需提供可验证奖励、支持长程交互且可低成本扩展；已有方法依赖昂贵人工数据或LLM生成环境（存在幻觉与基准污染风险）。

Method: 构建PhantomEnvironments：基于虚构世界的多轮RL环境，由规则完全生成，智能体需在模板化文章语料中搜索以回答多跳问题，环境生成不涉及LLM。

Result: 尽管与真实世界无共享事实，智能体可迁移到真实多跳搜索基准，在新基准上常优于真实数据训练；可泛化到未见虚构世界；Qwen模型学会搜索预算随问题难度近似线性扩展（涌现搜索扩展）；消融显示跳数比约束或比较更能驱动迁移。

Conclusion: 即便最简单的规则生成环境也是训练可泛化LLM智能体的高效且免费资源，为突破环境瓶颈提供新思路。

Abstract: Training LLM agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is bottlenecked by environments, which must provide verifiable rewards, support long-horizon interaction, and scale cheaply. Existing approaches rely on costly human-curated data or on LLM-generated environments that risk hallucinations and benchmark contamination. We show that LLMs can instead be trained into capable search agents using synthetic environments generated entirely by rules, whose generation requires no LLM and has zero marginal cost. We build PhantomEnvironments, multi-turn RL environments from fictional worlds, where agents must search a corpus of templated articles to answer multi-hop questions. Despite sharing no facts with the real world, these strikingly simple environments yield agents that transfer to real-world multi-hop search benchmarks, often outperforming real-world training data on newer benchmarks. Trained agents generalize to unseen fictional universes, and Qwen models learn to scale their search budget roughly linearly with question difficulty, suggesting emergent search scaling from environment interaction alone. Ablating environment complexity reveals that hop count drives transfer more than constraints or comparisons: even the simplest rule-generated environments are a surprisingly effective, free resource for training generalizable LLM agents.

</details>


### [481] [LampAttention: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision FlashAttention for Dedicated Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39361)
*Stanislav Budzinskiy,Marian Gloser,Tolunay Yilmaz,Ying Hong Tham,Yuanyi Lin,Wenyi Fang,Fan Wu,Philipp Petersen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出混合精度FlashAttention，通过硬件-算法协同设计，在8位下计算注意力，并自适应识别敏感子块用16位重算，配合专用加速器恢复模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数注意力logits可低精度计算而不损害数值稳定性，但现有注意力核未能利用这一现象。

Method: 混合精度FlashAttention：用8位累加key-query乘积并计算指数，自适应识别敏感子块并在16位重算；提出可高效执行该流水线的专用加速器规格。

Result: 在Qwen3与Gemma 3上的仿真实验表明，仅将少数子块路由到高精度即可恢复基线模型性能。

Conclusion: 通过选择性混合精度结合专用硬件，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下加速注意力计算。

Abstract: While most attention logits can be computed in low precision without degrading numerical stability, current attention kernels fail to exploit this phenomenon. We introduce a novel hardware-algorithm co-design in the form of mixed-precision FlashAttention. Our method accumulates key-query products and evaluates their exponentials in 8-bit formats, then adaptively identifies sensitive sub-blocks and recomputes them in 16-bit formats. We propose the specifications for a dedicated accelerator capable of executing this pipeline efficiently. Simulated experiments with Qwen3 and Gemma 3 show that rerouting a selective minority of sub-blocks to high precision is sufficient to recover the baseline model performance.

</details>


### [482] [Wavelet Flow Matching for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39374)
*Lucas Poinsignon,Jorge da Silva Gonçalves,Samuel Ruipérez-Campillo,Julia E. Vogt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在小波域进行流匹配的多变量时间序列生成方法，结合通道token Transformer建模跨通道依赖，在多数据集上性能领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成时间序列广泛用于数据增强、隐私保护和下游任务，但现有方法难以同时忠实还原多尺度时间结构与跨通道依赖。

Method: 在小波域对多级离散小波系数做流匹配，代替直接在时域建模；不同尺度系数的天然方差差异诱导出隐式由粗到细的生成过程，无需显式多尺度调度；由于小波变换逐通道独立，配合通道token Transformer用注意力直接建模跨通道依赖。

Result: 在7个基准数据集、4种序列长度上，方法在多数数据集-指标组合上达到最优或持平，Context-FID与判别分数改进最大且最稳定。

Conclusion: 小波域流匹配加通道注意力能有效兼顾多尺度结构与跨通道依赖，是高质量多变量时间序列生成的有效方案。

Abstract: Synthetic time series are increasingly used for data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and downstream model development, yet faithfully reproducing both multi-scale temporal structure and cross-channel dependencies remains challenging. We study multivariate time-series generation through flow matching in the wavelet domain. By operating on multilevel discrete wavelet coefficients rather than directly in the time domain, the model represents coarse structure and progressively finer details at separate scales. Their naturally different variances further induce an implicit coarse-to-fine generative process without requiring an explicit multi-scale schedule. Since the transform acts independently on each channel, we pair it with a channel-token transformer whose attention directly models cross-channel dependencies. Across seven benchmark datasets and four sequence lengths, our method is best or tied on a majority of dataset-metric combinations, with the largest and most consistent improvements in Context-FID and discriminative score.

</details>


### [483] [cua-speedrun: Standardized Benchmarking of the Speed of Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40284)
*Pranjal Aggarwal,Lawrence Keunho Jang,Sean Welleck,Daniel Fried,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Jing Yu Koh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 cua-speedrun，标准化基础设施与任务集，专注评估计算机使用智能体（CUA）的速度与效率，并揭示推理强度、agent harness 与环境延迟对性能、速度、成本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA 虽在多项基准上超越人类，但速度与成本成为其广泛部署的关键障碍；同时现有 CUA 基准缺乏可复现性，机器与容器配置差异混淆了速度评估。

Method: 提出 cua-speedrun：统一虚拟机设置与执行流水线、通用 agent 接口（使单智能体实现跨基准运行），并在四个 CUA 基准上评估推理强度、agent harness 与环境延迟的影响。

Result: 没有单一模型家族在三项指标上均最优；开源权重模型均未达前沿；反直觉地，增加推理强度有时加快任务完成，而更快环境 I/O 反而可能拖慢整体完成时间；可缩减多数基准任务集而不显著降低统计功效。

Conclusion: cua-speedrun 为快速、高效 CUA 的结构化进展提供支持，解锁新应用场景，代码与基础设施已开源。

Abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs), which use graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete tasks on a computer, have recently surpassed human performance on many standard benchmarks, including difficult long-horizon tasks. Their capabilities are undoubtedly impressive, however, a key barrier to the widespread adoption and deployment of CUAs remains their speed and cost. Progress towards faster yet capable CUAs requires reliable evaluation of their speed, but many CUA benchmarks currently face a reproducibility crisis. Benchmarks are based on complex infrastructure with varying machine and container configurations that confound the evaluation of the execution speed of CUAs. Towards addressing this gap, we propose cua-speedrun, which introduces standardized infrastructure and task sets, with a focus on evaluating the speed and efficiency of CUAs. cua-speedrun uses a uniform virtual machine setup and execution pipeline, along with a common agent interface that enables single-agent implementations to operate seamlessly across different benchmarks. Across four different CUA benchmarks, we evaluate how reasoning effort, agent harnesses, and environment latency affect performance, speed, and cost. We find no single model family is optimal for all three; none of the open-weight models are on the frontier, and also, unintuitively, for some models increasing the reasoning effort can speed up task completion, while faster environment input-output can slow down overall task completion time. We also demonstrate that we can effectively reduce the evaluation task set of most CUA benchmarks without degrading overall statistical power, allowing for more efficient benchmarking and comparison. We believe cua-speedrun will enable structured progress towards fast, efficient CUAs, unlocking new real-world use cases and applications. All code, infrastructure, and analysis are available at https://cuaspeedrun.com.

</details>


### [484] [From Search to Signal: Online Post-Training in Automatic Heuristic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39383)
*Yilun Yuan,Tianyu Zhou,Zhenzhou Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将AHD中小型开源LLM的在线后训练形式化为"上下文依赖的信号构建"问题，提出从程序有效性、任务性能与生成上下文映射到更新信号的多种方案，并通过受控实验比较对有效性、性能与有效改进产出的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AHD系统用LLM迭代生成并精化启发式，评测结果既驱动搜索又（在RLVR类方法中）作为训练信号，形成搜索耦合循环。但有效性与性能并不能唯一决定何种模型更新有用，需考虑产生候选时的prompt与演化中的搜索状态；仅凭端到端搜索收益无法证明启发式设计能力真正提升。

Method: 在匹配评测rollout与更新预算下，对多种AHD任务和模型族做受控实验，比较不同"上下文依赖信号映射"与在线后训练基线；辅以checkpoint评测、冻结搜索评测与实时系统评测，区分收益来自模型更新还是搜索状态累积；并在预设成本核算下做资源匹配对比。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值结果，仅说明该设计用于检验各映射对有效性、有效提案中的性能及"在上下文比较下可改进的有效提案产出"的影响，并评估增益是否体现在更新后checkpoint行为与后续搜索中。

Conclusion: 将搜索收益与模型能力提升区分开来，避免把端到端搜索收益直接当作更强启发式设计能力的证据；为AHD中的在线后训练提供了受控、可归因的评估框架。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) iteratively proposes and refines heuristics, pairing design rationales with executable code. Task-specific evaluators assess programs; execution outcomes and performance scores guide search. Many AHD systems keep the generator frozen; EvoTune and Co-Evolution of Algorithms and Language Model (CALM) instead update it from evaluated candidates. When such outcomes drive reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), they create a search-coupled loop: the evaluated candidate stream supplies both search-state updates and training signals for the model that generates future candidates. Yet validity and performance do not uniquely determine useful model updates; converting them into learning signals must account for the prompt and evolving search state that produced each candidate. We formulate online post-training of small open-weight LLMs in AHD as context-dependent signal construction and develop alternative mappings from program validity, task performance, and generation context to update signals. Using shared evaluated rollouts and matched update budgets, controlled experiments across AHD tasks and model families compare these mappings with online post-training baselines, testing their effects on validity, performance among valid proposals, and the yield of valid proposals that improve under contextual comparisons. Complementary checkpoint, frozen-search, and live-system evaluations assess whether proposal-level gains appear in updated checkpoint behavior and subsequent search, rather than arising solely from accumulated search state. A resource-matched comparison under pre-specified cost accounting tests whether online updating adds value beyond additional search with a frozen generator. Together, this design avoids treating end-to-end search gains alone as evidence of stronger heuristic-design capabilities.

</details>


### [485] [Scaling Laws for Looped Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40316)
*Yanbei Chen,Anirudh Goyal,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个联合建模循环（recurrence）与稀疏（MoE）的缩放定律 Loop Scaling Laws，准确预测循环模型损失并指导循环MoE设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环与MoE是两条互补的高效扩展路径，但现有缩放定律只孤立建模其中之一，无法刻画两者交互带来的收益。

Method: 提出有界、稀疏条件化的循环映射，统一刻画循环带来的有效参数增益及稀疏对增益的提升，并将标准稠密与MoE缩放定律作为特例纳入。

Result: 预测留出损失比现有方法更准；稀疏带来约3倍活跃参数效率，循环带来约2倍总参数效率；万亿token规模下，匹配训练算力的循环MoE可匹敌约2倍大的非循环MoE，并支持递归式测试时扩展。

Conclusion: 循环与稀疏两条轴互补，联合缩放可推进性能前沿，为算力与内存约束下的循环MoE设计提供理论基础。

Abstract: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. Yet existing scaling laws model recurrence or sparsity in isolation. In this work, we introduce Loop Scaling Laws, the first scaling law to jointly model recurrence and sparsity alongside model size and data. At its core is a bounded, sparsity-conditional recurrence mapping that characterizes the effective-parameter gain from looping and how sparsity raises this gain. The laws predict the held-out loss of looped models more accurately than prior alternatives, and recover the standard dense and MoE scaling laws as special cases. Beyond prediction, the fitted laws provide a principled foundation for designing looped MoE models under compute and memory constraints. Downstream evaluations further demonstrate the complementary benefits of the two axes: sparsity delivers ~3x active-parameter efficiency, recurrence yields ~2x total-parameter efficiency on reasoning, and joint scaling further advances the performance frontier. As a practical extension, we show these gains hold at trillion-token scale: at matched training compute, a looped MoE with law-derived recurrence matches a ~2x larger non-looped MoE on the reasoning benchmarks, while enabling test-time scaling through recurrence.

</details>


### [486] [When, Not How Much: Evaluating Time-Series Foundation Models on Sparse Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39386)
*Daniel Schoess,Florian von Wangenheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）虽被广泛评估为预测器，但在稀疏序列上很多决策只关心未来哪些时段有活动。作者基于五个稀疏数据集提出"事件排序"评测，发现已发布点预测相较无需训练参考基准几乎无增益；而在冻结骨干上轻量事件探针排序更好，甚至超过部分原始上下文基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练时间序列基础模型通常只被评估为"预测未来值"的工具。然而对于稀疏时间序列，许多实际决策只取决于未来哪些时段包含事件（活动），而非具体数值。标准基准未评估这一能力，因此缺少对TSFM在稀疏事件排序任务上的系统分析。

Method: 在五个稀疏数据集上，对预测窗口内同时含事件与零值的位置进行排序评测。评估12个TSFM的已发布点预测，并与无需训练参考基准对比；同时在六个冻结骨干上训练线性探针（带事件监督），并与各骨干的点预测、梯度提升树（原始上下文）、随机初始化特征等基线做对照。

Result: 12个TSFM点预测在机会校正平均精度上最多仅比无需训练参考高0.031，中位TSFM的机会校正AUC在每个数据集上都低于参考。带事件监督的探针在30个骨干—数据集组合中的29个优于其骨干点预测。对预测分位数取平均（而非取中位数）可改善多数预测中位数的TSFM的排序，两个数据集上最强输出可与探针媲美。探针相对原始上下文学习器的优势依数据集而异；同一探针下，六个骨干中有五个的预训练特征优于随机初始化特征。最佳探针在五个数据集中的三个上超过在原始上下文上训练的梯度提升树。

Conclusion: 对稀疏事件排序而言，已发布点预测相较简单参考基准增益有限；而冻结TSFM上的轻量事件头排序表现更好。更广泛地，评估预训练预测器时若超出数值预测任务，需同时报告其输出、表征的监督探针、以及原始上下文与随机化对照，因为每类证据支持不同结论。

Abstract: Pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are evaluated as forecasters of future values, yet for sparse series many decisions depend only on which future periods contain activity. Standard benchmarks do not assess this. On five sparse datasets, we rank positions within forecast windows that contain both events and zeros. The released point forecasts of 12 TSFMs improve chance-corrected average precision over training-free references by at most 0.031, and in chance-corrected AUC the median TSFM falls below them on every dataset. With event supervision, linear probes of six frozen backbones improve on their backbone's point forecast in 29 of 30 backbone--dataset pairs. Averaging the predicted quantiles instead of taking their median improves the ranking of most TSFMs that forecast the median, and on two datasets the strongest such outputs rival the probes. The probes' advantage over raw-context learners depends on the dataset, and under the same probe, pretrained features outperform randomly initialized ones for five of six backbones. For sparse-event ranking, released point forecasts thus add little over simple references, whereas lightweight event heads on frozen TSFMs rank events better than these forecasts, and the best of them exceed gradient-boosted trees trained on the raw context on three of the five datasets. More broadly, assessing pretrained forecasters on tasks beyond value forecasting requires reporting their outputs, supervised probes of their representations, and raw-context and randomized controls side by side, since each supports a different conclusion.

</details>


### [487] [Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40360)
*Junshu Pan,Zhizhang Fu,Shulin Huang,Yiran Ding,Zifan Cheng,Wenqi Shao,Qiaosheng Zhang,Yue Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCAPO，将半事实稳定性引入GRPO的token级信用分配，提升LLM推理与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR虽提升LLM推理能力，但预测对任务无关的prompt特征敏感；GRPO将同一结果优势分配给每个token，可能强化虚假依赖。作者通过半事实prompt干预（保持问题与答案不变）发现token级敏感性差异大，抑制高漂移token可提升准确率而无需更新权重。

Method: SCAPO是GRPO的因果启发变体：在半事实干预下测量固定响应的token概率漂移，用归一化稳定性分数在训练早期降低相对不稳定token的优势，但稳定性本身不额外给予信用。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，AIME 2024-2026准确率较GRPO分别提升5.63和4.17个百分点；两个规模上，SCAPO在多数数学基准及所有分布外基准上均取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 半事实稳定性为RLVR提供有效的训练信号，通过更细粒度的信用分配改善推理与泛化。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.

</details>


### [488] [Beyond Simulation: Retain-and-Repair Neural Operators for Real-World Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39387)
*Woojin Cho,Junghwan Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出R²NO框架，将仿真预训练的神经算子适配到真实数据，通过频域分块的谱集成修复，在RealPDEBench上超越全量微调和迭代细化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子从数值仿真预训练中受益，但适配到真实世界预测仍具挑战，需要在适配新数据的同时保留预训练中有用的结构。

Method: 先对预训练算子进行真实数据微调并冻结以产生源预测；共享修复模块从相同观测学习一系列细化。利用正交傅里叶投影，谱集成在每个频域单元内拟合小型岭回归，并用留出的真实数据分片拟合权重组合各细化。单元由径向范围、角度扇区和测量通道联合定义，使细化深度随频率大小、方向和通道变化；源预测作为候选使保留在每个单元可用，独立训练的修复模块作为额外候选进入组合。

Result: 在RealPDEBench所有系统和六个骨干网络上，R²NO持续超越全量微调与迭代细化。

Conclusion: 该框架将适配深度视为从真实数据学习的逐单元选择。

Abstract: Neural operators increasingly benefit from pretraining on numerical simulations, yet adapting them for real-world prediction remains challenging. We introduce the Retain-and-Repair Neural Operator (R$^2$NO), a framework for adapting simulation-pretrained operators to real-world data while retaining useful pretrained structure. The pretrained operator is first finetuned on real data and then frozen to provide a source prediction, and a shared repair module learns a sequence of refinements from the same observations. Using orthogonal Fourier projections, a spectral ensemble fits a small ridge regression within each cell of the Fourier domain and combines the refinements by weights fitted on a held-out split of the real data. The cells are defined jointly by radial ranges, angular sectors, and measured channels, allowing refinement depth to vary with frequency magnitude, with orientation, and across channels. Including the source prediction as a candidate makes retention available in every cell, and independently trained repair modules enter the same combination as additional candidates. On all RealPDEBench systems and six backbones, R$^2$NO consistently outperforms full finetuning and iterative refinement. The framework treats adaptation depth as a cell-specific choice learned from real data.

</details>


### [489] [Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40361)
*Tian Xia,Minghao Liu,Yiqing Liang,Laixi Shi,Jiayun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Ranking-PE，将反射式提示演化中的正确性分数矩阵替换为成对排序矩阵，使列均值等价于AUROC，从而在类别极不平衡的临床诊断任务中优化MLLM提示，显著提升排序性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM临床诊断适配流程仍以准确率为目标，而临床数据高度类别不平衡，常数多数预测器准确率可超90%却无临床价值。准确率本身对类别均衡敏感，因此需要优化与类别分布无关的排序指标AUROC。现有反射式提示优化方法（如GEPA）依赖逐实例正确性矩阵，其列均值即准确率，无法直接优化排名。

Method: 提出成对Pareto提示演化（Ranking-PE）：将正确性行替换为(正例,负例)实例对上的成对排序行，若候选提示给正例打分高于负例则记为1，此时列均值等于经验AUROC（依据Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney恒等式）。在提示演化搜索的三个层面统一替换：决定Pareto支配的分数矩阵、反馈给反射LM的逐样本反馈、以及最终候选选择。不增加模型调用，也不引入代理损失。

Result: 在MIMIC三个疾病上，基于准确率的提示演化会损害排序性能，而Ranking-PE逆转该趋势：在微调Qwen3-VL-8B上比准确率方案提升+5.8 AUROC百分点，在MedGemma-4B上提升+16.2个百分点。消融实验验证各设计组件，并表明医学级视觉骨干（经视觉编码器微调SFT或医学预训练）是提示搜索无法替代的前提条件。

Conclusion: 将反射式提示演化从纯文本数据扩展到多模态临床决策，通过成对排序目标直接优化AUROC，在类别不平衡场景下优于准确率驱动方案；但需配合医学级视觉骨干才有效。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly advancing clinical diagnosis, yet their adaptation pipelines remain anchored to accuracy-based objectives. Clinical data are heavily class-imbalanced: a constant-majority predictor can score above 90% accuracy while being clinically useless. We therefore evaluate and optimize for AUROC, a threshold-free score that ranks positives above negatives and is invariant to class balance. We focus on prompt optimization in MLLMs. Reflective methods such as GEPA use a binary scores matrix with one row per evaluation instance and one column per candidate prompt; cells record per-instance correctness, so the column average is accuracy and drives candidate selection. We introduce pair-level Pareto prompt evolution (Ranking-PE), which replaces each correctness row with a pairwise-ordering row over (positive, negative) instance pairs: the cell is 1 if the candidate scores the positive higher than the paired negative. The column average then equals empirical AUROC (by the Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney identity). We apply this swap at all three layers the prompt evolution search reads from - the scores matrix that decides Pareto dominance, the per-example feedback to the reflection LM, and final candidate selection - at no extra model calls and with no surrogate loss. Across three diseases on MIMIC, accuracy-based prompt evolution can degrade ranking; Ranking-PE reverses this, beating the accuracy-based recipe by +5.8 AUROC pp on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 pp on MedGemma-4B. Ablations examine each design component and show that a medical-grade visual backbone - via vision-encoder-tuned SFT or medical pretraining - is a prerequisite that prompt search cannot replace - our recipe extends reflective prompt evolution from text-only data to multimodal clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [490] [Decoupled and Distilled: Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer for Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39390)
*Hongwei Zhao,Rui Liu,Yansong Liu,Zhiyuan Zou,Yong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TALON 提出一种推理高效的小样本类增量学习框架，为每个增量任务分配独立LoRA-Teacher，再通过集成知识蒸馏将多个冻结教师统一到单一LoRA-Student，兼顾性能与部署效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FSCIL需在极少样本下学习新类并保留旧知识。现有预训练模型参数高效微调方法存在两个问题：严格梯度约束在严重数据稀缺时不可靠；多专家方法推理成本高。

Method: TALON动态为每个增量任务分配独立LoRA-Teacher以学习任务特定表示；随后通过Ensemble Knowledge Transfer将多个冻结教师蒸馏进统一LoRA-Student，消除运行时模块选择或生成。并采用语义引导蒸馏策略，按特征空间相似度加权教师贡献，缓解灾难性遗忘与过拟合。

Result: 在四个FSCIL基准、三次类序运行中取得可比或更优平均准确率：CUB200 86.68±1.22%、CIFAR100 90.39±0.27%、ImageNet-R 78.38±0.94%、miniImageNet 96.34±0.33%。部署参数最多减少33倍，平均每任务推理时间降至26.7秒，相较ASP减少41.70%。

Conclusion: TALON通过教师-学生集成知识蒸馏框架，在保持FSCIL性能的同时显著降低部署参数量与推理时间，验证了高效推理FSCIL方案的可行性。

Abstract: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) addresses the challenge of learning new classes from very limited samples while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods with pre-trained models show promise for class-incremental learning, strict gradient-based constraints can be unreliable under severe data scarcity, while multi-expert approaches can impose substantial inference-time costs. We propose TALON (Task-Adaptive LoRA-Teachers with Ensemble Knowledge Transfer), an inference-efficient FSCIL framework. TALON dynamically allocates an independent LoRA-Teacher to each incremental task for task-specific representation learning, then distills multiple frozen teachers into a unified LoRA-Student through Ensemble Knowledge Transfer, eliminating runtime module selection or generation. A semantic-guided distillation strategy weights teacher contributions by feature-space similarity to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and overfitting. Across three class-order runs, TALON achieves comparable or better mean average accuracy across four FSCIL benchmarks, obtaining 86.68 +/- 1.22% on CUB200, 90.39 +/- 0.27% on CIFAR100, 78.38 +/- 0.94% on ImageNet-R, and 96.34 +/- 0.33% on miniImageNet. TALON uses up to 33x fewer deployment parameters and reduces average inference time per task to 26.7 s, a 41.70% reduction relative to ASP.

</details>


### [491] [No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39405)
*Jingang Zhou,Feiyu Han,Han Zhu,Yuyi Zhou,Ruiyang Zhang,Jian Xu,Sirui Gao,Qingpei Guo,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: on-policy蒸馏产生的任务向量可与RL教师更新互补，并跨任务有效组合，弱性能不代表弱可组合性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务向量能组合能力，但OPD任务向量的可组合性未被探索。OPD用学生在自生成轨迹上的教师反馈训练，其参数更新不同于RL教师更新。作者问：OPD任务向量能否与RL教师更新互补并跨任务组合？

Method: 在5个领域、2种模型架构上，比较OPD与RL任务向量的合并：任务内合并两者；跨任务用不同backbone-merging规则组合；并对参数空间做分析（非共线性、方向互补性、top-10%前馈通道重叠度）。

Result: 任务内，合并OPD与RL任务向量可超过各自模型，即使OPD学生弱于RL教师；跨任务，OPD组合在8组backbone-merging-rule比较中7组平均分更高。参数空间显示OPD与RL更新显著非共线；SmolLM3-3B的CODE实验中组合方向优于任一成分方向；OPD更新在top-10%前馈通道上重叠更低。

Conclusion: 较弱独立性能不等于较弱任务向量可组合性。OPD任务向量能互补更强的RL教师更新并跨任务有效组合，可组合性可作为理解与评估后训练更新的独立属性。

Abstract: Task vectors provide a simple mechanism for composing learned capabilities through model merging. However, the composability of task vectors produced by on-policy distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. OPD trains a student using teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, yielding parameter updates that differ from those produced by the teacher model, usually by reinforcement learning (RL). We therefore ask whether OPD task vectors can complement their RL teacher updates and compose effectively across tasks. Across five domains and two model architectures, we find evidence for both forms of composability. Within a task, merging OPD and RL task vectors can outperform both constituent models, even when the OPD student is weaker than its RL teacher. Across tasks, OPD task-vector compositions achieve higher average scores than corresponding RL compositions in seven of eight backbone-merging-rule comparisons. Parameter-space analyses reveal substantial non-collinearity between OPD and RL updates. Experiment in CODE domain on SMOLLM3-3B shows that the combined direction outperforms either constituent direction at the tested global update norm, supporting directional complementarity in this configuration. Across tasks, OPD updates also show lower overlap among the top-10% feed-forward channels ranked by update energy. Together, these results show that weaker standalone performance does not imply weaker task-vector composability. OPD task vectors can complement stronger RL teacher updates and combine effectively across tasks, highlighting composability as a distinct property for understanding and evaluating post-training updates.

</details>


### [492] [From Imitation to Reward Discovery: On-Policy Warmup for Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39436)
*Yitong Qiao,Tiantian He,Lei Liu,Yue Shen,Jian Wang,Jinjie Gu,Zhixuan Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Warmup (OPW)：在RLVR前用教师监督训练学生自身轨迹，经实验与理论证明可加速RLVR、提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR依赖稀疏结果奖励，早期训练缺乏策略改进信号，导致学习缓慢。

Method: 先用教师对学生自身交互轨迹做on-policy reverse-KL蒸馏（OPW），再转入RLVR；理论将其与轨迹级分布匹配关联，并分析初始验证成功下界与奖励发现复杂度。

Result: 观察到On-Policy Acceleration现象：on-policy蒸馏初始化的RLVR更早达到高性能，且后续RLVR平均性能和最终性能均优于基线；理论给出成功概率与group-relative RLVR奖励信息性的联系。

Conclusion: on-policy蒸馏是agentic RLVR的有效warmup，初始奖励发现可作为加速机制。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with a verifiable reward (RLVR) offers a scalable approach to training language-model agents, yet sparse outcome rewards can leave early training with little signal for policy improvement. We identify an On-Policy Acceleration Phenomenon: in our main comparisons, RLVR initialized with on-policy distillation reaches high performance earlier in training and achieves both higher average performance during subsequent RLVR and higher final performance than the alternative baselines. Motivated by this observation, we study On-Policy Warmup (OPW), a teacher-guided stage in which the student trains with teacher supervision on its own interaction trajectories before transitioning to RLVR. Unlike imitation on fixed teacher-generated trajectories, OPW targets states induced by the student's own decisions, including imperfect actions and recovery situations. We provide a theoretical explanation by connecting on-policy reverse-KL distillation to trajectory-level distribution matching. Under a competent teacher and sufficiently small population distillation loss, this connection yields a lower bound on initial verifier success and a corresponding bound on reward-discovery complexity. For group-relative RLVR, we further characterize when increased success probability produces more reward-informative groups. Together, our findings support on-policy distillation as an effective warmup for agentic RLVR and identify initial reward discovery as a mechanism that can contribute to the observed acceleration.

</details>


### [493] [Network-based Spatial Context Retrieval for Open-weight LLMs: A Faithfulness Benchmark for Grounded Geographic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39437)
*Joan Perez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在提供结构化空间上下文后，是依据上下文推理还是被自身参数记忆覆盖，并提出基于网络的空间上下文检索流程与忠实性基准进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽编码大量地理知识，但空间推理能力差，仅凭坐标查询不可靠；只有在提示中提供结构化空间上下文时才表现有用。一个地理评估未考察的问题是：即使提供了正确上下文，模型是基于它推理，还是用参数记忆覆盖它。

Method: 提出开放流程NSCR：以行人街道网络定义点的可达范围，仅用开放数据与开放权重模型，从OpenStreetMap和GHS-POP人口格网检索特征，在网络集水区上计算指标，并注入为紧凑空间简报。据此构建忠实性基准，按来源（简报支撑 vs 训练知识）和正确性标注模型的每个主张，并用简报可反驳的植入错误前提探测每个案例。

Result: 评估三个城市上16种开放权重模型配置（Qwen、Gemma、Llama三家族，Gemma两代，四个规模等级，含思考与非思考模式），每案例10个种子重采样。结果显示对植入前提的抵抗能力更多随模型家族和代际变化而非规模变化；简报阅读能力构成部分独立维度。

Conclusion: 这些行为无法被传统世界正确性分数或单次评估捕捉。作者开源实现、空间简报、模型输出与主张级标注，形成可复现工作流。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial latent geographic knowledge, yet they reason poorly over space and are unreliable when queried from coordinates alone. Useful behaviour emerges only when structured spatial context is supplied in the prompt. This raises a question geographic evaluation has left unexamined: once the right context is supplied, does the model reason from it, or override it with its own parametric recall? We take up this question with an open pipeline for network-based spatial context retriev-al. In it, the surroundings of a selected point are defined by the pedestrian street network, the area actually reachable on foot. Using only open data and open-weight models, the pipeline retrieves features from OpenStreetMap and the GHS-POP population grid, computes indicators over the network catchment in code, and injects them as a compact spatial brief. On this basis we build a faithfulness benchmark. It labels every claim a model makes by its source (grounded in the brief, or drawn from training knowledge) and its correctness, and it probes each case with a planted false premise that the brief refutes. We evaluate sixteen open-weight model configurations across three families (Qwen, Gemma and Llama, with Gemma in two generations), four size classes and, where available, both thinking and non-thinking modes, on three con-trasting cities, resampling every case over ten seeds. The results show that resistance to the planted premise varies more strongly by model family and generation than by scale, while brief-reading competence forms a partly separate dimension. These behaviours are not captured by conventional world-correctness scores or single-shot evaluation. We release the implementation, spatial briefs, model outputs, and claim-level labels as a reproducible workflow at github.com/perezjoan/NSCR-LLM.

</details>


### [494] [Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39456)
*Ho-min Park,Byungkon Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MEQ互反馈架构，将两个（可能不同模态的）输入迭代耦合为互相包含对方信息的嵌入对，最终输出定义为该交互的不动点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多以拼接等简单方式融合多模态信息，缺乏两个输入之间持续的信息交换，难以充分挖掘互补模态的作用。

Method: 设计由两个组件构成的互反馈架构，输出互馈到对方，形成连续信息交换；将最终输出定义为交互的不动点，并进行理论分析以解释模型并提供防止失败情形的设计选择。

Result: 在跨多个数据集的分类与视觉定位任务上验证：多模态分类中优于或媲美基于拼接的基线；视觉定位中与互补模态配对时能逐步精化定位结果。

Conclusion: 互反馈机制在多模态融合中有效，能持续交换信息并逐步改进结果，展示了该架构在互补模态场景下的潜力。

Abstract: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

</details>


### [495] [Understanding Head Geometry and Dynamics in Federated Regression through a Natural Solution Selection Rule: An Unconstrained Feature Model Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39464)
*Chuang Ma,Tomoyuki Obuchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究联邦平均中局部最优头选择歧义，提出"最近广播头"选择规则，用UFM刻画共享Gram矩阵的动态与偏差，并给出纠正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦平均中局部目标可能有多个最优头，导致全局聚合依赖客户端返回哪个头，这一歧义此前缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 在隐私骨干+共享线性头的联邦多元回归中，采用无约束特征模型(UFM)，引入"客户端返回最接近广播头的最优头"选择规则，用消失的近端惩罚实现该规则，并推导共享Gram矩阵的递归、极限(客户端最优Gram矩阵的Bures-Wasserstein重心)及偏差分解，另提出一次性交换目标均值和协方差的纠正方案。

Result: 当客户端最优Gram矩阵与初始共享Gram矩阵正定时，共享Gram矩阵按闭式递归收敛到唯一的Bures-Wasserstein重心，但一般不等于集中式最优Gram矩阵；该差距可分解为客户端目标均值差异、协方差异质性与对齐头平均三项半正定项；纠正方案在精确局部优化与相同选择规则下，一轮即可恢复集中式最优Gram矩阵。

Conclusion: 数值实验在UFM及五个表格、五个图像回归数据集上验证了预测：普通训练趋于重心，弱近端惩罚改善端点一致性与轨迹吻合，纠正使最终Gram矩阵接近集中式UFM预测。

Abstract: In federated averaging, local objectives can admit multiple optimal heads, making the aggregate depend on which heads clients return. We study this ambiguity in federated multivariate regression with private backbones and a shared linear head, using an unconstrained feature model (UFM) that treats training-sample features as free variables. We introduce a natural selection rule: each client returns the optimal head closest to the broadcast head. We show that global minimization with a vanishing proximal penalty on the head realizes this rule. When the clients' optimal Gram matrices and the initial shared Gram matrix are positive definite, the shared Gram matrix follows a closed recursion and converges to the unique Bures-Wasserstein barycenter of the clients' optimal Gram matrices. Even with this alignment, the limit generally differs from the centralized optimal Gram matrix. We decompose this gap into three positive-semidefinite terms arising from differences in client target means, covariance heterogeneity, and averaging the aligned heads. A correction based on a one-time exchange of target means and covariances recovers the centralized optimal Gram matrix in one round under exact local optimization and the same selection rule. We verify these results numerically in the UFM and test its predictions on five tabular and five image regression datasets using deep networks with feature regularization and long local training. In these experiments, ordinary training approaches the predicted barycenter, while a weak proximal penalty improves endpoint agreement and yields trajectories that closely follow the predicted Gram dynamics. The correction moves the final Gram matrices close to the centralized UFM prediction.

</details>


### [496] [Also Small Models Can Reasonably Self-Evaluate Their Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39478)
*Idil Kapikiran,Thomas Decker,Thomas Runkler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了不同规模语言模型在通用到专业问答任务上的自评估不确定性量化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究模型规模与领域专业性如何影响自评估置信信号的质量，以判断小模型能否胜任可靠的不确定性量化。

Method: 采用多种自评估方法（模型评判自身预测），在从通用到专业知识的问答任务上，对不同规模的语言模型进行系统评估。

Result: 准确率随模型变小和领域变专业而下降，但自评估置信的可靠性在两个维度上基本保持稳定；最强模型不一定是自评估最优的。

Conclusion: 小模型虽准确率较低，但可获得合理的自评估置信，适用于资源受限场景。

Abstract: This study systematically evaluates self-evaluation-based uncertainty quantification across different language models of varying sizes on question-answering tasks spanning general to specialized knowledge domains. Using various self-evaluation methods where models judge their own predictions, we examine how model scale and domain specificity affect the quality of self-assessed confidence signals. Our results reveal that while accuracy predictably declines with smaller models and more specialized domains, the reliability of self-evaluated confidence remains largely stable across both dimensions. This independence means the most capable model is not necessarily the best at self-assessing prediction reliability. These findings suggest that smaller models can achieve reasonable self-assessed confidence despite lower accuracy, making them viable for resource-constrained deployments.

</details>


### [497] [Correcting CondOT: Exact Finite-Step Sampling in Gaussian Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39488)
*Ron Levy,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究高斯目标下flow matching中点采样法的调度依赖误差，证明CondOT调度可抵消主阶中点误差并改进收敛界，并构造出逼近CondOT的噪声调度实现精确高斯采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Flow matching通过有限采样步骤将噪声转为数据时，会引入依赖调度的数值误差，需厘清调度选择对采样精度的影响。

Method: 针对高斯目标与显式中点采样法，使用精确流场，以目标分布与中点采样器最终分布间的平方Wasserstein距离度量采样误差，分析CondOT调度在不同（含非均匀）采样步下的作用。

Result: CondOT调度能抵消主阶中点误差并改善一般收敛界；在S步均匀网格上固定信号调度α_t=t，证明存在以速率1/S逼近CondOT噪声调度1-t的标量噪声调度β_t，对足够大的S实现精确高斯采样。

Conclusion: 调度设计显著影响中点采样精度，CondOT噪声调度在理论上具有最优性，且可通过近似实现精确高斯采样；高斯实验验证了收敛速率与精确校准。

Abstract: Flow matching generates samples by gradually transforming noise into data. In practice, using a finite number of sampling steps introduces a numerical error that depends on the chosen schedule. We study this dependence for Gaussian targets and the explicit midpoint sampling method, using the exact flow field. We measure sampling error by the squared Wasserstein distance between the target distribution and the final distribution produced by the midpoint sampler. We show that the standard conditional optimal transport (CondOT) schedule cancels the leading midpoint error and improves the general convergence bound, even when the sampling steps are unequally spaced. On a uniform grid of $S$ sampling steps, we fix the signal schedule at $α_t=t$ and prove the existence of scalar noise schedules $β_t$ that approach the CondOT noise schedule $1-t$ at rate $1/S$ and yield exact Gaussian sampling for every sufficiently large $S$. Controlled Gaussian experiments illustrate the convergence rates and exact calibration.

</details>


### [498] [Towards Robust Time Series Learning via Capacity-Centric Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39489)
*Siru Zhong,Senzhang Wang,James T. Kwok,Yuxuan Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出样本自适应容量调节框架SACM，利用谱稀疏性为每个样本分配内部激活路径的dropout概率，作为互补的样本自适应正则化原则，在多种时间序列任务上提升性能且无测试时开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度时间序列学习中普遍存在样本级可靠性异质性，标准训练对所有样本采用统一正则化设置，导致对损坏样本欠正则化、对干净样本过度限制。现有鲁棒性方法要么在数据空间过滤观测，要么对潜在表示施加先验，存在局限。

Method: 提出以容量为中心的正则化调制原则（CCM），并据此设计SACM框架。SACM利用谱稀疏性沿着内部激活路径为每个样本分配样本级的dropout概率，可无缝集成到现有骨干网络中，无需结构重设计，且保持确定性推理流程。

Result: 在301个真实数据集-骨干网络组合上（覆盖9个预测、32个分类和4个异常检测数据集），相较未修改的骨干网络，SACM平均降低预测MSE 6.7%，分类准确率提升3.04%，点调整F1提升17.05%，且零测试时开销。

Conclusion: SACM作为一种任务无关的样本自适应容量调节方法，能有效缓解样本级可靠性异质性问题，在预测、分类和异常检测任务上均取得显著提升，同时保持推理效率和即插即用特性。

Abstract: Sample-level reliability heterogeneity is common in deep time series learning. Standard training pipelines apply a uniform regularization setting to all samples, which can under-regularize corrupted samples and over-restrict clean samples. Common robustness approaches filter observations in data space or impose priors on latent representations. We propose Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) as a complementary, sample-adaptive regularization principle. Under this principle, we introduce SACM (Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation), a task-agnostic framework that exploits spectral sparsity to assign sample-wise dropout probabilities along internal activation paths. SACM integrates into existing backbones without architectural redesign and preserves the deterministic inference pipeline. Across 301 real-world dataset-backbone pairs covering 9 forecasting, 32 classification, and 4 anomaly-detection datasets, SACM reduces forecasting MSE by 6.7% on average and improves classification accuracy and point-adjusted F1 by 3.04% and 17.05%, respectively, relative to unmodified backbones, with zero test-time overhead.

</details>


### [499] [Can Domain Generalization be Guaranteed in Small-Sample Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39512)
*Hong Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次为域泛化(DG)下的结构风险最小化(SRM)建立理论保证，基于稳定性概念推导学习一致性与泛化误差界，并探讨其在深度学习中的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小样本学习是机器学习的根本挑战，SRM在经典i.i.d.假设下是原则性解法，但域泛化违背该假设，SRM在DG中的理论作用尚未被探索。

Method: 基于稳定性(stability)概念，推导学习一致性与泛化误差界，证明假设满足稳定性条件时界变紧；在特定假设空间假设下，为SRM建立稳定性、学习与泛化界。

Result: 建立了DG下SRM的稳定性、学习与泛化误差界，证明稳定性条件下界更紧，并讨论了这些界对深度学习的适用性。

Conclusion: 本工作为分布偏移下的SRM奠定理论基础，并为小样本场景下鲁棒DG算法的设计提供启示。

Abstract: The small-sample learning problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning because limited training data lead to unstable model estimation and generalization. Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) has long been regarded as a principled solution under the classical i.i.d. assumption. However, domain generalization (DG) violates this assumption, leaving the theoretical role of SRM in DG largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we establish the first theoretical guarantees for SRM in DG under mild assumptions. Specifically, based on the concept of stability, we derive learning consistency and generalization error bounds and prove that these bounds become tight when the hypotheses satisfy the stability condition. Building upon this, under a specific hypothesis space assumption, we establish stability, learning, and generalization bounds for SRM. We further discuss the applicability of these bounds to deep learning. This work establishes theoretical foundations for SRM under distribution shifts and sheds light on the design of robust DG algorithms in small-sample scenarios.

</details>


### [500] [CIDER-FM: Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39523)
*Yuche Gao,Arik Reuter,Siyuan Guo,Anish Dhir,Bernhard Schölkopf,Adrian Weller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CIDER-FM，一个因果基础模型，通过结合有限观测数据和替代干预数据来更准确地预测目标条件干预分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠观测数据可能无法唯一确定因果模型，而对目标变量进行干预的实验数据往往不可得，因此需要利用替代实验（surrogate experiments）来辅助因果推断。

Method: 先形式化替代实验的概念优势，再提出CIDER-FM：采用干预感知表示（intervention-aware representation）和分层三轴注意力（hierarchical three-axis attention），在变量、样本和实验机制三个维度交换信息。

Result: 在多种合成图与机制族、以及Causal Chambers的模拟和真实数据上，CIDER-FM相比众多基线展现出强CID预测性能，且引入实验上下文能优于仅用观测数据。

Conclusion: 结合观测与替代干预数据可提升因果基础模型的目标条件干预分布预测，实验上下文对因果推断具有实质价值。

Abstract: Causal foundation models (CFMs) amortise causal inference over priors of synthetic structural causal models (SCMs), predicting the effect of an experiment on a specific variable. However, observational data alone may leave multiple causal models compatible with available evidence, while experimental data with interventions on exactly the variable of interest might be unavailable. This work studies CFMs as a method to combine finite observational and surrogate-interventional datasets in order to predict a target conditional interventional distribution (CID) more accurately than with observational data alone. We first formalise the conceptual benefits of surrogate experiments. Building on this analysis, we introduce \textsc{Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes} (\emph{CIDER-FM}), a causal foundation model that uses an intervention-aware representation and hierarchical three-axis attention to exchange information across variables, samples, and experimental regimes. We evaluate CIDER-FM against a wide range of baselines across diverse synthetic graph and mechanism families, as well as on both simulated and real-world data from Causal Chambers. Our results demonstrate strong CID prediction performance and show that incorporating experimental context can improve predictions over observational data alone.

</details>


### [501] [Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39547)
*Bo Han,Qianyi Wang,Shuai Liu,Xiong Zifan,Changqiao Wu,Yuanfa Li,Pengzhi Gao,Wei Liu,Jian Luan,Heng Qu,Yunpeng Song,Zhongmin Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个框架，将GUI智能体的知识获取与噪声鲁棒利用相结合，使其能在不完美先验下正确行动，并在真实设备与模拟器基准上取得更高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI任务依赖应用专属且时效性强的操作知识，预训练语料稀缺，导致模型在未见应用和复杂多步任务上表现差。检索增强虽可缓解，但面临知识规模获取难、自采先验易随版本更新、促销、广告、A/B测试和个性化而漂移的问题。作者主张不应追求完美知识，而应让智能体学会在不完美先验下正确行动。

Method: 框架包含两部分：1）结构化探索策略，遍历交互元素、构建UI状态转移图，并用VLM合成（任务，轨迹）对，无需人工标注；2）噪声感知训练策略，基于真实GUI漂移模式分类，向自探索轨迹注入五类现实错误，训练智能体在行动前评估先验可靠性。

Result: 在物理设备和在线模拟器基准上，该方法发现更多独特屏幕、覆盖更多基准任务，更有效拒绝错误先验并利用正确先验，准确率提升可跨数据集迁移。

Conclusion: GUI智能体应转向在不完美先验下行动的能力，通过知识获取与噪声鲁棒利用的结合，可显著提升真实复杂环境中的任务表现。

Abstract: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ads, A/B tests, and personalization. We therefore argue that GUI agents should not pursue perfect knowledge but learn to act correctly under imperfect priors, and propose our framework that couples knowledge acquisition with noise-robust utilization: a structured exploration strategy traverses interactive elements, builds a UI state-transition graph, and synthesizes (task, trajectory) pairs via a VLM without human annotation; a noise-aware training strategy, grounded in a taxonomy of real GUI drift patterns, injects five types of realistic errors into self-explored trajectories to teach the agent to assess prior reliability before acting. Experiments on physical devices and online emulator benchmarks show that our method discovers more unique screens, covers more benchmark tasks, and more effectively rejects erroneous priors while leveraging correct ones, with accuracy gains that transfer across datasets.

</details>


### [502] [Hyperbolic Prototype Routing for Rehearsal-Free Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39550)
*HongWei Zhao,Rui Liu,Yong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyPro是一个无需回放的类增量学习框架，为每个增量任务分配专用LoRA专家模块，并通过双曲空间原型路由实现可靠的推理匹配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于预训练模型参数高效微调的CIL方法存在累积干扰导致的灾难性遗忘，以及推理时模块与样本匹配不佳的问题。

Method: 为每个增量任务分配专用LoRA-Expert模块实现隔离表征学习；将路由特征投影到Poincaré球上，用测地最近原型匹配进行任务级判别。

Result: 在标准CIL和Few-Shot CIL基准上，HyPro在平均准确率和最终阶段准确率上持续优于强基线。

Conclusion: HyPro通过任务隔离的LoRA专家与双曲原型路由，有效缓解灾难性遗忘并提升增量学习性能。

Abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to continually learn new classes while preserving prior knowledge. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with pre-trained models enables CIL with minimal parameter updates, but existing approaches still suffer from catastrophic forgetting caused by cumulative interference and suboptimal module-sample matching at inference. We propose Hyperbolic Prototype Routing (HyPro), a rehearsal-free framework for continual learning. HyPro allocates a dedicated LoRA-Expert module to each incremental task for isolated representation learning, then projects routing features onto a Poincare ball and performs geodesic nearest-prototype matching for reliable task-level discrimination. Extensive experiments on standard CIL and Few-Shot CIL benchmarks show that HyPro consistently improves average and final-stage accuracy over strong baselines.

</details>


### [503] [Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39560)
*Michael Helcig,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Self-Repulsion (SR)采样方法，用于掩码扩散语言模型，通过同伴承诺惩罚实现多样化采样，训练无关，在GSM8K等基准上提升投票准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样多样本并投票可提升语言模型准确率，但重复答案使额外样本收益递减；提高温度虽增多样性却可能损害单样本准确率。因此需要一种在保持单样本质量的同时产生多样化路径的采样方法。

Method: SR在去噪步骤中根据同伴已承诺同一位置token的数量降低该token的logit（同伴承诺惩罚）。路径共享批量前向传播，随后按序列承诺，使后续路径观察同一步中较早路径的选择。无需训练或额外前/反向传播，可在温度为零时产生不同路径；当所有路径从相同logit共同承诺某位置时，更新恰好最大化总logit减去凸重复代价。

Result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上，10条路径、128步去噪：确定性SR在GSM8K达到80.38%多数投票准确率，无惩罚贪心解码为70.17%。温度0.6且模型评估预算匹配时，计数惩罚在32块中比self-consistency提升2.06个百分点，纯扩散下提升14.50。在GSM8K、MATH和TruthfulQA上，投票收益主要来自对正确答案覆盖率的提升。

Conclusion: SR是一种无需训练的扩散模型采样器，通过同伴承诺惩罚有效促进样本多样性，显著提升多数投票准确率；增益因基准与解码机制而异，主要源于提高正确答案覆盖率。

Abstract: Sampling several responses and voting over their answers can improve a language model's accuracy, but repeated answers limit the benefit of additional samples. Raising temperature increases diversity at a potential cost to per-sample accuracy. We introduce Self-Repulsion (SR), a sampler for masked diffusion language models that uses peer commitments to diversify the pool. At each penalized denoising step, each path lowers a token's logit according to how many peers have committed that token at the same position. Paths share a batched forward pass and then commit in sequence, so later paths observe choices made earlier in the same step. This coupling requires no training or additional forward or backward pass and can produce distinct paths even at temperature zero. When all paths commit a position together from identical logits, the update exactly maximizes total logit minus a convex duplication cost. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct with ten paths and 128 denoising steps, deterministic SR reaches 80.38% plurality accuracy on GSM8K, compared with 70.17% for the unpenalized greedy decoder. At temperature 0.6 and matched model-evaluation budgets, the count penalty improves over self-consistency by 2.06 percentage points in blocks of 32 and 14.50 under pure diffusion. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH and TruthfulQA show that voting gains arise mainly from higher coverage of correct answers, with gains that vary by benchmark and decoding regime.

</details>


### [504] [Candidate Retention for Abductive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39561)
*Hao-Yuan He,Yu Liu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Abductive Candidate Retention (ACR)方法，通过选择保留候选子集来平衡监督锐度与模型覆盖，改善溯因学习中的伪标签选择问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 溯因学习结合神经感知与符号推理，同一符号目标的多个有效解释可能给相同输入赋予冲突标签。现有策略要么选单一候选作伪标签（可能强化错误），要么对所有候选加权（可能分散监督），因此需要选择保留子集来平衡监督锐度与模型质量覆盖。

Method: 用保留不确定性、丢弃模型质量和模型不匹配来界定坐标级监督误差。对于固定模型和训练对，仅前两项依赖保留集。基于此提出ACR，利用这些项引导贪心添加：当候选恢复的质量超过保留不确定性的增量时接受该候选。

Result: 实验表明，在大多数评估的聚合模加法设置中，ACR相比单候选基线和A3BL提高了概念准确率。目标消融实验支持不确定性与后验质量的联合使用。

Conclusion: ACR通过以不确定性和后验质量为准则进行候选保留，有效缓解溯因学习中冲突标签监督问题，并优于单候选基线和A3BL。

Abstract: Abductive learning combines neural perception with symbolic reasoning, using explanations generated by abduction to supervise the perception model. Multiple valid explanations of the same symbolic target can assign conflicting labels to the same inputs. Common policies select a single candidate as a pseudo-label, which may reinforce mistaken assignments, or weight all candidates, which may spread supervision across competing labels. These risks motivate selecting a retained subset to balance supervision sharpness and model-mass coverage. To guide this choice, we bound the coordinate-level supervision error using retained uncertainty, discarded model mass, and model mismatch. For a fixed model and training pair, only the first two terms depend on the retained set. We propose Abductive Candidate Retention (ACR), which uses these terms to guide greedy additions, accepting a candidate when its recovered mass exceeds the increase in retained uncertainty. Experiments show that ACR improves concept accuracy over single-candidate baselines and A3BL in most evaluated aggregated mod-addition settings. Objective ablations support the joint use of uncertainty and posterior mass.

</details>


### [505] [Robust Transfer Learning for Paper ECG Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39581)
*Yinghao Xie,Zhenbang Dai,Haojun Wang,Jinyu Cai,Fabio Bonassi,Hongwu Chen,Johan Sundström,Jiawei Li,Antônio H. Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RobECG-CL，一种秩感知对比学习框架，用于鲁棒的纸面ECG表征学习，在退化、少样本和真实医院数据上均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的纸面ECG图像在版式、物理伪影和标签可用性方面差异很大，导致识别困难，亟需鲁棒的表示学习方法。

Method: 从标准12导联ECG记录出发，构造逐步退化、版式异构的纸面ECG视图，训练模型在同记录不变性与退化感知排序之间取得平衡。

Result: 在CODE-II和EchoNext合成压力测试中，严重退化下鲁棒性提升，少样本迁移优于对比学习基线；1%标签设置下超越波形基础模型ECG-FM；在312个医院样本、37个标签上取得最佳macro AUROC。

Conclusion: RobECG-CL通过秩感知对比学习有效提升了纸面ECG在退化、低标签场景下的表示鲁棒性，并在真实医院数据上验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Paper ECG recognition is challenging because real-world ECG images vary in layout, physical artifacts, and label availability. We introduce RobECG-CL, a rank-aware contrastive learning framework for robust paper ECG representation learning. Starting from standard 12-lead ECG recordings, we construct progressively degraded paper ECG views with heterogeneous layouts and train the model to balance same-recording invariance with degradation-aware ordering. Across synthetic stress tests on CODE-II and EchoNext, RobECG-CL improves robustness under severe degradation and few-shot transfer, outperforming contrastive learning baselines and surpassing the waveform-based foundation model, ECG-FM, in the 1% labeled setting. On 312 samples of hospital data with 37 labels, RobECG-CL achieves the best macro AUROC.

</details>


### [506] [Convergence of Practical Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz Iterations and Nesterov Momentum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39595)
*Hanyng Peng,Hui Wang,Yue Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对实际版 Muon（逐矩阵动量 + 固定步 Newton–Schulz + Nesterov 校正）给出耦合非凸目标上的收敛性分析，在较弱假设下得到平均 Frobenius 梯度范数的 O(T^{-1/4}) 界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分析常把 Muon 的有限步 Newton–Schulz 更新替换为精确极分解或全局正交化，无法刻画实际逐层更新、动量与 Nesterov 校正的联合行为。

Method: 在梯度依赖的 (L0,L1,q)-光滑性与有条件无偏、逐层有界方差的随机梯度下，直接分析逐矩阵有限步更新；通过下降不等式和将动量跟踪误差分解为初始化、噪声与漂移进行分析。

Result: 得到期望平均 Frobenius 梯度范数的 O(T^{-1/4}) 界；无需有界随机梯度、对称噪声或非零奇异值的统一下界，且当块数与问题常数固定时常数不含显式矩阵维数或秩因子；对原始五步 quintic 解析验证标量映射界，并给出核范数结果刻画更强谱条件下的秩依赖。

Conclusion: 该工作为实际逐层有限步 Muon 更新提供了理论保证，支持步依赖系数及耦合学习率与动量调度（含标准单系数 Nesterov 规则）。

Abstract: Practical Muon maintains momentum and performs a small, fixed number of Newton--Schulz iterations separately for each parameter matrix, often with a Nesterov correction. We analyze these layer-wise finite-step updates jointly on a coupled nonconvex objective, rather than replacing them by exact polar factors or one global orthogonalization. Under gradient-dependent $(\mathcal L_0,\mathcal L_1,q)$-smoothness and conditionally unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded layer-wise variance, we establish an $\mathcal O(T^{-1/4})$ bound on the expected average Frobenius gradient norm. The analysis retains the Nesterov recursion and requires neither bounded stochastic gradients, symmetric noise, nor a uniform positive lower bound on the nonzero output singular values. Its constants contain no explicit matrix-dimension or rank factors when the number of blocks and problem constants are fixed. The proof follows a descent inequality and a decomposition of the momentum tracking error into initialization, noise, and drift. For the original five-step quintic, we verify the required scalar-map bounds analytically; the result also allows step-dependent coefficients satisfying the same bounds. A complementary nuclear-norm result quantifies rank dependence under a stronger spectral condition. The vanishing rate uses coupled learning-rate and momentum schedules, including the standard single-coefficient Nesterov rule.

</details>


### [507] [Hybrid Methods for Robust Tabular Data Imputation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39613)
*Jinwei Li,Michelle Bruch,Daniel Tenbrinck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出NuclearForest与SoftForest两种混合插补方法，将基于核范数的低秩初始化（SVT与SoftImpute）与非迭代随机森林精炼相结合，在保持或超越MissForest精度的同时大幅降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺失数据是统计分析与机器学习的核心挑战，插补方法的选择严重影响下游推断。现有方法（如MissForest等迭代方法）精度高但计算代价大，亟需兼顾精度与效率的方案。

Method: 用SVT和SoftImpute进行基于核范数的低秩初始化，捕捉全局协方差结构提供结构化热启动；随后用非迭代的随机森林单步精炼恢复局部依赖的非线性残差信号。针对SVT组件引入自适应步长规则，证明自适应步长界并建立零初始化迭代的收敛性。支持混合类型变量。

Result: 在多个领域数据集、MCAR/MAR/MNAR三种机制及不同缺失率下，与七种已有方法对比，所提方法在插补保真度上匹配或超越MissForest等最先进迭代方法，速度分别约为MissForest的5.81倍和9.52倍。

Conclusion: 该方法有效利用真实表格数据的低秩结构并兼容混合类型变量，为生物信息学、经济学等领域提供高效稳健的插补方案。

Abstract: Missing data are a fundamental challenge in statistical analysis and machine learning, as the choice of imputation method substantially impacts downstream inference. In this work, we propose two hybrid imputation methods called NuclearForest and SoftForest, which combine nuclear-norm-based low-rank initialization using Singular Value Thresholding (SVT) and SoftImpute, respectively, with a non-iterative Random Forest refinement. For the SVT-based component, we further introduce an adaptive step-size rule, prove adaptive step-size bounds, and establish convergence for the corresponding zero-initialized iteration. The low-rank initialization provides a structured warm start that captures the global covariance patterns in the data, while the subsequent Random Forest step recovers residual nonlinear signals encoding local dependencies. We conduct an extensive benchmark on diverse datasets from different application domains, comparing the proposed methods with seven established imputation methods under the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR), Missing at Random (MAR), and Missing Not at Random (MNAR) mechanisms across varying missingness rates. Our results demonstrate that NuclearForest and SoftForest match or exceed the imputation fidelity of state-of-the-art iterative methods such as MissForest, while significantly reducing computational cost. In particular, they achieve speedups of approximately 5.81 times and 9.52 times over MissForest by replacing iterative cycles with a single refinement step. Our approach effectively exploits the low-rank structure of real-world tabular data and accommodates mixed-type variables, providing an efficient and robust solution for data imputation in bioinformatics, economics, and beyond.

</details>


### [508] [Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39626)
*Marcio A. Sampaio,Paulo H. Ranazzi,Martin J. Blunt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对集合平滑器在非高斯（复杂相分布）先验下性能下降的问题，比较VAE-GAN、Latent Diffusion与StyleGAN2等深度学习参数化方法，并首次将StyleGAN2分别在其潜空间z与中间空间w进行数据同化，发现w空间效果更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集合平滑器是历史拟合中最成功高效的方法，但依赖高斯假设，当先验地质表现为复杂相分布（非高斯）时性能严重退化，因此需要高效参数化技术；深度学习模型是最有效的参数化手段，但尚不清楚哪种模型最适合与集合类方法配合使用。

Method: 基于文献综述筛选出VAE-GAN、Latent Diffusion和StyleGAN2三种最有前景的模型；作为创新点，采用第二代StyleGAN（StyleGAN2）分别在其潜空间z和中间空间w进行数据同化（结合ESMDA），并在两个二维案例（三分类相与连续型）中应用。

Result: 三种模型均高效，其中StyleGAN2在生成地质真实感样本和实现优良数据匹配方面表现突出；使用中间空间w进行数据同化的效果优于传统潜空间z，原因是ESMDA采用线性更新，而w空间比高度纠缠的z空间更线性、更解耦，使更新向量更接近真实地质模式；结果通过主要地质统计学与历史拟合指标验证。

Conclusion: StyleGAN2配合w空间数据同化是处理非高斯先验的高效参数化方案，优于z空间及传统做法，并通过地质统计与历史拟合指标得到验证。

Abstract: Ensemble smoothers are the most successful and efficient techniques currently available for history matching. However, because these methods rely on Gaussian assumptions, their performance is severely degraded when the prior geology is described in terms of complex facies distributions (non-Gaussian). In this way, for these methods, we need to apply efficient parameterization techniques. Currently, the most efficient methods for performing parameterization are deep learning models. However, given the variety of existing deep learning models, studies have not identified which is most suitable for use with ensemble-based methods, although some important models had already been evaluated. Based on a recent literature review, the most promising models selected were VAE-GAN, Latent Diffusion, and StyleGAN models. As a novel aspect of this work, data assimilation with the second generation of StyleGAN (StyleGAN2) model was performed using the latent z-space and intermediate w-space, separately. They were applied in two 2D case studies: one categorical (three facies) and the other continuous. The results demonstrated that all three models are highly efficient, with the StyleGAN2 model standing out for generating samples with geological realism and achieving excellent data matching in the cases studied. Our findings show that performing data assimilation with StyleGAN2 using the intermediate space (w-space) yielded better results than the traditional application in the latent space (z-space). This is due to the fact that ESMDA uses linear updates and the w-space is much more linear and disentangled than the highly entangled z-space, thereby ensuring that the updated vectors remain close to realistic geological patterns. These results were validated using main geostatistical and history matching metrics.

</details>


### [509] [MIND: Marginal-Invariant Neural Dependency Diffusion for Mixed-Type Tabular Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39628)
*Pengfei Li,Mohammad Khalil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIND是一个边际不变神经依赖扩散模型，通过分离边际建模与依赖学习来生成混合类型表格数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始异质特征空间中直接学习联合分布困难，边际与依赖耦合导致生成质量难以平衡。

Method: 通过列向边际传输映射到统一隐依赖空间；条件扩散模型学习跨列关系；copula-tangent去噪分离已知边际成分与可学习依赖残差；采样阶段用秩投影缓解边际偏移。

Result: 在九个多样化表格基准上，MIND在边际保真度和依赖保持上持续优于现有统一方法。

Conclusion: 将边际建模与依赖建模分离是复杂混合类型表格生成的一种原则性且高效范式。

Abstract: This paper proposes MIND, a marginal-invariant neural dependency diffusion model for mixed-type tabular data. MIND does not directly learn the joint distribution in the original heterogeneous feature space. Instead, it first maps different variable types into a unified latent dependency space via column-wise marginal transport. A conditional diffusion model then learns cross-column relationships. Copula-tangent denoising separates known marginal components from learnable dependency residuals. Rank projection during the sampling phase further mitigates marginal shift in reverse diffusion. Experiments across nine diverse tabular benchmarks show that MIND consistently improves marginal fidelity and dependency preservation over existing unified approaches. By explicitly isolating marginal modelling from dependency learning, MIND achieves a strong and stable balance among marginal fidelity, joint dependency preservation, and downstream prediction utility. This work supports separating marginal and dependency modelling as a principled and highly effective paradigm for complex mixed-type tabular generation.

</details>


### [510] [Certification-Based Differentially Private Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39629)
*Mihnea Ghitu,Matthew Wicker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用形式化方法（抽象解释）统一分析差分隐私的隐私预测与隐私学习，将AGT框架推广到连续无界回归，并提出AGS算法为隐私学习提供基于可达性的保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有形式化方法仅用于分类场景下的隐私预测，缺乏对回归任务和隐私学习的通用隐私分析工具，且全局敏感度在许多情形下无界。

Method: 将AGT框架推广至连续无界回归的隐私预测；通过将参数化模型的学习归约为参数空间上的回归问题，提出Abstract Gradient Sampling（AGS）算法，实现基于可达性分析的隐私学习保证；并给出平滑敏感度上界的隐私记账与理论分析。

Result: 在回归基准上，回归边界比全局敏感度基线更紧；在全局预测敏感度先验无界的场景下首次给出有限隐私保证；匹配条件下隐私学习算法可优于标准隐私学习器。

Conclusion: 形式化方法可作为更紧隐私分析的通用工具，同时适用于隐私预测与隐私学习，并在回归与无界敏感度场景中展现出优势。

Abstract: Differential privacy (DP) in machine learning is typically achieved by adding noise to model parameters (private learning) or to model outputs (private prediction). Recent work uses formal methods, namely abstract interpretation, to provide tighter privacy guarantees, but only for private prediction in classification settings. In this work, we investigate the use of formal methods as a general tool for tighter privacy analysis. First, we generalize the abstract gradient training (AGT) framework to private prediction in continuous, unbounded regression. Second, by reducing learning in parameterized models to a regression problem over the parameter space, we introduce Abstract Gradient Sampling (AGS), an algorithm that enables reachability-based analysis to provide guarantees for private learning. In both private prediction and private learning, we provide tightened privacy accounting for the AGT framework and a theoretical analysis demonstrating when our smooth sensitivity upper-bounds yield favourable privacy-utility trade-off. In practice, we validate that our regression bounds are tighter than global-sensitivity baselines on regression benchmarks, and, notably, yield the first finite privacy guarantees in settings where global prediction sensitivity is a priori unbounded. We also find that under matched conditions, our private learning algorithm can outperform standard private learners.

</details>


### [511] [PEG-Tab: Sampling-Time Record Repair and Release Control for Tabular Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39630)
*Pengfei Li,QinYi Liu,Mohammad Khalil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PEG-Tab 是一种针对冻结表格生成器的训练后修复与发布控制框架，在不更新参数的情况下降低复制风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练表格生成器即使聚合效用高，仍可能复制训练记录；当重训练不可用或成本过高时，只能依赖采样与发布阶段的干预。

Method: 对每个生成行，用生成器原生算子产生两个备选；共享校准评分比较三个候选，偏好低风险记录，并进行最终发布检查。方法应用于 GReaT、CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM。

Result: 在五个数据集、四类生成器上，平均 Near Copy 从 0.078 降至 0.027，Exact Copy 降至 0；相比 3 倍事后过滤，在 16 个迁移设置中 12 个保持更高效用，并在 8 个中帕累托优于过滤器。

Conclusion: PEG-Tab 有效降低复制与邻近风险，且效用损失较小，适用于冻结生成器的后处理场景。

Abstract: Pretrained tabular generators can reproduce training records even when aggregate utility remains high. When retraining is unavailable or too costly, sampling and release are the remaining intervention points. We present PEG-Tab (Post-Training Energy Guidance for Tabular Synthesis), a post-training repair and release-control framework for frozen tabular generators. For each generated row, a generator-native operator creates two alternatives. A shared calibrated score compares the three candidates, favours lower-risk records, and applies a final release check. We instantiate this interface for GReaT, CTGAN, TVAE, and TabDDPM without updating their parameters. Across five datasets and four generator families, PEG-Tab reduces mean Near Copy from $0.078$ to $0.027$ and lowers aggregate Exact Copy to zero. Relative to a $3\times$ post hoc filter, it retains higher utility in 12 of 16 transfer settings and Pareto-dominates the filter in eight. Gains are concentrated in copy and proximity-related risks.

</details>


### [512] [Towards Better Exploration in Sequential Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39632)
*Joseph Rance,Fabio Pizzati,Juil Sock,Woody Bayliss,Marc Górriz Blanch,Philip Torr,Adel Bibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文发现顺序式测试时扩展(sequential scaling)常因过早陷入"吸引子"(attractor)而停止改进,并提出简单模型混合干预来帮助逃逸。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展可提升推理能力,但现有两类方法(并行、顺序)在长时间尺度上都难以持续改进:并行采样在单次难以解决的问题上扩展性差,而顺序方法能否超越并行方法此前未被证实。

Method: 通过27种扩展方法×模型×基准的组合,分析顺序扩展的轨迹,识别出"吸引子"现象;并提出模型混合(model-mixing)干预帮助逃逸吸引子。

Result: 53.8%的顺序扩展轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子;模型混合使吸引子命中率平均降低21.2个百分点,将解覆盖扩展到超过算力匹配的并行基线,并使递归自聚合准确率至少提升2.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 长时程测试时扩展的研究应从并行方法转向能基于先前答案改进的顺序方法。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute at inference. However, both classes of existing methods often fail to continue improving over long timescales. Parallel methods repeatedly sample independent answers from the model, scaling poorly on problems the model is unlikely to solve in a single attempt. In contrast, sequential methods build on previous answers to access new ideas, yet so far have not been shown to reach answers beyond those found by parallel scaling. First, we show that sequential scaling often stops improving because it becomes prematurely trapped in an attractor: a set of answers that prevents exploration of different answers once entered. Across 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and benchmarks, we find that 53.8% of sequential scaling trajectories enter an attractor within four iterations. Second, we show that a simple model-mixing intervention helps escape attractors. This reduces the attractor hit rate by 21.2 percentage points on average, expands solution coverage beyond a compute-matched parallel baseline, and improves accuracy of recursive self-aggregation by at least 2.2 percentage points. Our results motivate refocusing long-horizon test-time scaling from parallel methods to sequential methods that improve previous answers.

</details>


### [513] [Free Everywhere, Exact on Trees: PPO's Dropped Correction Buys Sample Efficiency Under Aggressive Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39634)
*Nima H. Siboni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出TRPO/PPO/GRPO等策略改进方法因使用行为策略的状态访问分布而产生偏差，提出在history-injective dynamics下可精确恢复状态访问比率，并给出偏差-方差可调的一族修正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流策略改进方法（TRPO、PPO、GRPO）在行为策略的状态访问分布下估计改进目标，引入随策略偏离增大的偏差，依赖trust region/clip且无法远距off-policy复用数据。

Method: 证明在history-injective dynamics下，被丢弃的状态访问比率等于采样前缀上每步策略比率的乘积（不仅期望意义且逐轨迹成立），从而利用PPO已计算的log-prob精确恢复该比率；并推广为含单参数α的偏差-方差族（α=0即PPO，α=1为完全修正），并对未裁剪surrogate做梯度级分析。

Result: 梯度分析识别出修正起作用的两条通道与三个有效条件，可枚举测试台验证了预测；在困难credit-assignment调度任务上，短期修正warmup配合激进早复用比PPO和未修正复用学得更快，边际收益随难度增大（AUC +0.02至+0.09）；全程施加修正或clipping已包含复用偏差处则无效甚至有害。

Conclusion: 精确修正在history-injective设定下可恢复状态访问比率，但会带来随horizon增长的方差；作为单参数偏差-方差旋钮，仅在特定条件与早期激进复用场景下有效，应谨慎使用而非全程施加。

Abstract: Common policy improvement methods, including TRPO, PPO, and GRPO, estimate policy improvement under the behavioral policy's state-visitation distribution rather than the improved policy's own. The substitution makes the objective estimable from the behavioral policy's rollouts but adds a bias growing with policy divergence, hence the trust region or clip, and hence no reuse of a batch far off-policy. We show that under history-injective dynamics, where each state is reached by exactly one history, the dropped state-visitation ratio equals the product of per-step policy ratios along the sampled prefix, on every trajectory and not only in expectation. The ratio is therefore restored exactly, from log-probabilities PPO already computes. Autoregressive generation and canonical-order constructive optimization are both history-injective. The exact correction pays importance-sampling variance that grows with the horizon, so we generalize it to a one-parameter family with PPO ($α{=}0$) and the full correction ($α{=}1$) as endpoints: a single bias--variance knob. A gradient-level analysis of the unclipped surrogate identifies two channels the correction acts through and three conditions under which it carries signal; an enumerable testbed confirms the conditions' predictions. On hard credit-assignment scheduling tasks, a short corrected warmup with aggressive early sample reuse learns faster than PPO and than the same reuse uncorrected; the marginal gain grows with task difficulty ($+0.02$ to $+0.09$ learning-curve AUC), and the early win over PPO tracks the prefix bias that reuse incurs. A correction held throughout, or applied where clipping already contains the reuse bias, is null to harmful.

</details>


### [514] [RiboUnmix: Learning Shared Translational Dynamics from Biased and Noisy Ribo-seq Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39644)
*Gabriele Martino,Denis Skibinski,Ivo L. Hofacker,Sebastian Tschiatschek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RiboUnmix，一个概率多数据集框架，通过共享序列依赖信号乘以数据集特定因子并采用负二项观测模型，将Ribo-seq测量中的实验效应与真实核糖体占据生物学信号解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ribo-seq测得的核糖体占据谱包含实验特异性的扭曲与随机变异，因此仅能准确预测测量谱的模型可能复现的是技术效应而非真实的生物学信号。作者希望探究：联合建模不同实验条件下收集的数据集，能否揭示共享的、序列依赖的核糖体占据模式。

Method: RiboUnmix将每个预期测量谱表示为共享的序列依赖信号与数据集特异性乘性因子的乘积；使用负二项分布观测模型刻画重复样本间的变异。在结合程序化翻译动力学、核糖体流、随机计数采样和序列依赖性实验扭曲的合成基准上评估，因真值已知可分别检验两个组分的恢复情况；并在四个物种真实数据基准及114个HEK数据集子集上验证。

Result: 合成基准中，推断的共享谱与数据集特异效应均与各自目标强相关，证明可解耦共享动力学模式与实验效应；在四个物种真实数据基准上，RiboUnmix预测测量谱的表现优于序列到谱的基线；独立训练的114个HEK数据集子集对留出转录本恢复出高度一致的共享谱，且改变训练数据集数量与组成时学习到的表示保持稳定。

Conclusion: RiboUnmix将实验间的变异转化为可复现的序列依赖核糖体占据模式的证据，支持从多样化Ribo-seq数据集中进行生物学假设生成。

Abstract: Ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq) measures ribosome distributions along mRNAs, but observed occupancy profiles also contain experiment-specific distortions and stochastic variability. Consequently, models that accurately predict measured profiles may reproduce technical effects rather than recover the underlying biology. We ask whether jointly modeling datasets collected under different experimental conditions can reveal shared, sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy. We introduce RiboUnmix, a probabilistic multi-dataset framework in which each expected measured profile is represented as a shared sequence-dependent signal modulated by a dataset-specific multiplicative factor. A negative-binomial observation model captures variability across replicates. We evaluate RiboUnmix on a controlled synthetic benchmark combining programmed translation kinetics, ribosome traffic, stochastic count sampling, and sequence-dependent experimental distortions. Because the underlying kinetics and distortions are known, recovery of the shared profile and dataset-specific effects can be assessed separately. Both inferred components correlate strongly with their targets, demonstrating that RiboUnmix can disentangle shared kinetic patterns from experimental effects. Across four organism-specific real-data benchmarks, RiboUnmix outperforms sequence-to-profile baselines in predicting measured profiles. Models trained independently on subsets of 114 HEK-derived datasets recover concordant shared profiles for held-out transcripts, and experiments varying the number and composition of training datasets show that the learned representation remains stable. RiboUnmix thus converts variation across experiments into evidence for reproducible sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy, supporting biological hypothesis generation from diverse Ribo-seq datasets.

</details>


### [515] [Beyond Uniform Compression: Budgeted Transmission Allocation for Extreme Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39646)
*Pengfei Li,Mohammad Khalil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LBAT，将联邦学习上行通信建模为资源分配问题，按层动态分配rank与bit预算，在极端带宽下优于均匀压缩方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端上传高维模型更新造成严重通信瓶颈；现有方法对所有层均匀压缩，忽略了不同参数块的异质价值，导致带宽浪费在不敏感层上。

Method: LBAT把极端上行预算下的通信重构为资源分配问题：利用本地训练信号动态估计各层的传输价值，再用精确的字节级动态规划分配器，在严格预算下确定最优的rank与bit配置。

Result: 在高度异质的联邦表格预测与数据生成任务上验证，LBAT在多种极端预算场景下一致优于均匀rank、均匀量化及固定压缩基线，并在保持分布保真度的同时取得更好的通信-效用权衡。

Conclusion: 按层自适应的预算分配优于均匀压缩策略，能在极端通信约束下兼顾通信效率与模型效用，且保持必要的分布保真度。

Abstract: Federated learning faces severe communication bottlenecks when clients upload high-dimensional model updates. Existing methods often compress these updates uniformly across all layers. This uniform approach ignores the heterogeneous value of different parameter blocks and wastes limited bandwidth on insensitive layers. To address this issue, we propose Layer-wise Budgeted Adaptive Transmission (LBAT). LBAT reframes federated communication under extreme uplink budgets as a resource allocation problem. Our framework dynamically estimates the transmission value of different layers utilising local training signals. It then employs an exact byte dynamic programming allocator to determine optimal rank and bit configurations under strict budgets. We validate LBAT on highly heterogeneous federated tabular prediction and data generation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LBAT consistently outperforms uniform rank, uniform quantisation, and fixed compression baselines across various extreme budget regimes. Furthermore, it achieves significantly better communication and utility tradeoffs while preserving essential distributional fidelity.

</details>


### [516] [From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39648)
*Cristina López Amado,Marco Fumero,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将扩散模型视为一族随噪声尺度变化的确定性动力系统，通过噪声尺度下不动点的持久性（临界尺度σ_c）来量化记忆现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型通常被理解为噪声到数据的随机过程，但缺乏一个几何视角来理解记忆（memorization）现象，包括由重复、过拟合和异常值导致的记忆。

Method: 在每个固定噪声尺度σ下把去噪器看作自映射并研究其动力学：精确去噪器的不动点对应平滑数据密度的临界点，吸引子对应其众数；随σ增大样本级众数逐级合并。用临界尺度σ_c（样本仍被固定尺度动力学保留的最大噪声尺度）量化持久性，并在条件模型中扩展到图文对。

Result: 受控实验与大规模模型实验表明，σ_c能追踪由重复、过拟合和异常值引起的记忆，并在Stable Diffusion中识别完全记忆与部分记忆的样本，还可给出记忆在图像空间分布和字幕依赖方面的可解释度量。

Conclusion: 固定尺度下的动力学分析为扩散模型的记忆提供了几何刻画，σ_c是一种有效的记忆检测与解释性度量工具。

Abstract: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $σ$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $σ$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale $σ_c$, the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image--caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that $σ_c$ tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion.
